Bava Metzia 107a:11-107b:3: Amar leh rav yehuda leravin bar rav nachman: ravin achi, la tizboyn ara dismicha lemata, deamar rabbi avahu amar rav huna amar rav: asur lo leadam sheyyaamod al sede chavero beshaa sheomedet bekamoteha.
Ini? veha ashkechinhu rabbi abba letalmideh derav, amar lehu: may amar rav behane kerae "baruch atta bair uvaruch atta bassade", "baruch atta bevoecha uvaruch atta betzetecha"?

Vaamaru leh, hachi amar rav: "baruch atta bair" – sheyyehe betcha samuch levet hakkeneset. "baruch atta bassade" – sheyyehu nechasecha kerovim lair. "baruch atta bevoecha" – shello timtza ishtecha sefek nidda bishat biatcha min hadderech. "baruch atta betzetecha" – sheyyehu tzeetzae meecha kemotcha.
Vaamar lehu: rabbi yochanan la amar hachi, ella: "baruch atta bair" – sheyyehe bet hakkisse samuch leshulechancha, aval bet hakkeneset la. verabbi yochanan letameh, deamar: sechar pesiot yesh.

"Baruch atta bassade" – sheyyehu nechasecha meshullashin: shelish bitvua, shelish bezetim, ushelish bigfanim. "baruch atta bevoecha uvaruch atta betzetecha" – shettehe yetziatcha min haolam keviatcha leolam. ma biatcha leolam belo chet, af yetziatcha min haolam belo chet.
La kashya: ha dimhaddar leh shura veritka, ha dela mehaddar leh shura veritka.
"Vehesir Adonai mimmecha kol choli", amar rav: zo [ha]ayin. rav letameh. derav salek leve kivre, avad may daavad, amar: tishin vetisha beayin raa, veechad bederech eretz.
Ushemuel amar: ze haruach. shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: hakkol baruach. velishmuel: ha ikka haruge malchut! hanach name, i lav zika, avdi lehu samma vechaye.
Berakhot 10b:21-28: Amar abbaye, veittema rabbi yitzchak: harotze lehanot — yehane, keelisha. vesheeno rotze lehanot — al yehane, kishmuel haramati. shenneemar: "uteshuvato haramata ki sham beto", veamar rabbi yochanan: shekkol makom shehalach sham — beto immo.
"Vattomer el ishah hinne na yadati ki ish elohim kadosh hu", amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: mikkan shehaishsha makkeret beorchin yoter min haish.
"Kadosh hu": mena yada? rav ushemuel. chad amar: shello raata zevuv over al shulchano, vechad amar: sadin shel pishtan hitztzia al mittato velo raata keri alav.
"Kadosh hu" amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: hu kadosh umesharto eno kadosh. shenneemar: "vayyiggash gechazi lehadfah", amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: sheachazah behod yafyah.
"Over alenu tamid", amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: kol hameareach talmid chacham betoch beto umehannehu minnechasav — maale alav hakkatuv keillu makriv temidin.
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: al yaamod adam bemakom gavoah veyitpallel, ella bemakom namuch veyitpallel. shenneemar: "mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai".

Tanya name hachi: lo yaamod adam lo al gabbe kisse, velo al gabbe sherafraf, velo bemakom gavoah, veyitpallel, ella bemakom namuch, veyitpallel. lefi sheen gavhut lifne hammakom. shenneemar "mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai". uchetiv: "tefilla leani chi yaatof".
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: hammitpallel tzarich sheyyechavven et raglav, shenneemar: "veraglehem regel yeshara".

Ketubot 39b:4-10: Haones noten miyyad hamefatte lichsheyyotzi vechulei. lichsheyyotzi?! ishto hi? amar abbaye: ema lichshello yichnos. tanya name hachi: af al pi sheamru hamefatte noten lichshello yichnos, boshet ufegam noten miyyad. veechad haones veechad hamefatte, ben hi uven aviha yecholin leakkev.
Bishlama mefutta — ketiv: "im maen yemaen aviha". en li ella aviha, hi atzmah minnayin — talmud lomar: "yemaen", mikkol makom.
Ella ones? bishlama ihi — ketiv: "velo tihye", middatah. ella aviha menalan?

Amar abbaye: shello yehe chote niskar. rava amar: kal vachomer, uma mefatte shello avar ella al daat aviha bilvad, ben hi uven aviha yecholin leakkev — ones sheavar al daat aviha veal daat atzmah, lo kol shekken?!

Rava la amar keabbayye. kevan deka meshallem kenas, lav chote niskar hu. abbaye la amar kerava: mefatte deihu matze meakkev — aviha name matze meakkev, ones deihu la matze meakkev — aviha name la matze meakkev.

Tanya iddach: af al pi sheamru ones noten miyyad, kesheyyotzi hu en lah alav kelum. kesheyyotzi?! mi matze mappek la?! ema: keshettetze hi, en lah alav kelum. met — yatza kesef kenasah bichtubbatah. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: yesh lah ketubba mane.

Bemay kamippalgi. rabbanan savri: tama may takkinu rabbanan ketubba — kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah, veha la matze mappek la. verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar: ha name metzaar la ad deamra hi "la baena lach".
Menachot 43b:8-16: Tanya iddach: "ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai", shekula mitzva zo keneged kol hammitzvot kullan.

Vetanya iddach: "ureitem oto uzechartem... vaasitem" – reiyya mevia lide zechira, zechira mevia lide asiyya. verabbi shimon bar yochay omer: kol hazzariz bemitzva zo zoche umekabbel pene shechina. ketiv hacha: "ureitem oto", uchetiv hatam: "et Adonai elohecha tira veoto taavod".

Tanu rabbanan: chavivin yisrael shessibbevan hakkadosh baruch hu bemitzvot, tefillin berashehen utefillin bizrootehen vetzitzit bevigdehen umezuza lefitchehen, vaalehen amar david: "sheva bayyom hillalticha al mishpete tzidkecha".

Uveshaa shennichnas david levet hammerchatz veraa atzmo omed arom, amar: oy li sheeemod arom belo mitzva! vechevan shennizkar bammila shebbivsaro, nityayshsheva dato. leachar sheyyatza, amar aleha shira, shenneemar: "lamnatztzeach al hashsheminit mizmor ledavid", al mila shennittena bashshemini.

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: kol sheyyesh lo tefillin berosho utefillin bizroo vetzitzit bevigdo umezuza befitcho, hakkol bechizzuk shello yecheta, shenneemar: "vehachut hameshullash lo vimhera yinnatek", veomer: "chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem".

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: ma nishtanna techelet mikkol mine tzivonin? mippene shehattechelet dome layyam, veyam dome larakia, verakia lechisse hakkavod, shenneemar: "vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar", uchetiv: "kemare even sappir demut kisse".

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: gadol onsho shel lavan yoter meonsho shel techelet, mashal lema haddavar dome? lemelech basar vadam sheamar lishne avadav, leechad amar: "have li chotam shel tit", uleechad amar: "have li chotam shel zahav", ufashu shenehem velo heviu, eze mehen onsho merubbe? heve omer: ze sheamar lo "have li chotam shel tit" velo hevi.
Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: chayyayv adam levarech mea berachot bechol yom, shenneemar: "veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach".

Shiyyer miktzat hagget uchetavo vaddaf hashsheni, vehaedim millematta, kasher. chatmu edim berosh haddaf, min hatztzad, o meacharav beget pashut, pasul. hikkif rosho shel ze vetzad rosho shel ze, vehaedim baemtza, shenehem pesulin. sofo shel ze vetzad sofo shel ze, vehaedim baemtza, et shehaedim nikrin immo, kasher. rosho shel ze vetzad sofo shel ze, vehaedim baemtza, et shehaedim nikrin besofo, kasher:

Yatza shemah bair mekuddeshet, hare zo mekuddeshet. megoreshet, hare zo megoreshet. uvilvad shello yehe sham amatla. ezo hi amatla. gerash ish peloni et ishto al tenay, zarak lah kiddusheha, safek karov lah safek karov lo, zo hi amatla:

Mishnah Kelim 10:3-6:
Megufat hechavit hamechulchelet veenah nishmetet, rabbi yehuda omer, matztzelet. vachachamim omrim, enah matztzelet. haya vet etzba shellah shokea betochah, hashsheretz betochah, hechavit temea. hashsheretz bechavit, ochalin shebbetochah temeim: 
Hakkaddur vehappekaat shel gemi shennetanan al pi hechavit, im merach min hatztzedadin, lo hitztzil, ad sheyyemarach milmalan umillemattan. vechen bematlit shel beged. hayta shel neyar o shel or, ukesharah bimshicha, im merach min hatztzedadin, hitztzil: 
Chavit shennitkallefa vehazzefet shellah omedet, vechen kevosim shel muryas sheggefatan im hassafa, rabbi yehuda omer, enam matztzilin. vachachamim omrim, matztzilin: 
Chavit shennikkeva usetamuha shemarim, hitztziluha. pekakah bizmora, ad sheyyemarach min hatztzedadim. hayu shetayim, ad sheyyemarach min hatztzedadin uven zemora lachavertah. neser shehu natun al pi hattannur, im merach min hatztzedadin, hitztzil. hayu shenayim, ad sheyyemarach min hatztzedadin uven neser lachavero. asaan besinin o veshogmin, eno tzarich lemareach min haemtza:
Mishnah Kelim 10:7-11:3:
Tannur yashan betoch hechadash usereda al pi hayyashan, nittal hayyashan usereda nofelet, hakkol tame. veim lav, hakkol tahor. chadash betoch hayyashan usereda al pi hayyashan, im en ben chadash lassereda foteach tefach, kol shebbechadash tahor: 
Lefasin zo vetoch zo vesiftotehen shavot, hashsheretz baelyona o vattachtona, hi temea vechullan tehorot. hayu vechones mashke, hashsheretz baelyona, kullan temeot. battachtona, hi temea vechullan tehorot. hashsheretz baelyona, vehattachtona odefet, hi vehattachtona temea. baelyona, vehattachtona odefet, kol sheyyesh bah mashke tofeach, temea: 
Kele mattachot, peshutehen umekabbelehen temein. nishberu, taharu. chazar veasa mehen keli, chazru letumatan hayeshana. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo lechol tuma, ella letumat hannafesh: 
Kol keli mattachot sheyyesh lo shem bifne atzmo, tame, chutz min haddelet, umin hanneger, umin hammanul, vehappota shettachat hatztzir, vehatztzir, vehakkora, vehatztzinnor, shennaasu lakkarka: 
Haose chelim min haeshet, umin hacharara, umin hassovev shel galgal, umin hattassin, umin hatztzippuyin, mikkanne chelim, umeogne chelim, meazne chelim, min hashshecholet, umin haggerudot, tehorin. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, af min hakketzutzot. mishshivre chelim, min haggerutim, umin hammasmerot, sheyyadua shennaasu mikkeli, temein. min hammasmerot, bet shammay metammein, uvet hillel metaharin:
Mishnah Kelim 11:4-7:
Barzel tame shebbelalo im barzel tahor, im rov min hattame, tame. veim rov min hattahor, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. vechen min hachalama umin haggelalim. kelostera, temea. umetzuppa, tehora. happin, vehappurena, temein. vehakkelostera, rabbi yehoshua omer, shomtah mippetach ze vetolah bachavero beshabbat. rabbi tarfon omer, hare hi lo kechol hakkelim, umittaltelet bechatzer: 
Akrav shel perumbeya, temea. ulechayayim, tehorim. rabbi eliezer metamme vallechayayim. vachachamim omrim, en tame ella akrav. uvishat chibburan, hakkol tame: 
Pika shel mattechet, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. umetzuppa, tehora. hakkush, vehaimma, vehammakkel, vesimponya, vechalil shel mattechet, temein. umetzuppin, tehorim. simponya, im yesh bah bet kibbul kenafayim, ben kach uven kach temea: 
Keren agulla, temea. ufeshuta, tehora. im hayta metzuppit shellah shel mattechet, temea. hakkav shellah, rabbi tarfon metamme, vachachamim metaharin. uvishat chibburan, hakkol tame. kayyotze vo, kene menora, tehorin. happerach vehabbasis, temeim. uvishat chibburan, hakkol tame:
Mishnah Kelim 11:8-12:2:
Kasda, temea. ulechayayim, tehorim. im yesh bahen bet kibbul mayim, temeim. kol kele hammilchama, temeim. hakkidon, hannikon, vehammaggafayin, vehashshiryon, temein. kol tachshite nashim, temeim. ir shel zahav, katlayot, nezamim vetabbaot, vetabbaat, ben sheyyesh lah chotam uven sheen lah chotam, nizme haaf. katla shechulyot shellah shel mattachot bechut shel pishtan o shel tzemer, nifsak hachut, hachulyot temeot, shekkol achat veachat keli vifne atzmah. chut shel mattachot, vechulyot shel avanim tovot umargaliyyot, veshel zechuchit, nishtabberu hachulyot, hachut bifne atzmo kayyam, tame. sheyare katla, kimlo tzavvar ketanna. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu tabbaat achat, temea, shekken tolin batztzavvar: 
Nezem shehu asuy kikdera millemattan vechaadasha milmalan, venifrak, kikdera tame mishshum keli vet kibbul, vechaadasha tame vifne atzmo. tzinnora, tehora. heasuy kemin eshkol, venifrak, tahor: 
Tabbaat adam, temea. tabbaat behema vechelim ushear kol hattabbaot, tehorot. korat hachitztzim, temea. veshel asirin, tehora. hakkolar, temea. shalshelet sheyyesh bah bet neila, temea. haasuya lichfita, tehora. shalshelet shel sitonot, temea, shel baale vattim tehora. amar rabbi yose, ematay, bizman shehu mafteach echad, aval im hayu shenayim, o shekkashar chillazon beroshah, temea: 
Kene moznayim shel sarokot, tame, mippene unkelayot. veshel baale vattim, im yesh bo unkelayot, tame. unkelin shel kattafin, tehora. veshel rochlim, temea. rabbi yehuda omer, shel rochlim, shellefanav temea, veshelleacharav tehora. unkeli dargash, temea. veshel naklitin, tehora. shel shidda, temea. veshel akon, tehora. shel shulchan, tame. shel menorat haetz, tahor. ze hakkelal, kol hamechubbar lattame, tame. vehamechubbar lattahor, tahor. vechullan, achat achat bifne atzman, tehorot:
Mishnah Kelim 12:3-7:

Mishnah Kelim 12:8-13:3:

Hassayif, vehassakkin, vehappigyon, veharomach, maggal yad umaggal katzir, vehashshechor vezug shel sapparim, shennechelku, hare ellu temein. rabbi yose omer, hassamuch layyad, tame. vehassamuch larosh, tahor. misperet shennechleka lishnayim, rabbi yehuda metamme, vachachamim metaharin:

Mishnah Kiddushin 1:1-4:

Behema gassa niknet bimsira, vehaddakka behagebaha, divre rabbi meir verabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, behema dakka niknet bimshicha:
Mishnah Kiddushin 1:10-2:3:
Kol haose mitzva achat, metivin lo umaarichin lo yamav venochel et haaretz. vechol sheeno ose mitzva achat, en metivin lo veen maarichin lo yamav veeno nochel et haaretz. kol sheyyeshno vammikra uvammishna uvederech eretz, lo vimhera hu chote, shenneemar (Kohelet 4) vehachut hameshullash lo vimhera yinnatek. vechol sheeno lo vammikra velo vammishna velo vederech eretz, eno min hayyishshuv: 
Haish mekaddesh bo uvishlucho. haishsha mitkaddeshet bah uvishluchah. haish mekaddesh et bitto keshehi naara, bo uvishlucho. haomer leishsha, hitkaddeshi li vitmara zo, hitkaddeshi li vezo, im yesh beachat mehen shave feruta, mekuddeshet. veim lav, enah mekuddeshet. bezo uvezo uvezo, im yesh shave feruta bechullan, mekuddeshet. veim lav, enah mekuddeshet. hayta ochelet rishona rishona, enah mekuddeshet, ad sheyyehe veachat mehen shave feruta: 
Hitkaddeshi li vechos ze shel yayin, venimtza shel devash. shel devash, venimtza shel yayin. bedinar ze shel kesef, venimtza shel zahav. shel zahav, venimtza shel kesef. al menat sheani ashir, venimtza ani. ani, venimtza ashir, enah mekuddeshet. rabbi shimon omer, im hitah leshevach, mekuddeshet: 
Al menat sheani chohen, venimtza levi. levi, venimtza chohen. natin, venimtza mamzer. mamzer, venimtza natin. ben ir, venimtza ven kerach. ben kerach, venimtza ven ir. al menat shebbeti karov lammerchatz, venimtza rachok. rachok, venimtza karov. al menat sheyyesh li vat o shifcha gaddelet, veen lo. o al menat sheen li, veyesh lo. al menat sheen li vanim, veyesh lo. o al menat sheyyesh li, veen lo. uvechullam, af al pi sheamra, belibbi haya lehitkaddesh lo, af al pi chen, enah mekuddeshet. vechen hi shehitattu:
Mishnah Kiddushin 1:5-9:
Nechasim sheyyesh lahem acharayut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka. vesheen lahem acharayut, en niknin ella vimshicha. nechasim sheen lahem acharayut, niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahem acharayut, bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka. vezokkin nechasim sheen lahem acharayut et hannechasim sheyyesh lahem acharayut lishshava alehen: 
Kol hannaase damim beacher, kevan shezzacha ze, nitchayyev ze vachalifav. ketzad. hechelif shor befara o chamor beshor, kevan shezzacha ze, nitchayyev ze vachalifav. reshut haggavoah, bechesef, ureshut hahedyot, bachazaka. amirato laggavoah, kimsirato lahedyot: 
Kol mitzvot habben al haav, anashim chayyavin venashim peturot. vechol mitzvot haav al habben, echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavin. vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah, anashim chayyavin venashim peturot. vechol mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah, echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavin. vechol mitzvat lo taase, ben shehazzeman geramah ben shello hazzeman geramah, echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavin, chutz mibbal tashchit uval takkif uval tittamma lemetim: 
Hassemichot, vehattenufot, vehahaggashot, vehakkemitzot, vehahaktarot, vehammelikot, vehahazzaot, vehakkabbalot, nohagin baanashim velo venashim, chutz mimminchat sota unezira, shehen menifot: 
Kol mitzva shehi teluya vaaretz enah noheget ella vaaretz. vesheenah teluya vaaretz noheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz, chutz min haarla vechilayim. rabbi eliezer omer, af min hechadash:
Mishnah Kiddushin 2:4-7:
Haomer lishlucho, tze vekaddesh li ishsha felonit bemakom peloni, vehalach vekiddeshah bemakom acher, enah mekuddeshet. hare hi vemakom peloni, vekiddeshah bemakom acher, hare zo mekuddeshet: 
Hamekaddesh et haishsha al menat sheen aleha nedarim venimtzeu aleha nedarim, enah mekuddeshet. kenasah setam venimtzeu aleha nedarim, tetze shello vichtubba. al menat sheen aleha mumin venimtzeu vah mumin, enah mekuddeshet. kenasah setam venimtzeu vah mumin, tetze shello vichtubba. kol hammumin happoslim bakkohanim, poslim bannashim: 
Hamekaddesh shete nashim beshave feruta, o ishsha achat befachot mishshave feruta, af al pi sheshshalach sivlonot leachar mikkan, enah mekuddeshet, shemmechamat kiddushin harishonim shalach. vechen katan shekkiddesh: 
Hamekaddesh ishsha uvittah o ishsha vaachotah, keachat, enan mekuddashot. umaase vechamesh nashim uvahen shete achayot, velikket echad kalkala shel teenim, veshellahem hayta veshel sheviit hayta, veamar hare chullechem mekuddashot li vechalkala zo, vekibbela achat mehen al yede chullan, veamru chachamim, en haachayot mekuddashot:
Mishnah Kiddushin 2:8-3:1:
Hamekaddesh bechelko, ben kadshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim, enah mekuddeshet. bemaaser sheni, ben shogeg ben mezid, lo kiddesh, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, beshogeg lo kiddesh, bemezid kiddesh. uvehekdesh, bemezid kiddesh uveshogeg lo kiddesh, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, beshogeg kiddesh, bemezid lo kiddesh: 
Hamekaddesh bearla, bechile hakkerem, beshor hanniskal, uveegla arufa, betzippore metzora, uvisar nazir, ufeter chamor, uvasar bechalav, vechullin shennishchatu vaazara, enah mekuddeshet. mecharan vekiddesh bidmehen, mekuddeshet: 
Hamekaddesh bitrumot uvemaasrot uvemattanot uveme chattat uveefer chattat, hare zo mekuddeshet, vaafillu yisrael: 
Haomer lachavero, tze vekaddesh li ishsha felonit vehalach vekiddeshah leatzmo, mekuddeshet. vechen haomer leishsha, hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheloshim yom, uva acher vekiddeshah betoch sheloshim yom, mekuddeshet lashsheni. bat yisrael lechohen, tochal batteruma. meachshav uleachar sheloshim yom, uva acher vekiddeshah betoch sheloshim yom, mekuddeshet veenah mekuddeshet. bat yisrael lechohen o vat kohen leyisrael, lo tochal batteruma:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 1:1: Maaser sheni, en mochrin oto, veen memashkenin oto, veen machalifin oto, velo shoklin kennegdo. velo yomar adam lachavero birushalayim, helach yayin veten li shamen. vechen shear kol happerot. aval notnin ze laze mattenat chinnam:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 1:2-5:
Masar behema, en mochrin oto tamim chay, velo vaal mum chay veshachut, veen mekaddeshin bo haishsha. habbechor mochrin oto tamim chay, uvaal mum chay veshachut, umekaddeshin bo haishsha. en mechallelin maaser sheni al asimon, velo al hammatbea sheeno yotze, velo al hammaot sheenan birshuto: 
Hallokeach behema lezivche shelamim, o chayya livsar taava, yatza haor lechullin, af al pi shehaor merubbe al habbasar. kadde yayin setumot, mekom sheddarkan limkor setumot, yatza kankan lechullin. haegozim vehashshekedim, yatzu kelippehem lechullin. hattemed, ad shello hechmitz, eno nilkach bechesef maaser. umishshehechmitz, nilkach bechesef maaser: 
Hallokeach chayya lezivche shelamim, behema livsar taava, lo yatza haor lechullin. kadde yayin petuchot o setumot, mekom sheddarkan limmacher petuchot, lo yatza kankan lechullin. salle zetim vesalle anavim im hakkeli, lo yatzu deme hakkeli lechullin: 
Hallokeach mayim, umelach, uferot hamechubbarim lakkarka, o ferot sheenan yecholin lehaggia lirushalayim, lo kana maaser. hallokeach perot, shogeg, yachzeru damim limkoman. mezid, yoolu veyeachlu vammakom. veim en mikdash, yerakkevu:
Mishnah Maasrot 3:4-8:
Matza ketzitzot badderech, afillu vetzad sede ketzitzot, vechen teena shehi nota al derech, umatza tachteha teenim, muttarot mishshum gazel ufeturot min hammaasrot. uvezetim uvecharuvim, chayyavim. matza gerogarot, im darsu rov bene adam, chayyav, veim lav, patur. matza filche devela, chayyav, sheyyadua shehen middavar gamur. vehecharuvin, ad shello chenasan lerosh haggag, morid mehem livhema, patur, mippene shehu machazir et hammotar: 
Ezo hi chatzer shehi chayyevet bammaasrot, rabbi yishmael omer, chatzer hatztzorit, shehakkelim nishmarim betochah. rabbi akiva omer, kol sheechad poteach veechad noel, petura. rabbi nechemya omer, kol sheen adam bosh milleechol betochah, chayyevet. rabbi yose omer, kol shennichnas lah veen omer ma atta mevakkesh, petura. rabbi yehuda omer, shene chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo, happenimit chayyevet, vehachitzona petura: 
Haggaggot peturin, af al pi shehem shel chatzer hachayyavet. bet shaar, achsadra umirpeset, hare ellu kechatzer, im chayyevet, chayyavin, veim petura, peturim: 
Hatztzerifin vehabburganin vehaelkatiyyot, peturin. sukkat ginnosar, af al pi sheyyesh bo rechayim vetarnegolim, petura. sukkat hayyotzrim, happenimit chayyevet, vehachitzona petura. rabbi yose omer, kol sheenah dirat hachamma vedirat haggeshamim, petura. sukkat hechag bechag, rabbi yehuda mechayyev, vachachamim potrin: 
Teena shehi omedet bechatzer, ochel achat achat ufatur. veim tzeraf, chayyav. rabbi shimon omer, achat bimino veachat bismolo veachat befiv. ala leroshah, memalle cheko veochel:
Mishnah Maasrot 3:9-4:2: Gefen shehi netua vechatzer, notel et kol haeshkol. vechen berimmon, vechen baavattiach, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, megarger baeshkolot, uforet barimmon, vesofet baavattiach. kusbar shehi zerua vechatzer, mekartem ale ale veochel. veim tzeraf, chayyav. hassea vehaezov vehakkoranit shebbechatzer, im hayu nishmarim, chayyavin:

Teena shehi omedet bechatzer venota lagginna, ochel kedarko ufatur. omedet bagginna venota lechatzer, ochel achat achat, patur. veim tzeraf, chayyav. omedet baaretz venota lechutza laaretz, bechutza laaretz venota laaretz, hakkol holech achar haikkar. uvevatte are choma, hakkol holech achar haikkar. uveare miklat, hakkol holech achar hannof. uvirushalayim, hakkol holech achar hannof:

Hakkovesh, hashsholek, hammoleach, chayyav. hamechammen baadama, patur. hametabbel bassade, patur. happotzea zetim sheyyetze mehem hasseraf, patur. hassochet zetim al besaro, patur. im sachat venatan letoch yado, chayyav. hamekappe letavshil, patur. likdera, chayyav, mippene shehu chevor katan:

Tinokot shettamnu teenim leshabbat, veshachchu leasseran, lo yochlu lemotzae shabbat ad sheyyeasseru. kalkalat shabbat, bet shammay potrin uvet hillel mechayyevin. rabbi yehuda omer, af halloket et hakkalkala lishloach lachavero, lo yochal ad sheyyitasser:
Mishnah Maasrot 4:3-6: Hannotel zetim min hammaatan, tovel echad echad bemelach veochel. im malach venatan lefanav, chayyav. rabbi eliezer omer, min hammaatan hattahor chayyav, umin hattame patur, mippene shehu machazir et hammotar:
Shotim al haggat, ben al hachammin ben al hatztzonen patur, divre rabbi meir. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok mechayyev. vachachamim omrim, al hachammin chayyav, veal hatztzonen patur:

Hamekallef seorim, mekallef achat achat veochel. veim killef venatan letoch yado, chayyav. hammolel melilot shel chittim, menappe miyyad leyad veochel. veim nippa venatan letoch cheko, chayyav. kusbar shezzeraah lezera, yarkah patur. zeraah leyarak, mitasseret zera veyarak. rabbi eliezer omer, hashshevet mitasseret zera veyarak vezerin. vachachamim omrim, eno mitasser zera veyarak ella hashshachalayim vehaggargir bilvad:

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, temarot shel tiltan veshel chardal veshel pol hallavan, chayyavot bammaaser. rabbi eliezer omer, hatztzalaf mitasser temarot vaaviyyonot vekafras. rabbi akiva omer, en mitasser ella aviyyonot, mippene shehen peri:
Mishnah Maasrot 5:1-5:
Haoker shetalim mittoch shello venata letoch shello, patur. lakach bimchubbar lakkarka, patur. lakat lishloach lachavero, patur. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, im yesh kayyotze vahem nimkarim bashshuk, hare ellu chayyavin: 
Haoker lefet utzenonot mittoch shello venotea letoch shello lezera, chayyav, mippene shehu garnan. betzalim, mishshehishrishu vaaliyya, taharu milletamme. nafla alehem mappolet vehem megullim, hare ellu kintuim bassade: 
Lo yimkor adam et perotav mishebbau leonat hammaasrot lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot, velo vashsheviit lemi shehu chashud al hashsheviit. veim bikkeru, notel et habbakkurot umocher et hashshear: 
Lo yimkor adam et tivno veet gifto veet zaggav lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot, lehotzi mehen mashkin. veim hotzi, chayyav bammaasrot ufatur min hatteruma, shehattorem, belibbo al hakketuim, al hatztzedadim veal ma shebbetoch hatteven: 
Hallokeach sede yarak besureya, im ad shello va leonat hammaasrot, chayyav. umishshebba leonat hammaasrot, patur, veloket kedarko veholech. rabbi yehuda omer, af yiskor poalim vilakket. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, bamme devarim amurim, bizman shekkana karka, aval bizman shello kana karka, im ad shello va leonat hammaasrot, patur. rabbi omer, af lefi cheshbon:
Mishnah Maasrot 5:6-8:
Hametammed venatan mayim bammidda umatza chede middato, patur. rabbi yehuda mechayyev. matza yoter al kede middato, motzi alav mimmakom acher lefi cheshbon: 
Chore hannemalim shellanu vetzad haarema hachayyevet, hare ellu chayyavim, sheyyadua shemmiddavar haggamur hayu gorrin kol hallayla: 
Shum baal bechi, uvatzal shel richpa, ugerisin hakkilkin, vehaadashim hammitzriyyot, rabbi meir omer, af hakkarkas, rabbi yose omer af hakkutenim, peturim min hammaasrot, venilkachin mikkol adam bashsheviit. zera luf haelyon, zera kereshim, zera betzalim, zera lefet utzenonot, ushear zerone ginna sheenan neechalim, peturim min hammaasrot, venilkachin mikkol adam bashsheviit, sheaf al pi sheavihen teruma, hare ellu yeachelu:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 2:11-12: Hakkore lemafrea lo yatza. bamme devarim amurim beseder happesukim aval im hikdim parasha lefarasha af al pi sheeno rashshay ani omer sheyyatza lefi sheenah semucha lah battora. kara pasuk vechazar ukerao paam sheniyya hare ze megunne. kara milla achat uchefalah kegon shekkara shema shema meshattekin oto:

Keraah serugin yatza. afillu shaha ben serug leserug kede ligmor et kullah yatza. vehu sheyyikra al hasseder. keraah mitnamnem vehu mi sheeno er velo nirdam beshena yatza. uvilvad sheyyihye er befasuk rishon:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 2:13-14: Safek kara keriat shema safek lo kara chozer vekore umevarech lefaneha uleachareha. aval im yada shekkara venistappek lo im berech lefaneha uleachareha o lo berech eno chozer umevarech. kara vetaa yachazor lammakom shettaa. neelam mimmennu ben parasha lefarasha veeno yodea e zo parasha hishlim vee zo tzarich lehatechil chozer lefarasha rishona shehu <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha" vegomer:

Taa beemtza happerek veeno yodea lehechan pasak chozer lerosh happerek. haya kore uchetavtam veeno yodea im hu beuchetavtam shel shema o beuchetavtam shebbivhaya im shamoa chozer leuchetavtam shel shema. veim nistappek lo achar shekkara lemaan yirbu yemechem eno chozer sheal hergel leshono hu holech:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 2:15-17: Haya kore ufaga baacherim o pagu bo acherim. im haya ben perek leferek posek umatchil veshoel shelom mi shehu chayyav bichvodo kegon sheppaga beaviv o rabbo o mi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma. umeshiv shalom lechol adam shennatan lo shalom:

Haya kore beemtza happarasha eno posek umatchil lishl ella bishlom mi shehu mityare mimmennu kegon melech o annas vechayyotze bahen. aval mi shehu chayyav bichvodo kegon aviv o rabbo im natan lo shalom techilla posek umeshiv lo shalom:

Veellu hen ben happerakim. ben beracha rishona lashsheniyya. ben sheniyya lishma. ben shema livhaya im shamoa. ben vehaya im shamoa levayyomer. ben happerakim haellu shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv shalom lechol adam. aval ben vayyomer leemet veyatztziv hare ze keemtza happerek velo yafsik ella lishl mippene hayyira ulehashiv mippene hakkavod:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 3:1-3: Hakore et shema rochetz yadav bammayim kodem sheyyikra. higgia zeman keriatah velo matza mayim kodem sheyyikra lo yeacher keriatah veyelech levakkesh mayim ella mekanneach yadav beafar o bitzror o bekora vechayyotze bahen vekore:

En korin lo bevet hammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse af al pi sheen bo tzoa velo bevet hakkevarot velo betzad hammet atzmo veim hirchik arba ammot min hakkever o min hammet muttar likrot. vechol mi shekkara bemakom sheen korin bo chozer vekore:

Bet hakkisse hechadash shehuchan vaadayin lo nishtammesh bo muttar likrot keriat shema lenegdo aval lo betocho. merchatz hechadash muttar likrot betocho. hayu shene battim zimmen echad mehem levet hakkisse veamar al hashsheni veze. hare hashsheni safek im hizmino lechach im lo. lefichach en korin bo lechattechilla veim kara yatza. amar gam ze hare shenehem mezummanin veen korin bahen. chatzar hammerchatz vehu hammakom shebbene adam omdin bo levushin muttar likrot bo keriat shema:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 3:4-5: Velo keriat shema bilvad ella kol inyan shehu middivre hakkodesh asur leamro bevet hammerchatz uvevet hakkisse vaafillu amaro bilshon chol. velo leamro bilvad ella afillu lehareher belibbo bedivre tora bevet hakkisse uvevet hammerchatz uvimkom hattinofet vehu hammakom sheyyesh bo tzoa ume raglayim asur:

Devarim shel chol muttar leamran bilshon kodesh bevet hakkisse. vechen hakkinnuyim kegon rachum vechannun veneeman vechayyotze bahen muttar leamran bevet hakkisse. aval hashshemot hameyuchadim vehen hashshemot sheenan nimchakin asur lehazekiran bevet hakkisse uvevet hammerchatz yashan. veim nizdammen lo lehaferish min davar haasur bevet hammerchatz o bevet hakkisse mafrish vaafillu bilshon kodesh uveinyene kodesh:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6:10-11: Ketzad. omer yisrael lenachri beshabbat laalot bailan o lashut al pene hammayim kede lehavi lo shofar. o sakkin lemila. o mevi lo mechatzer lechatzer sheen eruv benehen mayim chammin leharechitz bahem katan umitztaer. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hallokeach bayit beeretz yisrael min hannachri muttar lo lomar lannachri lichtov lo shetar beshabbat. sheamira lenachri beshabbat asura middivrehem umishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael lo gazru bedavar ze. vechen hallokeach bayit mehem besureya, shessureya keeretz yisrael ledavar ze:
Niddah 17a:17-19: Uvodkin mittotehen bemela parhava — mesayyay leh lishmuel, deamar shemuel: en bodkin et hammitta ella befakolin o betzemer naki verach. amar rav: hayeynu dechi havay hatam bearve shabbatot, havo amri: "man bae pakole benahama", vela yadana may kaamri.
Amar rava: hane shachake dechittana meallu livdika. ini? veha tana deve menashshe: en bodkin et hammitta lo beed edom, velo beed shachor, velo befishtan, ella befakolin o betzemer naki verach!
La kashya — ha bechittana, ha bemane dechittana. veibbaet ema: ha veha bemane dechittana — ha bechadte, ha beshachake.

Ateret tiferet seva bederech tzedaka timmatze

Proverbs 17:11-16: Pagosh dov shakkul beish veal-kesil beivvalto
Meshiv raa tachat tova lo[tamush] (tameysh) raa mibbeto
Poter mayim reshit madon velifne hitgalla hariv netosh
Matzdik rasha umarshia tzaddik toavat Adonai gam-shenehem
Lamma-ze mechir beyad-kesil liknot chochma velev-ayin
Proverbs 17:17-21: Bechol-et ohev harea veach letzara yivvaled
Adam chasar-lev tokea kaf orev arubba lifne reehu
Ohev pesha ohev matztza magbiah pitcho mevakkesh-shaver

Proverbs 17:2-5: Eved-maskil yimshol beven mevish uvetoch achim yachalok nachala
Matzref lakkesef vechur lazzahav uvochen libbot Adonai
Mera makshiv al-sefat-aven sheker mezin al-leshon havvot

Proverbs 17:6-10: Ateret zekenim bene vanim vetiferet banim avotam

Even-chen hashshochad beene vealav el-kol-asher yifne yaskil
Mechasse-pesha mevakkesh ahava veshone vedavar mafrid alluf
Techat geara vemevin mehakkot kesil mea
Shabbat 137b:2-9: Gemara amar rabbi avina amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav: basar hachofe et rov govhah shel atara.
Veim haya baal basar vechulei. amar shemuel: katan hamesurebal bevasar, roin oto, kol zeman shemmitkashshe venire mahul — eno tzarich lamul, veim lav — tzarich lamul.
Bematnita tana, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: katan hamesurebal bevasar, roin oto, kol zeman shemmitkashshe veeno nire mahul — tzarich lemulo, veim lav — eno tzarich lemulo.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu, nire veeno nire.

Mal velo para. tanu rabbanan, hammal omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammila". avi habben omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehacheniso bivrito shel avraham avinu". haomdim omrim: "keshem shennichnas labberit, kach yikkanes letora lechuppa ulemaasim tovim".

Vehamevarech omer: "asher kiddesh yadid mibbeten, chok bishero sam, vetzeetzaav chatam beot berit kodesh. al ken bischar zot el chay chelkenu [tzurenu], tzivva lehatztzil yedidut sheerenu mishshachat lemaan berito asher sam bivsarenu. baruch atta Adonai koret habberit".

Hammal et haggerim omer: "baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammila", vehamevarech omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lamul et haggerim ulehattif mehem dam berit, sheilmale dam berit lo nitkayyeymu shamayim vaaretz, shenneemar: 'im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. baruch atta Adonai koret habberit".

Hammal et haavadim omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammila", vehamevarech omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lamul et haavadim ulehattif mehem dam berit, sheilmale dam berit chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo nitkayyeymu, shenneemar: 'im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. baruch atta Adonai koret habberit".
Zohar, Terumah 10: Patach chad veamar, (Tehillim 113:2) haleluyah halelu avde Adonai halelu et shem Adonai. patach tinyayna veamar, yehi shem Adonai mevorach meatta vead olam. patach telitaa veamar, mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo mehullal shem Adonai. keden karoza kadim vekare itatadu kaddishe elyonin, innun dimshabbechan lemarehon, ittakkanu bishvacha dimama. keden itparshun yemama min lelya. zakkaa chulakeh, man dekam betzafra, miggo tushebachta deorayyta, delae belelya. behahu zimna tzelota detzafra.

Ketiv, (Yeshayahu 21:12) amar shomer ata voker vegam layla im tivayun beayu shuvu etayu, hay kera ukemuha leh, al galut deyisrael, deyatve go bene seir, veyisrael amre lekudesha berich hu, shomer, ma millayla, ma tehe alan min galuta da, dedamme lachashocha delelya. ma ketiv, amar shomer, da kudesha berich hu, ata voker, kevar nehirna lechu begaluta demitzrayim, veassikna lechu vekarivit yatchon lefulechani, veorayyta yahavit lechon, begin detizkun lechayye alma. shevaktun orayyti, vegam layla, ailna lechu begaluta (sefer acher devavel, veassikna lechu. shevaktun orayyti kemillekaddemin, ailna lechu begaluta) kemillekaddemin. im tivayun beayu kema deat amer, (yeshaya la) dirshu meal sefer Adonai ukerau, vetamman tishkechun bema talya galuta dilchon, ugeula dilchon, vechad tivayun bah, hi tema vetachriz kamayychu. shuvu etayu. shuvu bitshuva shelemata, umiyyad etayu veikrivu legabbay. (nusach acher uveraza dehay kera)

Uvehay kera ketiv, massa duma. veraza da, beshit dargin dinvua (bachamishsha archin) ittemar linvie. bemachaze. bachazon. bechizzayon. bechazut. bedavar. bemash. vechullehu chamishsha kullehu keman dechame batar kotala, hahu nehiru dinhora. uminnehon, keman dechame nehora deshimsha miggo ashashita. aval massa, have, kad mate hahu nehora betorach saggi veitrach milloy aloy, dela yachil leitgalyay leh, kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 11:11) lasum et massa kol haam hazze alay. ubbegin kach, massa.

Vehacha massa duma, torach saggia, dela yachil leitgalyay veihu nevua bilchishu, vekayyeyma bilchishu. elay kore misseir hacha la itgalya man amar elay kore misseir. i kudesha berich hu, i nevia mehemana. aval nevua da vadday kayyeyma bilchishu, go raza dimhemnuta illaa, umiggo raza setimaa, nevia mehemana amar, dilleh hava kara kala beraza dimhemnuta, veamar elay kore misseir. kema deat amer, (Devarim 33:2) vezarach misseir lamo. vela ketiv vezarach leseir, begin deraza dimhemnuta hachi ihu, dargin miggo dargin, illen penimain meillen, kelifa go kelifa, umocha go mocha.

Veha okimna, dichtiv, (yechezkel 1:4) vehinne ruach seara baa min hatztzafon, ha darga chad. anan gadol, ha darga achara. veesh mitlakkachat, ha darga telitaa. venoga lo saviv, ha darga reviaa. ulevatar umittochah keen hachashmal. ulevatar umittochah demut arba chayyot ha dargin go middargin (nusach acher dargin).

Uf hacha, kad itgalleyay kudesha berich hu leyisrael, la itgalleyay ella miggo dargin illen. missinay ba, darga dehava temira yattir, ulevatar itzterich leitgalya. veamar vezarach misseir, ha darga achara, deihu beitgalleyay yattir, kelifa desharya al gav mocha. ulevatar hofia mehar paran, ha darga achara. ulevatar veata merivvot kodesh, da shevacha decholla, deaf al gav deitgalyay mikkol illen dargin, mehahu atar dehu ikara decholla, share leitgallaa minneh. mean atar ihu. merivvot kodesh ihu, innun dargin illain leella, (leella) uf hacha elay kore misseir, mehahu darga dekaamaran, deitdabbak leella.

Shomer ma millayla shomer ma millel. shomer da metatron, (shomer yisrael) uchetiv, (Mishlei 27:18) veshomer adonav yechubbad, veda raza deshalta belelya. ma millayla shomer ma millel, ma ben hay lehay. ella, kolla chad, aval bechulaka da, shalta sitra achara. uvechulaka da, la shalta kelal. lel, itzterich lintura, dichtiv, (Shemot 12:42) lel (37 amud bet) shimmurim hu, veal da chaser Adonai, veda ihu kad al lelya, ad deitpelag. mippalgu lelya ulehala, shalta layla baAdonai dichtiv vayhi bachatzi hallayla. hu hallayla hazze. (Tehillim 139:12) velayla kayyom yair vegomer. uvegin kach, shomer ma millayla shomer ma millel.

Amar shomer. ashkachna besifra deadam, ma ben vayyomer leamar. vayyomer leella, veamar letatta, veel moshe amar. man (164 amud alef) amar, amar shomer, da metatron. ata boker, da tzelota deshacharit deihu shultanu dimama, hahu deshalit al lelya. vei tema deihu ate bilchodoy, veitperash dechar minnukeva, ha ketiv vegam layla, tarvavyyhu kachada, vela (7 amud alef) mitparshin da min da lealmin. vekala da kare bemillin illen, ata voker vegam layla tarvavyyhu zeminin legabbayychu.

Mikkan ulehala im tivayun beayu. im tivun bautechon bitzllo kamme malka kaddisha, beayu, tzallu uveu bautechon, vetuvu legabbe marechon. etayu, keman dezammin lekabbela livnoy, ulerachama alayyhu. uf hachi kudesha berich hu, boker vegam layla, kara veamar etayu. zakkaa amma kaddisha, demarehon bae alon, vekara lon lekarva lon legabbeh.

Keden amma kaddisha, baan leitchabbera, uleaala beve kenishta. vechol man deakdim bekadmita, itchabbar bishchinta bechibbura chada. ta chazi, hahu kadmaa deishtechach beve kenishta, (veorich beve kenishta) zakkaa chulakeh, deihu kayyeyma bedarga detzaddik bahade shechinta. veda ihu raza (Mishlei 8:17) umeshacharay yimtzaunni. da salik bisliku illaa. vei tema, ha tanenan beshaata dekudesha berich hu ate leve kenishta, vela ashkach tamman asra, miyyad koes. veat amart hahu chad deakdim, itchabbar bishchinta, vekayyeyma bedarga detzaddik.

Ella, (351 156 amud alef) lemalka deshadar lechol bene mata, deyishtakkechun immeh beyom pelan, bedoch pelan. ad dahavo mezammene garmayyhu innun bene mata, akdim chad veata lehahu atar. ben kach uven kach ata malka, ashkach lehahu bar nash deakdim tamman, amar leh, pelan beni mata an innun. amar leh, mari, ana akdimna minnayyhu, veha innun atan avatray lefikkuda demalka. keden, tav beene malka, veyativ tamman vahadeh, veishtae immeh, veitavid rechima demalka. ben kach uven kach, atu kol amma, veitpayays malka immehon, veshadar lon lishlam. aval i innun bene mata la atyayn, vechad la akdim leishtae kame malka, leitchazaa beginayyhu deha kullehu atyayn. miyyad kais veragiz malka.

Uf hacha, kevan dechad akdim, veishtechach beve kenishta, ushechinta atya veashkach leh, keden itchashiv keillu kullehu ishtechachu tamman. deha da orich lon tamman. miyad itchabbarat immeh shechinta, veyatve beziuuga chad, veishtemoda bahadeh, veotiv leh bedarga detzaddik. vei chad la akdim vela ishtechach tamman, ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 50:2) maddua bati veen ish. veen asara la ketiv, ella veen ish, leitchabbera bahaday, lemeheve gabbay, kema deat amer ish haelohim lemeheve bedarga detzaddik.

Velo od, ella deishtemoda bahadeh, veshail aloy, i yoma chad la ate, kema (balak 196 amud alef) deokimna, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:10) mi vachem yere Adonai shomea bekol avdo. veha ittearna behay dichtiv, elay kore misseir, deha darga batar darga, darga go darga, hahu shomer, kore bechela bechol yoma veyoma, veda ihu shomea bekol avdo, avdo, da metatron. uvegin kach, zakkaa ihu man deakdim leve kenishta, lesalleka behahu darga illaa dekamran.

Kad ate tzafra, vetzibbura ishtechachu beve kenishta, bau leishtakkecha beshirin vetushebchan dedavid. veha okimna, desiddura ihu leitara rechimu leella vetatta, leatkena tikkunin, uleitara chedva. deha begin da levae mitare leitara rechimu vechedva leella, beinnun shirin vetushebchan.

Uman demishtae beve kenishta bemillin dechol, vavy leh, deachaze piruda, vavy let degara mehemnuta. vavy leh delet leh chulaka beelaha deyisrael. deachaze deha let (leh) elaha, vela ishtechach tamman, (velet leh chulakeh beh) vela dachil minneh, veanhig kelana betikkuna (sefer acher batekaypaa) illaa dilella.

Deha beshaata deyisrael mesaddere beve kenishta, siddura deshirin vetushebchan vesiddura ditzlota, keden mitkanneshe telat mashreyayn demalache illae. mashiryayta chada, innun malachin kaddishin (illain) deka meshabbechan lekudesha berich hu bimama, begin deit acharanin deka meshabbechan lekudesha berich hu belelya. veacharanin (sefer acher veillen) innun deka meshabbechan lekudesha berich hu, veamrin shirin vetushebchan bahadayyhu deyisrael bimama.

Mashiryayta tinyayna, innun malachin kaddishin, demishtakkeche bechol kedusha ukedusha deyisrael, mekaddeshe letatta. uveshuletana dilhon, kol innun demitarin bechol innun rekiin, (sefer acher hechalin) behahi tzelota deyisrael (sefer acher dimyushav). mashiryayta telitaa innun (260 amud bet) ulemtan illain. deka mittakkene im matronita, umetakkene lah leaala lah kame malka, veillen innun mashreyayn ilain al kullehu.

(260 Amud bet) vechullehu mittakkene, besiddura deyisrael demitattekne letatta, beinnun shirin vetushebchan, uvehahi tzelota deka metzalu yisrael. kevan deillen telat mashreyayn mizdammenan, keden yisrael patche shirata, vezamre kame marehon. vehahi mashshiryayta chada, di memana leshabbecha lemarehon bimama, izdammenan alayyhu, vezamre immehon kachada, beinnun shevache dedavid malka, veha ukimna mille.

Behahu zimna dimsayyeyme yisrael shevache deinnun tushebchan dedavid, keden tushebachta deshirata deyamma, kema deokimna. vei tema, hay tushebachta amay ihi betikkuna batrayyta batar shevache dedavid, veha tora shebbichtav, akdimat letora shebbeal pe, veakdimat lanneviim, veakdimat lakketuvim, uchema deakdimat, hachi itzterich leakdema. (nusach acher beshirta)

Ella, miggo dekneset yisrael la ittaknat ella mittora shebbichtav, mishshum hachi itzterich lomar lah besheruta detikkunaha, vehay tushebachta mealleya, mikkol shear tushebchan dealma. veihi la ittaknat mikkullehu, kema deittaknat mittushebachta da. uvegin da, ihi samuch litzlota dimyyushav, kema deokimna.

Bah shaata kad shirata deyamma ittemar, mitattera keneset yisrael behahu kitra, dezammin kudesha berich hu leattera lemalka meshicha, vehahu (8 amud bet) kitra gelifa mechukkaka bishmahan kaddishin, kema deitattar kudesha berich hu hahu yoma deabaru yisrael yat yamma, veatba lechol mashreyayn defaro ufarashohi. begin da, bae bar nash leshavvava reuteh behay shirata. vechol man dezache lah behay alma, (60 amud alef) zache lemecheme lemalka meshicha betikkune hahu kitra, uvachagiru dezayyneh, vezakke leshabbecha hay shirata tamman, veha ukimna mille.

Kevan demate bar nash leyishtabbach natil kudesha berich hu hahu kitra, veshavve leh kameh, ukkeneset yisrael sheriat leittakna lemete kame malka illaa. veitzterich leachlala lah, betlesar mechilan derachame illae, deminnehon itbarchat. veinnun telesar busemin illain, kema deat amer, (Shir hashshirim 4:14) nerd vecharkom kane vekinnamon vegomer, vehacha innun, shir, ushevacha, hallel, vezimra, oz, umemshala, netzach, gedula, uggevura, tehilla, vetiferet, kedusha. ha teresar. ulevatar lechabbera lah bahadayyhu, velomar umalchut, vahavu telesar. begin deihi mitbarcha minnayyhu.

Veal da itzterich, beshaata deitkelilat benayyhu, leshavvava libba ureuta behay, vela lishtae kelal, dela lifsok benayyhu. vei pasik benayyhu, mittechot gadpe keruveyay nafik chad shalhova, vekare bechela veamar, pelanya di pasik geuta dekudesha berich hu, yishtetze veyitpessak, dela yechome gauta demalka kaddisha, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 26:10) uval yire geut Adonai, begin deillen telesar innun geut Adonai.

Mikkan ulehala el hahodaot kulei, da malka illaa dishlama kolla dileh, begin dechol hane shevachan innun legabbah dekneset yisrael kad mishtabbecha bemashshiryayta diltatta. kema deat amer shir hashshirim asher lishlomo, lemalka dishlama dileh, mittamman ulehala, (Yeshayahu 45:7) yotzer or uvore choshech ose shalom uvore et hakkol. veha ittearna beh, veattearu chavrayyay dehane innun tikkunin dealma illaa. (el adon).
31 Baruch: tikkune dealma tattaa, deinnun 22 atvavn zeirin, begin deit (Bereshit 3 amud bet) atvavn ravrevan, veatvavn zeirin. atvavn zeirin, mealma tattaa. atvavn ravrevan, mehahu alma deate.

Becholla innun ravrevan, innun ravrevan begarmayyhu. kad (lo) atyayn yechidain innun ravrevan (nusach acher dechar venukeba peshitan) dechad lo peshitan yattir, innun atyayn kol at veat birticha dechazze leh, kegon shevacha deshabbat deinnun atvavn deshevach, el adon al kol hammaasim, baruch umevorach befi kol neshama. illen atvavn bachamesh chamesh tevin, deinnun chamshin tarin dealma deate.

Teren atvavn acharanin di besofa: 700. innun beshit shit tevin, deinnun shit sitrin dealma deate, venafke mittamman. kegon: shevach yittenu lo kol tzeva marom. tiferet ugedulla serafim veofannim vechayyot hakkodesh.

Illen teren atvavn, beshit shit teren atvavn kadmae, bechamesh chamesh. kullehu shear atvavn di beemtzaita, kullehu bearba arba, begin deinnun beraza dirticha illaa, deinnun atvavn kadmae veinnun divsofa, innun shelimu dichv atvavn, begin deit behu 22 tevin, lokovel 22 atvavn illain. ishtaaru timnesar atvavn acharanin, deka salkin birtichayyhu learba arba, leshivin uteren tevin, deinnun raza dishma meforash, gelifa kaddisha dev atvavn, dekudesha berich hu mitattar behu. ushema da, ihu meattera likkeneset yisrael, vesalik beraza da, leitattera behu go shelichuta (demareh) dishchinta.

Vesimanicha deillen atvavn, deka mitatteran bishvacha illaa, da kadmae vesofe, desallekin beitterayyhu innun 401 302. alef bechamesh. tav beshit. bet bechamesh. shin beshit. begin kach raza det 302 kelala dechv atvavn, deinnun attara ditlatin uteren shevilin. (sefer acher dishma kaddisha).

Vesiman deinnun atvavn acharanin desallekin birtichayyhu, gar. share begimel, vesiyyem beresh, vechullehu raza dirticha kaddisha. 401 302, raza dishma kaddisha. 203, raza dirticha kaddisha, desalleka lev, veitavid minnayyhu shema kaddisha, leitattera keneset yisrael, miggo reticha illaa. (dichtiv, (Tehillim 48:11) chishmecha elohim ken tehillatecha)

Uvegin kach hahu shema dev kelila beraza daavahan, yemina usemala veemtzaita. veihi mitattera behu, lemehve shema kaddisha. velav shema illaa, keinnun shemahan illain, dealma illaa, deitachadan leella leella. veaf al gav dehay shema illaa ihu, aval raza dileh, david malka, demitattera baavahan.

Shema demv atvavn raza dileh avahan, deka (Vayikra 79 amud alef, 108, 256 amud bet) mitatteran bealma illaa. vealma illaa bema dilella. (sefer acher vesalleka raza leella leella, ad deitattera bain sof) veal da, salik vela nachit, itattar go machashava illaa. zakkaa chulaka deman deyada leh, veizdehar beh.

Shema dev atvavn, david deka (Bereshit 33 amud bet, 207 amud bet, 234 amud bet, Vayikra 150 amud bet) mitattera baavahan, veraza dileh salik venachit, kegavvna da 300, (300) shema ditlesar mechilin derachame. innun teresar, raza dirticha kaddisha, denafik mechad, desharya alayyhu uvegin kach (salik venachit, vechullehu sallekin venachtin bar hay shemma 46 desalik velo nachit veal da) shema dev salik venachit, salik missitra da, venachit missitra da. shema ditlesar mechilan, salik missitra da, venachit missitra da, vehahu denachit begin leamshacha tivu letatta. veal da, 401 302 203 104 95 86 77 68 59 50 50. atvavn kadmae sallekin bechushebana, veatvavn acharanin nachte bechushebana, begin leamshacha tivu dilella letatta.
Shema demv, ihu mitattera lirticha illaa. shema dev, ihu mitattera lirticha tattaa. zakkaa chulakeh man demishtaddel leminda lemareh, zakkaa ihu bealma den uvealma deate.

Uvegin kach, tushebachta deshabbat deka meshabbecha lemalka dishlama dileh. meshabbach leh bishma dev, 30 tevin, raza dechv atvavn, begin detitatter beh lesalleka leella betushebachta da. veal da, el adon, tushebachta dealma deate ihu, uferichu (sefer acher vaperaykav) dirticha kaddisha illaa, demitattera lesalleka leella, uferichu dichneset yisrael, demitattera lesalleka go reticha illaa.

401 302, Sallekin (261 amud alef) venachtin, kema deittemar. amar leh 42 sallekin vela nachtin, vesimanich, da shabbat bilchodoy. veda shabbat veyom hakkippurim, desalleka raza leella leella, ad demitattera kolla been sof.

El baruch, da siddura deatvavn zeirin, vetikkune keneset yisrael bechol yoma bitzlota. uvegin deinnun atvavn zeirin, let (205 amud bet) revavcha benayyhu, veinnun tikkuni ulematan deatyayn im matronita legabbe malka illaa.

Kedushsha da deka mekaddeshe malache illae, lav ihu beyachid. veha ukimna, kol kedusha deihu belashon hakkodesh, yachid asir leh lememar. targum, leolam beyachid, vela besaggiin, veyachid ihu tikkuna dileh vadday, vela saggiin. vesiman leraza da, shenayim mikra veechad targum. shenayim lishana desaggiin ihu, devadday kedusha delashon hakkodesh asir ihi (129) beyachid. kedushat targum asir ihu besaggiin, ella beyachid leolam. echad targum tanenan, vela teren vela yattir. targum atya lemiuta, vehachi itzterich. lashon hakkodesh atya lirvuyay, vehachi itzterich. demaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. uvetargum moridin velo maalin. echad taninan, vela yattir, vela maalin kelal.

Kedushsha da, kedushata deitkaddeshat shechinta, vechol innun retichin dilah, leittakkena legabbe malka illaa. uvegin deihi kedushat alma tattaa, ihi meyushav vela baamida. kedusha achara deahadure tzelota, ihi kedushata dealma illaa, uvegin kach ihi baamida, begin leamshacha lah letatta, vechol milloy dealma illaa, ihu baamida vela meyushav.

Uvechol hane kedushete, yisrael mitkaddeshe behu letatta. veal da yisrael mitkaddeshe bikdusha dirticha tattaa meyushav. uvikdushsha dirticha illaa meumad. kedusha achara, ihi (261 amud bet) tosefet kedusha, begine kach ihi batar tzelota. uvegin deihi tosefet kedusha, al kedushan acharanin, ihi levatar tzelota. uvegin dechol chad vechad bae leamshacha aleh mehahu tosefet, ittakkan lechol yachid veyachid kedushat targum.

Vei tema ha it bah kedushat lashon hakkodesh. hahu latztzibbur, leitkaddesha kullehu bichlal, behahu tosefet kedusha. uvegin deyachid let leh reshut, leomrah belashon hakkodesh, uleitkaddesha yechiday, atkinu lah belashon targum, veihu beyachid, leitkaddesha kol chad vechad behahu tosefet, leamshacha aleh kedusha yattir. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, deka mitkaddeshe bekiddushe illae, begin deinnun devekin leella, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kulchem hayyom.
Zohar, Terumah 11: Ketiv (Melachim b 4:9-10) hinne na yadati ki ish elohim kadosh hu over vegomer, uchetiv naase na aliyyat kir ketanna vegomer, behay kera it lan semach bealma lesiddura ditzlota. hinne na yadati, da ihu reuta deitzterich bar nash leshavvaa begavvih bitzlota. ki ish elohim kadosh hu, da ihu alma illaa, deihu yativ al kurese yekareh, vechol kiddushan nafkin minneh, veihu mekaddesh lechullehu almin. over alenu tamid, mehahu kedusha deihu mekaddesh lechol almin leella, ihu mekaddesh lan behay alma. deha let kedusha leella, ella i it kedushsha letatta, kema deat amer (Vayikra 22:32) venikdashti betoch bene yisrael.

Vehoil vechach hu, naase na aliyyat kir ketanna, da ihu siddura detikkuna (vaychi 228 amud bet) dishchinta, deihi aliyyat kir, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 38:2) vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir. ketanna: begin deihi zeera, kema deat amer (Kohelet 9:14) ir ketanna. venasim lo sham betikkuna da deanan metakkenin, uvesiddura dilan beshirin vetushebachan uvitzlota, (uvetikkuna da) anan metakkenin legabbeh, lenayycha dileh. mitta veshulchan vechisse umenora. arba illen, kullehu bishchinta innun. veihi (kolla) bechol tikkunin illen mittakkenan, legabbe alma illaa besiddura deanan mesadderin.

Besiddura ditzlota dearvit, uvetikkuna dileh, ha mitta. besiddura deinnun karbanin veillavavn, deanan mesadderin betzafra veinnun shirin vetushebchan, ha shulchan. uvehahu siddura ditzlota dimyyushav, uvetikkuna dikriat shema, behahu yichuda deanan metakkenin ha kisse. behahu siddura ditzlota dimumad, uveinnun kedushan, vetosefet kedusha, uvirkan, deanan mesadderin (la) ha menora.

Zakkaa ihu bar nash, deda shavve biruteh, leashlama legabbe mareh bechol yoma, uleatkena hay aliyyat kir ketanna, legabbe mareh behane tikkunin. keden vadday kudesha berich hu yehe ushepizeh bechol yoma. zakkaa ihu behay alma, vezakkaa ihu bealma deate. begin deillen arba, innun tikkune dishchinta, leittakna legabbe balah. bearba tikkunin illen, ittaknat bishfiraha, bechedvavha, bechezvavha, al yede deamma kaddisha bechol yoma.

Mitta ityehivat leh leyaakov leittakkena, veal da yaakov atkin tzelota dearvit. shulchan atkin david malka, beinun shirin vetushebchan deihu atkin, kema deat amer (Tehillim 23:5) taaroch lefanay shulchan neged tzorray. kisse atkin avraham, beitkashsheruta dileh, deavid tivu ushelimu denishmatin lechol bene alma, velet tikkuna dechisse, ella bechesed deavraham, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 16:5) vehuchan bachesed kisse.

Menora atkin yitzchak, deakdish shema dekudesha berich hu leenehon dechol alma, venahir nehiru devutzina illaa behahi kedusha. begine kach, tzerichin amma kaddisha, lomar tadir uleshavvaa reutehon, lesaddera legabbe alma illaa, deihu mareh deveta, ish haelohim, mitta veshulchan vechisse umenora, lemeheve shelimu bechol yoma, ella vetatta.
Zohar, Terumah 79: Patach hahu ravya bevirkat mezona veamar, katuv echad omer (Devarim 14:23) veachalta lifni Adonai elohecha, vechatuv echad omer (Devarim 27:7) vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha. hane kerae kad yisrael havo sharan beara kaddisha, veitchazun kamme kudesha berich hu beve makdesha, havo mitkayyeymme. hashsheta hech mitkayyeymme, man yachil lemechal lifne Adonai ulemechede lifne Adonai.

Ella vadday hachi hu, bekadmita kad yativ bar nash al patoreh lemechal, mevarech al nahama hammotzi. may taama hammotzi, vela motzi, deha ketiv (Yeshayahu 42:5) bore hashshamayim, vela ketiv habbore. (Yirmeyahu 10:12) ose eretz, vela ketiv haose eretz. may taama hacha hammotzi.

Ella kol millin deinnun meraza dealma illaa setira, istattera Adonai mittamman, leitchazaa deha mealma geniza usetira ihu. vechol millin deinnun mealma tattaa deitgalya yattir, ketiv baAdonai, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) hammotzi bemispar tzevaam (Amos Adonai:8) hakkore leme hayyam, kullehu meraza dealma tattaa ihu, vei (231 amud bet) achtiv bishma ihu baAdonai, kegon hael haggadol, vehacha deihu beorach satim (nusach acher beitgalleya) meraza dealma tattaa ihu, kevan dimvarech bar nash, shechinta atya kameh.

Uma deamar veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha. hacha itkelil lemallela bemille deorayyta, dehachi itzterich hoil vekudesha berich hu kameh, lekayyeyma dichtiv, (yechezkel 41:22) ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai. uchetiv (Devarim 14:26) veachalta sham lifne Adonai elohecha.

Hoil vekaim bar nash kame mareh, itzterich name lemechan lemiskene, lemetan lon, kema deihu yahiv leh lemechal. (sefer acher uman deachil kammeh malka kaddisha itzterich vechulei) keman deachil kame malka kaddisha veitzterich dela yishtechach balan al patoreh, deha bilanu missitra achara have, veraza da (Bereshit 25:30) haleiteni na, orach balanu, vehachi itzterich lesitra achara, uchetiv (Mishlei 13:25) uveten reshaim techsar. veal da veachalta lifni Adonai elohecha ketiv, vela lifne sitra achara. veitzterich dela yitassek bemillin betelin, uvetzarche seuda (shappir) veitzterich leitasseka bemillin deorayyta, deha kad millin deorayyta ittemaru al patora, yahiv hahu bar nash tukpa lemareh.

Vesamachta lifni Adonai elohecha, da ihu bechos shel beracha, kad barich bar nash bechos shel beracha, itzterich lemechode uleachazaa chedva vela atzivu kelal, kevan denatil bar nash kos shel beracha, kudesha berich hu kaim al gabbeh, veihu itzterich leatafa resheh bechedva. ulevarcha al hakkos bemotav telata, nevarech sheachalnu mishelo.

Uvetuvo chayyinu, da itzterich reuta leella legabbe attika deattikin, veal da ihi beorach satim. uvetuvo, vela mittuvo, uvetuvo: da yemina (davar acher zaynah) illaa. umittuvo: da darga achara, deate missitra dimina, veihu darga letatta minneh, begin divhahu tov itbeni alma, uveh ittezan.

Amay ikre tov vaamay ikre chesed. tov ihu, kad kalil kolla begavveh, vela itpashat lenachta letatta. chesed kad nachta letatta. veavid tivu bechol biryayn, betzaddike uverashie vela chayish, veaf al gav dedarga chad hu. menalan dichtiv, (Tehillim 23:6) ach tov vechesed yirdefuni, i tov lamma chesed, vei chesed lamma tov, deha bechad sagya ella tov kalil kolla begavveh, vela itpashat letatta. chesed nachit (109 amud alef) veitpashshat letatta, vezan kolla tzaddike verashie kachada.

Vehacha kevan deamar uvetuvo chayyinu, hadar veamar hazzan et haolam kullo betuvo bechesed, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 136:25) noten lechem lechol basar ki leolam chasdo. veal da hazzan et hakkol, letztzadike ulerashie lecholla. da ikre birkat yamin. semol lav ihu bevirkat mezona. uvegin kach semala la tesayyea limina.

Dechevan devarich birkat yamin (nusach acher hayyayin), itzterich ledabbeka eretz hachayyim bayyamin, leittezana mittamman, ulefarnasa ulemehav mezona lecholla, veal da tinyayna birkat haaretz, veitzterich leadkera bah berit vetora, al beritcha shechatamta bivsarenu, veal toratcha shelimadtanu, leachazaa demehahu tov ittezan berit vetora, deihu tikkuna dehay tov.

Mikkan olifna, denashim peturot mibbirkat mezona leappaka yede chova, deha let behu tora uverit. velachatom al haaretz veal hammazon, ha didvekuta kachada bechesed, al haaretz da ihi eretz hachayyim. veal hammazon da ihu chesed, ha kelilu da beda bidvekuta chada.

Itpashshetuta detov ihu hodaa deikre chesed, veal da ihu omer, node lecha, al kach veal kach nissin veatin deitaviddu missitra detov. vei tema veha ketiv (Tehillim 16:11) neimot bimincha, netzach, ha ihu missitra deyamin. lav hachi, ella kol chad vechad achze al hahu atar denafik minneh.

Vei tema netzach bayyamin, ha ketiv neimot, uchetiv (Shmuel b 23:1) uneim zemirot yisrael, (Bereshit 21 amud bet) (davar acher bimincha netzach) veda semala. vechol semala itkelil beraza dimina. aval hodaa ode al yemina, leachazaa deha minneh nafka, veda peshitu detov, deitpashshat beeretz hachayyim.

May tama let hacha semala, begin delet chulaka lesitra achara bimzona deyisrael. vei ittear semala, sitra achara yittear immeh, veha ihu zabbin becheruteh vechulakeh leyaakov avuna. (Vayikra 21 amud alef) veha anan yahivna leh chulakeh, lehahu mekatrega bezuhama demayin batrain, vei let zuhama, ha chulakeh dehahu mechla, dekarivu beh yedin.

Veal da let leh chulaka bahadan. vehoil velet leh chulaka bahadan, deha natal chulakeh, let lan leitteara semala kelal. dela yittear mekatrega veyittol teren chulakin, chad letatta, vechad leella, kabbechor. deha zabbin becheruteh leyaakov avuna. chulakeh ihu letatta, velet leh leella kelum. yisrael natle leella, veesav natil letatta, veal da la yitkerav semala kelal, bevirkat mezona.

Kevan demitbarcha hay eretz hachayyim missitra dimina, umekabbel mezona, keden baenan rachamin al kolla. rachem Adonai elohenu al yisrael amach veal yerushalayim irach vegomer, deha mehahu mezona vesippuka deeretz hachayyim, nizke bah anan uve makdesha. deyitbene be makdesha letatta beinnun rachamim.

Uveshabbat dela ishtechach dina, lemeheve netzach vehod kelal chasadim, omer retze vehachalitzenu lemeheve (vaychi 219 amud alef) tarvayyhu, (Yeshayahu 55:3) chasde david hanneemanim, veal da al tehi tzara veyagon vechulei, deha retze umodim, innun chasde david, vesim shalom dekaamaran bitzlota, bevirkat ose shalom bimromav hu berachamav yaase shalom alenu.

Hattov vehammetiv, decholla ate missitra dimina, vela mistar semala kelum. man dimvarech birkat mezona, ihu natil birchan bekadmita mekullehu, veitberach bichlal birkat mezona, veal da it leh arka dechayyin. man denatil kos shel beracha, veka mevarech aleh, ketiv (Tehillim 116:13) kos (Bereshit 1 amud alef, 223 amud alef) yeshuot esa. man yeshuot da yemina, deihu moshia mikkol mekatregin dealma, dichtiv (nusach acher hoshia lo yemino) vattosha lo yemino, uchetiv (Tehillim 60:7) hoshia yemincha vaaneni.

Adhachi hava nahir yemama, kamu kullehu uneshakuhu. amar ribbi yosi, vadday hilula ihu yoma da, vela nefuk mehacha, ad deyitavid hilula bechol anshe mata, da hu hilula dekudesha berich hu itree beh. natlu lah leinteteh, uvarichu lah bechamma birchan, avdu daavuha yetakken beta achara lechedva, kenishu kol anshe mata lehahi chedvata, vekaru lah kalla. vechaddu immehon kol hahu yoma, veihu chadde immehon bemille deorayyta.
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

rashi: Battim labberichim. hattabbaot shettaase bahen yihyu battim likkanes bahen habberichim:

Vetzippita et habberichim zahav. lo shehaya hazzahav medubbak al habberichim – sheen alehem shum tzippuy – ella vakkeresh haya kovea kemin shete pifiyyot shel zahav, kemin shene sidke kane chalul, vekovan etzel hattabbaat lechan ulechan, arkan memalle et rochav hakkeresh min hattabbaat lechan umimmenna lechan, vehabberiach nichnas letocho umimmennu lattabbaat umin hattabbaat lappe hashsheni, nimtzeu habberichim metzuppim zahav keshehen techuvin bakkerashim; vehabberichim hallalu mibbachutz hayu boltot, hattabbaot vehappifiyyot lo hayu nirot betoch hammishkan, ella kol hakkotel chalak mibbifnim:

Kikkar zahav tahor. shello yihye mishkalah im kol keleha ella kikkar, lo pachot velo yoter (menachot 88). vehakkikkar shel chol shishshim mane, veshel kodesh haya kaful, 120 mane, vehammane hu litra sheshshoklin bah kesef lemishkal kolonya, vehem mea zehuvim – esrim vachamishsha selaim vehassela arbaa zehuvim:
ohc: Kikkar zahav vegomer. beferek 2 middot (menachot pach,1) tanya: "kikkar zahav tahor" vegomer, lamadnu lammenora shebbaa min hakkikkar, minnayin lerabbot neroteha? talmud lomar "et kol hakkelim". yachol sheani merabbe af malkacheha? talmud lomar "otah".

Velaamod al amittatan shel devarim, naskil ladaat ma haya chaser li bidiat mitzvat hammenora shealav hutzrach lomar pasuk ze. vaere ki belo pasuk ze lo hayiti yodea shiur zahav hammenora im kikkar im chetzyo, laze ba vehodia hakkatuv hashshiur dechikkar zahav tahor taase. veachar shehodia shiur hammenora az nichnasnu besafek im hannerot bichlal hashshiur o lo. vetaam shello nichnas ella bisfek hannerot velo bisfek hammelkachayim vehammachtot, mippene shehammelkachayim vehammachtot beer hakkatuv veamar "zahav tahor", veim hem mishshiur harashum bammenora lo haya tzarich lomar bahem zahav tahor, ma sheen ken hannerot shello hizkir bahem zahav nisharu besafek im hem mehakkikkar. veen lomar ki mimma shello amar zahav tahor shema minnah shehem mehakkikkar, mishshum sheyyesh lomar ki lo hikpid Adonai alehem sheyyihyu o min hazzahav o min shear hammattachot letzad sheomdim letashmish uleolam enam mehakkikkar. laze amar hakkatuv veet kol keleha, hare berer sefekan shehayinu mistappekin bannerot veamar shehem mehakkikkar, aval melkachayim umachtot en li safek bahem mimma shehutzrach lomar bahem zahav tahor vadday sheenam mehakkikkar. umeatta lo chash alay hakkatuv litot bemaamar "et kol keleha" shennichnas gam melkachayim umachtot.

Im ken kashe, lamma amar hakkatuv tevat "otah" lemaet? im lemaet melkachayim umachtot hare en tzarich miut. venire lomar, behair od bakkatuv, achar haemet sheen bichlal hakkikkar hammelkachayim vehammachtot, lamma sidder mitzvat kikkar zahav tahor achar shehizkir melkachayim umachtot, shemmizze yechuyyav hassechel lomar sheggam alehem chozer haddibbur? sheim lo chen haya lo lehakedim lomar "kikkar zahav tahor vegomer veet kol keleha", veachar kach yetzav Adonai "malkacheha umachtoteha", veaz al kol panim lo haya tzarich lomar tevat "otah" lemaet malkacheha umachtoteha, ki memuatim hem kevan shello huzkeru ella achar amro "kikkar zahav" vegomer:

Achen hinne haadon baruch hu noten hattora bachar lomar pasuk umalkacheha vegomer kodem amro kikkar zahav vegomer lishte sibbot. haechad letzad shehu omer uree vaase vetavnitam asher atta mare bahar (Shemot 25:40), laze samach pasuk ze lemaamar hammenora vecheleha shehem neroteha, veim haya mesadder pasuk ze "kikkar zahav" vegomer kodem "umalkacheha" haya nishma shechozrim haddevarim gam alehem, velo chen hu, ki efshar shello herahu Adonai tavnit hammelkachayim vehammachtot bahar.

Vesibba sheniyya, lismoch melkachayim lenerot – lomar keshem shehammelkachayim naasu bifne atzmam, gam hannerot domot lahem bifrat ze shemmaasehem bifne atzman, hagam shehem mehakkikkar lo mippene ze titchayyev lomar shehayu miksha kakkaftorim ugeviim vegomer. vahagam shepperashti lemala ki mimma shello hizkir hannerot im shear happeratim shehizkir bemiksha shema minnah ki enam bichlal, veim ken lo haya tzarich laremez hannizkar, im kol ze kevan sheamar hakkatuv "kikkar zahav tahor vegomer et kol hakkelim" (Shemot 25:39), hare hishva otam lammenora, vetavo hassevara lomar ki gam laze nitkavven hakkatuv lechallam sheyyihyu bemiksha, ki lo matzinu perat mipperate hammenora shehu mehakkikkar veeno mehammiksha, laze ba hakkatuv vehismich inyan hammelkachayim vehammachtot lannerot lomar kannizkar.
