Vehinne achar shehaya tzorech baddavar lichtov pasuk "kikkar zahav" vegomer achar pasuk "umalkacheha" vegomer latteamim hannizkarim, chash hakkatuv shello yaskil maskil al davar ki zot hi kavvanato yitbarach, veyomar ha vadday shello dibber keseder ze ella lehachenis hammelkachayim vehammachtot beshiur hakkikkar, veyidchok lomar taam amro "zahav tahor" leezo derasha, kemo shettomar leakkev bahem, hagam shehammenora amar bah hakkatuv ribbuy "tease hammenora", mikkol makom afillu mishshear mattachot beellu tzerichin lihyot zahav tahor. asher al karcho nitchakkem Adonai veamar tevat otah lemaet malkacheha umachtoteha sheenam mehakkikkar, vehodaat hannerot shehem mehakkikkar meamro et kol hakkelim bimkomah omedet. umeatta nachazik lomar shettaam shessidder pasuk umalkacheha vegomer kodem pasuk kikkar zahav vegomer shehu lassibbot shekkatavnu, velaze darash hattanna tevat "otah" lemaet malkacheha umachtoteha, veet kol hakkelim" lerabbot hannerot. veamar kol lomar sheafillu ner echad en laasoto ella mehakkikkar. ulederech ze hirvachti amro et kol hakkelim velo amar "veet" lomar "otah et" vegomer, "et kol" vegomer "veotah", vehaven.

Kaftorehem ukenotam mimmenna yihyu. behakkometz rabba (menachot koach,1) tenan: shiva kene menora meakkevin ze et ze, shiva neroteha meakkevin ze et ze. may tama? "havaya" ketiv behu, ad kan. vekashe, vahalo lo neemar "havaya" ella bakkanim velo bannerot, ki shete havayot neemru bammenora: achat befasuk ze veachat befasuk rishon "veasita menorat vegomer yerechah vekanah gevieha kaftoreha uferacheha mimmenna yihyu", mashma sheeno meakkev ella shiva kanim ugevieha kaftoreha uferacheha. vahagam shebbammishna lo hizkir ella hakkanim vehannerot, katvu hattosafot shehu haddin, velo hizkiram hattanna letzad sheenam bimnorot shel mattachot, vechen katav rambam perek 3 mehilchot bet habbechira, yeuyyan sham. aval hannerot lo hizkir bahem hahavaya, vehinne yesh machloket ben rabbotenu zichronam livracha (menachot pach,2) im hannerot kevuim o lo, velo mibbaya lehaomer shello hayu kevuim shehem kelim bifne atzman velo matzinu bahem havaya, ella afillu leman deamar kevuim hare mode hu sheenam miksha immah, shello nechleku rabbotenu zichronam livracha beferek 2 middot (menachot pach,2) ella im hayta mehakkikkar o levad mehakkikkar, aval sheenam miksha mimmenna allibba dechulle alma lo. vechen dikdek hakkatuv beamro "miksha yerechah vekanah gevieha kaftoreha uferacheha", veillu neroteha lo amar, veachar sheamar mishpete ferate hammenora beorech amar sheyyaasu et neroteha, hare ze mare baetzba shechalukim hem mehammenora. veod dikdek hakkatuv lomar mimmenna yihyu, lomar otam shehem mimmenna alehem ani matne havaya.

Veulay ki kevan shennitgalla taam shiva kanim shehem lasum bahem nerot, im ken kesheen ner hare hakkane batel ucheillu eno vehu meakkev. veulay ki lo amar hashshas behakkometz rabba (menachot koach,1) may tama ella al hakkanim, aval hannerot eno tzarich ki ze taluy baze.

rashi: Veasu li mikdash. veasu lishmi bet kedushsha:
ohc: Veasu li mikdash vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kerao mikdash, vetechef chazar bo ukerao mishkan, dichtiv et tavnit hammishkan.

Venire ki amro veasu li mikdash hi mitzvat ase kolelet kol hazzemannim, ben bammidbar ben bichnisatan laaretz bechol zeman sheyyihyu yisrael sham ledorot. utzerichin hayu yisrael laasot ken afillu baggaluyyot, ella shemmatzinu sheasar Adonai kol hammekomot meet shennivna bet hammikdash, keamro (Devarim 12:9) "ki lo vatem ad atta el hammenucha veel hannachala". velaze lo amar "veasu mishkan" sheyyihye nishma sheal oto zeman levad neemra mitzva zo. veachar shetztzivva derech kelal, amar perat hannaase bammidbar sheeno makom livnot bo binyan avanim, sheyyaase mishkan kasseder haamur. vetimtza shekkatav rambam beferek 1 mehilchot bet habbechira: mitzvat ase laasot bayit laAdonai dichtiv "veasu li mikdash", ad kan, vetamo hu mishshinnuy hallashon kemo shekkatavnu. od yirtze beamro veasu li mikdash ki meet sheosim oto lishmo yitbarach, keamro "li", hagam sheadayin lo sharta bo shechina, hare hu mikdash vedin kodesh yesh lo.

Veshachanti betocham. velo amar "betocho", lomar shehammakom asher yakdishu leshachno yihye betoch bene yisrael sheyyakkifu hammishkan bearbaa degalim. veulay ki devarim ellu hem teshuva lema shechashku yisrael (Bamidbar Rabba 2,5) birotam behar sinay shehaya baruch hu mukkaf bedigle hammalachim vehu ot betocham, vechishko ahav lihyot ken betocham, velaze baa hatteshuva mibbochen levavot veamar veasu li mikdash veshachanti kemo chen betocham.

rashi: Zahav vachesef unechoshet vegomer. kullam bau vindava – ish ish ma shennedavo libbo – chutz min hakkesef shebba beshave, machatzit hashshekel lechol echad, velo matzinu vechol melechet hammishkan shehutzrach sham kesef yoter, shenneemar vechesef pekude haeda vegomer beka laggulgolet vegomer, ushear hakkesef habba sham bindava asauhu lichle sharet:
ohc: Vezot hatteruma vegomer. taam amro vezot vegomer, ulay sheyyechavven lomar shello yaviu yisrael nedava mimmin echad o mishshelosha, ella tzerichin lehavi mikkol hamminim, veenam yotzim yede chovat terumat hammishkan ella bahavaatam mikkol hamminim, vehu amro "vezot", lomar millevad chiyyuv hahavaa od ani metzavve shettihye hatteruma mimminim ellu kullam. vehattaam ki en hachanat hammishkan mushlemet bechissaron echad mehamminim. veen hakkavvana ki chol ish veish miyyisrael yavi mikkullan, ella shebbichlalut terumat kol yisrael yihyu kol hamminim. o yirtze lomar sheyyekabbelu mehammeviim kol hashshelosha asar minim, velo yezalzel bammevi pishtan veorot vechulei:

rashi: Vesamta et hashshulchan. shulchan batztzafon, mashuch min hakkotel hatztzefoni shete ammot umechetza, umenora vaddarom, meshucha min hakkotel hadderomi shete ammot umechetza, umizbach hazzahav natun keneged avir shebben shulchan lammenora mashuch kima kelappe hammizrach, vechullam netunim min chatzi hammishkan velifnim; ketzad? orech hammishkan min happetach lapparochet esrim amma, hammizbeach vehashshulchan vehammenora meshuchim min happetach letzad maarav eser ammot (yoma 33):

Makbilot hallulaot ishsha el achotah. shemor shettaase hallulaot bemidda achat, mechuvvenet havedalatan zo mizzo, uchemiddatan biria zo ken yehe bachavertah, shekkeshettifros choveret etzel choveret yihyu hallulaot shel yeria zo mechuvvanot keneged lulaot shel zo, vezehu leshon makbilot – zo keneged zo, targumo shel neged lokovel. hayeriot arkan 28 verachban arba, ucheshechibber chamesh yeriot yachad nimtza rachban esrim, vechen hachoveret hashshenit, vehammishkan arko sheloshim min hammizrach lammaarav, shenne esrim kerashim lifat negev temana, vechen latztzafon, vechol keresh amma vachatzi haamma, hare sheloshim min hammizrach lammaarav, rochav hammishkan min hatztzafon laddarom eser ammot, shenneemar uleyarkete hammishkan yamma vegomer ushene kerashim limkutzot hare eser – uvimkomam afarshem lammikraot hallalu – noten hayeriot arkan lerachbo shel mishkan, eser ammot emtzaiyyot legag chalal rochav hammishkan, veamma mikkan veamma mikkan leovi rashe hakkerashim sheavyam amma, nishtayyeru 16 amma, 8 latzafon vech ladarom, mechassot komat hakkerashim sheggavhan eser, nimtzeu shete ammot hattachtonot megullot; rachban shel yeriot arbaim amma keshehen mechubbarot, esrim amma lechoveret. sheloshim mehen legag chalal hammishkan learko, veamma cheneged ovi rashe hakkerashim shebbammaarav, veamma lechassot ovi haammudim shebbammizrach – shello hayu kerashim bammizrach, ella chamishsha ammudim shehammasach parus vetaluy bavvavin shebbahen kemin vilon – nishtayyeru shemone ammot hatteluyin al achore hammishkan shebbammaarav, ushete ammot hattachtonot megullot, zo matzati bevarayta dearbaim vetesha middot. aval bemassechet shabbat en hayeriot mechassot et ammude hammizrach, vetesha ammot teluyot achore hammishkan, vehakkatuv befarasha zo mesayyeenu, venatatta et happarochet "tachat" hakkerasim, veim kedivre habbarayta hazzot, nimtzet parochet meshucha min hakkerasim velammaarav amma:

Veserach haodef biriot haohel. al yeriot hammishkan; yeriot haohel hen haelyonot shel izzim, shekkeruyim ohel, kemo shenneemar bahem leohel al hammishkan, vechol ohel haamur bahen eno ella leshon gag, shemmaahilot umesakkechot al hattachtonot, vehen hayu odfot al hattachtonot chatzi hayeria lammaarav, shehachetzi shel yeria achat esre hayetera haya nichpal el mul pene haohel, nisharu shete ammot rochav chetzyah odef al rochav hattachtonot:
Tisrach al achore hammishkan. lechassot shete ammot shehayu megullot bakkerashim:
Achore hammishkan. hu tzad maaravi, lefi shehappetach bammizrach shehen panav, vetzafon vedarom keruyin tzedadin layyamin velassemol:

Vehayu shemona kerashim. hen haamurot lemala taase shishsha kerashim ushene kerashim taase limkutzot, nimtzeu shemona kerashim beseder maaravi; kach shenuya bammishna maase seder hakkerashim bimlechet hammishkan; haya ose et haadanim chalulim vechoretz et hakkeresh millematta revia mikkan urevia mikkan, vehecharitz chetzyo baemtza, veasa lo shete yadot kemin shene chamukin – veli nire shehaggirsa kemin shene chavakin, kemin shene shelivot sullam hammuvdalot zo mizzo, umeshuppot likkanes bachalal haeden kishliva hannichneset benekev ammud hassullam, vehu leshon meshullavot, asuyot kemin sheliva – umachnisan letoch shene adanim, shenneemar shene adanim shene adanim, vechoretz et hakkeresh milmala etzba mikkan veetzba mikkan, venotnan letoch tabbaat achat shel zahav kede shello yihyu nifradin ze mizze, shenneemar veyihyu toamim millematta vegomer, kach hi hammishna, vehapperush shellah hitztzati lemala beseder hammikraot:
Karse zahav. payrameylesh belaaz, umachnisin roshan echad ballulaot shebbechoveret zo veroshan echad ballulaot shebbechoveret zo umechabberan bahen:

Veel haaron titten et haedut. lo yadati lamma nichpal, shehare kevar neemar venatatta el haaron et haedut, veyesh lomar, shebba lelammed shebbeodo aron levaddo, belo chapporet, yitten techilla haedut letocho veachar kach yitten et hakkapporet alav, vechen matzinu keshehekim et hammishkan, neemar vayyitten et haedut el haaron veachar kach vayyitten et hakkapporet al haaron milmala:
ohc: Venatatta et hakkapporet vegomer veel haaron titten vegomer. kashe lamma hutzrach lomar paam sheniyya veel haaron titten achar shekkevar amar lemala "venatatta et haedut" vegomer? verashi zichrono livracha yishshev sheyyirtze lomar sheyyitten techilla haedut veachar kach yitten hakkapporet alav ad kan. mashma middevarav shehaya makom litot sheyyitten haedut al haaron, veen dati nocha lomar sheyyesh makom litot baze, uma gam sheen makom sham ki hu mekom hakkeruvim, veod haya lo lomar befasuk rishon bimkom tevat "el" – "toch" velo haya tzarich lichtov paam sheniyya "veel haaron". veyesh od lehakeshot baze. verabbi eliyyahu mizrachi zichrono livracha katav baze devarim sheenam lefi rum chachmato. ureitiv sheratza lehistayyea ledivre Rashi middivre raava, uvimchila mikkevodo divre rabbi avraham ibben ezra hem shebba letakken hammashmaut shello yikshe lecha bappasuk shehikdim netinat hakkapporet kodem netinat haedut, umin harauy lehakedim netinat haedut, laze amar "uchevar" vechulei – lo lefaresh shekkol hakkatuv ba lomar shello yitten haedut lemala mehakkapporet, shezze adrabba muvan mippasuk rishon vehattaut adrabba mippasuk sheni.

Vehannachon beenay lomar, ki kavvanat hakkatuv hi lerabbot bo netina, lomar sheachar sheyyitten hakkapporet al haaron lo yetzu mimmennu od ledorot olam, kemishpat sefer tora asher tzivva lasum mitztzad vechulei, veamru zichronam livracha (Devarim Rabba 9,9) shemmishpato sheim yihye hefresh ben shevet leshevet besifrehem shekkatvu kol shevet sefer tora echad, yevarru hassefer missefer hammunach bet Adonai, veamar ki haedut sham yihyu leval yetzu od. velaze ribba bo netina achar netina, uletaam ze gam ken anu marvichim lamma hikdim netinat hakkapporet lintinat haedut, ki lo ba ella lomar sheachar shennetanum baaron vechissa bakkapporet netunim netunim yihyu shamma ad olam, vehaven.
Od yirtze, ki lo yanniach haedut baaron ad sheyyihye haaron shalem bechapporet halom velo kodem, veze amro venatatta et hakkapporet vegomer, az el haaron titten et haedut.

Od efshar lomar al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (bava batra yad:) shehalluchot veshivre luchot munnachim baaron, laze amar shete peamim, achat keneged halluchot hashshelemim vehashsheniyya keneged hashshevurim.

Uvederech remez nire, ki va lirmoz lo shehagam shehakkapporet lemala min haedut shehem betoch haaron lematta mehakkapporet, hem bivchina lemala mimmenna. velaze sidder netinat haedut achar hakkapporet, lomar zo lemala mizzo, ma shello haya nishma ken im haya makdim lomar "venatatta et haedut vegomer venatatta et hakkapporet al haaron milmala", mashma shehakkapporet hu lemala mehaaron.

rashi: Veasita et hammizbeach vegomer veshalosh ammot komato. devarim kichtavan, divre Rabbi yehuda, rabbi yose omer neemar kan ravua veneemar bappenimi ravua, ma lehallan gavho pi shenayim kearko, af kan gavho pi shenayim kearko, uma ani mekayyem veshalosh ammot komato? missefat sovev ulemala (17 59):
ohc: Veasita et hammizbeach. amar hammizbeach velo amar mizbeach. ulay shechozer el hammuzkar bemitzvat hakkelalut dichtiv (Shemot 25:9) "et tavnit hammishkan veet tavnit kol kelav", vesham herahu hammizbeach, velaze amar veasita et hammizbeach shehereticha tavnito, tzarich sheyyihye mibbifnim atze shittim.

rashi: Avne shoham. shetayim hutzrechu sham letzorech haefod haamur bivatta tetzavve:
Milluim. al shem sheosin lahem bazzahav moshav kemin gumma, venotnin haeven sham lemallovt haggumma, keruyim avne milluim, umekom hammoshav karuy mishbetzet:
Laefod velachoshen. avne hashshoham laefod veavne hammilluim lachoshen; vechoshen veefod meforashim bivatta tetzavve vehem mine tachshit:
ohc: Avne shoham vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma katav avne shoham veavne milluim basseder achar kol haachad asar minim, umin harauy haya lo lesadderam kodem zahav vachesef ki hem meullim mehem. veulay ki letzad shemmatzinu shehannesiim heviu otam baacharona kesherau sheheviu yisrael kol hatztzorech lammishkan, vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 92) shehikpid Adonai al ze vechisser ot achat mehem, "vehannesiim" ketiv, laze sidderam Adonai baacharona lomar ki hem lematta mikkullam, umehattaam atzmo shehem baacharona, vehaven:

Od nire lomar al pi ma sheamru beyoma perek ba lo (yoma 69.) shebbigde kehunna muttarim lehanot mehem, umashma sheen moalin bahem. veshuv raiti larambam shekkatav ken beferek Adonai mehilchot meila, ulefi ze bigde kehunna enam behashevaa im kele hammishkan vaavodato shekkullan kedushshatan lemala mibbigde kehunna umoalin bahem. umeatta bedin hu lesadder baacharona avne shoham veavne milluim achar kol haachad asar devarim, letzad shekkol haachad asar haddevarim kullam hem tzarche hammishkan vaavodato, ma sheen ken haavanim sheenam ella levigde kehunna. vahagam shebbehaachad asar devarim yesh gam ken biktzat mehem shehem letzarche bigde kehunna, af al pi chen en lecha min vamin mehaachad asar sheen bo tzarche mishkan vaavodato, ma sheen ken haavanim sheenam ella levigde kehunna.

Od nire al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru beyoma (yoma 75.) shehaananim hayu meviim et avne hashshoham vechulei, im ken mishshulchan gavoah hayu meviim belo torach vigia velo chesron kis, asher al karcho sidder nedavatam achar kol hannedavot shemmeviin mikkisam veal yede torach.

rashi: Lo yasuru mimmennu. leolam (yoma amud bet):
ohc: Lo yasuru mimmennu. taam shehutzrach lomar mimmennu velo hispik lomar "lo yasuru" vehainyan muvan shemmimmennu hu, efshar shennitkavven lomar sheen tzarich sheyyihyu mehuddakin mammash shello yazuzu mittechillatam lesofam battabbaot atzmam, ella shello yasuru mehaaron hi hahakpada. ella shebbeyoma (72,1) amru veze leshonam: rabbi yose bar chanina rame, ketiv "betabbeot haaron yihyu habbaddim lo yasuru mimmennu" uchetiv "vehuva et baddav", ha ketzad? mitparkin veen nishmatin, ad kan. middivre haggemara muchach ki "lo yasuru" levad mashma leh shello yazuzu, veulay ki tevat mimmennu yesh bah mashmaut acher, ki va lerabbot shello yazuzu ane vaana, laze amar hakkatuv (Shemot 25:14) veheveta.

Od nire, ki im lo amar "veheveta" hayiti omer ki ma sheamar hakkatuv "mimmennu" ba lomar sheen chiyyuv malkut ella al hasaratam behechlet, uleolam yesh issur afillu bahazazatam. talmud lomar veheveta, perush leshon havaa, sheim kavvanat hakkatuv sheyyihyu kevuim velo zazim, haya lo lomar "vekavata" o "vechibbarta", velo "veheveta", sheyyihye nishma sheyyihyu nichnasim veyotzim.

Veraiti lehattosafot shehikshu lamma hevi rabbi yose bar chanina pasuk "vehuva", vehikshu od mippasuk "vesamu et baddav" (Bamidbar 4:5-7) bishat silluk massaot, shennire shehayu notnim otam bechol massa, ha lamadta shehayu mesirim otam, vehattora amra "lo yasuru mimmennu". veamru ki hayu shemona tabbaot baaron vearbaa baddim, vediyyek hakkatuv sheamar "veyatzakta lo arba tabbeot" vegomer (Shemot 25:12), uchetiv "ushete tabbaot" vegomer, ha lamadta shehem shemone, yeuyyan sham divrehem. veen ani matzdik devarim ellu ki rabbu hakkushyot al haotiyyot, vehaddavar pashut ki taut nafal bassefarim vetzarich lomar bimkom "vehuva" – "veheveta et habbaddim battabbaot".

Vekusheyat "vesamu baddav" (Bamidbar 4:7) nire li lomar, ki leheyot shehabbaddim hayu laset et haaron bahem, laze keshetztzivva Adonai lechassot et haaron befarochet hammasach, tzivva sheyyasimu hakkohanim hachanat habbaddim sheyyotziu rashe habbaddim. uferush "vesamu" 502 belaaz, kede sheyyihye beseder veofen sheyyisu otam haleviyyim al kitfehem, shello yitztarchu haleviyyim lehotzi rashe habbaddim veyazunu enehem min hakkodesh. veharav yehuda meorleyaynsh peresh sheyyasimu habbaddim al kitfe haleviyyim, uchevar dachu hattosafot devarav, yeuyyan sham divrehem (yoma av,1). veod yesh lehakeshot al devarav zichrono livracha kahenna vechahenna, veyoter yesh livchor bidvarenu. vetaam amro "ushete tabbaot", lo yadati ma yefarshu bappasuk (Shemot 28:3) "veasu et bigde aharon vegomer veelle habbegadim", uvehechreach lomar sheen yoter mishshemona, vechaelle rabbot, vetihye zot keachat mehem beVav nosaf shebba leeze derasha. veulay ki tzivva Adonai laasot shete tabbaot sheyyihyu kevuim beguf haaron veenam naim venadim, veachar kach yaase shete tabbaot veyachnisem battabbaot hakkevuim baaron, veellu hem naim venadim, veze miyyofi hannaase behitkavvenut hannosim lechavod uletifaret. uleolam lo hayu ella shene baddim asher bahem hayu nosim haaron.

rashi: Lulot. 456 belaaz, vechen tirgem unkelos anuvin, leshon aniva:
Mikkatza bachovaret. beotah yeria shebbesof hachibbur, kevutzat chameshet hayeriot keruya choveret:
Vechen taase bisfat hayeria hakkitzona bammachberet hashshenit. beotah yeria shehi kitzona, leshon katze, kelomar lesof hachoveret:
Vaase keruv echad mikkatza. shello tomar shenayim keruvim lechol katze vekatze, lechach hutzrach lefaresh keruv echad mikkatza mizze:
Min hakkapporet. atzmah taase et hakkeruvim, zehu perush shel miksha taase otam, shello taase bifne atzmam utechabberem lakkapporet:
Tov pat chareva veshalva vah. tov haya lehakkadosh baruch hu lehachariv beto veiro, vehaya veshalva meaverotehen shel yisrael:
Mibbayit male zivche riv. shehayu makrivin zivche riv beveto:
targum: Tava hi lachma sherivta veshalvata vah min beta demale divche didyana:

rashi: Veyihyu. kol hakkerashim toamim ze laze millematta, shello yafsik ovi sefat shene haadanim benehem leharechikam zo mizzo, zehu shepperashti sheyyihyu tzire hayyadot charutzim mitztziddehen, sheyyehe rochav hakkeresh bolet letziddav chutz lide hakkeresh, lechassot et sefat haeden, vechen hakkeresh sheetzlo, venimtzeu toamim ze laze; vekeresh hammiktzoa shebbeseder hammaarav charutz lerachbo beavyo keneged charitz shel tzad keresh hatztzefoni vehadderomi, chede shello yafridu haadanim benehem:
Veyachdav yihyu tammim. kemo toamim:
Al rosho. shel keresh:

El hattabbaat haechat. kol keresh vekeresh haya charutz milmala verachbo shene charitzin, bishne tziddav, kemo ovi tabbaat, umachniso betabbaat achat, nimtza matim lakkeresh sheetzlo, aval otan tabbaot lo yadati im kevuot hen, im metultalot, uvakkeresh shebbammiktzoa hayta tabbaat beovi hakkeresh hadderomi vehatztzefoni, verosh keresh hammiktzoa shebbeseder maarav nichnas letocho, nimtzeu shene hakketalim mechubbarim:
Ken yihye lishnehem. lishne hakkerashim shebbammiktzoa, lakkeresh shebbesof tzafon velakkeresh hammaaravi, vechen lishne hammiktzoot:
Farochet. leshon mechitztza hu, uvilshon chachamim pargod davar hammavdil ben hammelech uven haam:
Techelet veargaman. kol min vamin haya chaful bechol chut vachut shishsha chutin:
Maase choshev. kevar perashti shezzo hi ariga shel shete kirot, vehatztziyyurin shemmishshene avareha enan domin ze laze:
Keruvim. tziyyurin shel beriyyot yaase vah:
Zer zahav. siman lecheter malchut, shehashshulchan shem osher ugedulla, kemo sheomrim shulchan melachim:
Ohev pesha. lifshoa bachavero:
Ohev matztza. lehitkotet velariv:
Magbiah pitcho. medabber begaava, kemo "shemor pitche ficha" (Micha 7:5):
targum: Derachem chova rachem matzuta umerim tareh bae tavra:

rashi: Chapporet. kissuy al haaron, shehaya patuach milmala umannicho alav kemin daf:

Ammatayim vachetzi orkah. kearko shel aron, verachbah kerachbo shel aron, umunnachat al ovi hakketalim arbatam, veaappi shello natan shiur leavyah, pershu rabbotenu shehaya avyah tefach (socha Adonai):
Veet hammishkan taase eser yeriot. lihyot lo legag velimchitztzot michutz lakkerashim, shehayeriot teluyot meachorehen lechassotan:

Shesh moshzar utechelet vetolaat shani. hare arbaa minin yachad chut vechut – echad shel pishtan ushelosha shel tzemer – vechol chut vechut kaful 6 hare arbaa minin keshehen shezurin yachad 24 kefalim lachut (yoma amud alef):

Keruvim maase choshev. keruvim hayu metzuyyarin bahem baarigatan, velo virkima shehu maase machat, ella vaariga vishne ketalim, partzuf echad mikkan ufartzuf echad mikkan – ari mitztzad ze venesher mitztzad ze – kemo sheorgin chagorot shel meshi shekkorin belaaz payysheyshea:
ohc: Veet hammishkan taase eser yeriot. ramaz baze keneged asara maamarot shebbahem nivra haolam, lomar sheshshakul hammishkan kechol haolam kullo shennivra baasara maamarot, gam zechut leyisrael bo keillu kiyyemu haasara maamarot shebbahem nivra haolam.

Od nitkavven beseder mitzva zo shel yeriot shesh veshel yeriot izzim, shebbeshel shesh tzivva asara veshel izzim tzivva ashte asar. od tzivva sheyyechabber chamesh yeriot levad vechamesh yeriot levad, vechen beshel izzim tzivva lechabber shesh levad. taam haddavar hu ki rasham Adonai shemo hannichbad bayriot, vetzivva ki chullan yihyu rachban arba ben shel shesh ben shel izzim keneged arba otiyyot shel shem 26. vechen timtza sheramzu rishonim bemaamaram hazzach (shabbat 6,1) reshut hayyachid rachbo arbaa vegavho asara, shehu al shem 26, rachbo arbaa vegavho perush bemilluy asara al ze hadderech yod 15 vav 15. vekiddesh happenimi lihyoto karov lammakom hammekuddash vetzivva laasot asara yeriot keneged ot yod shel shemo haggadol, vetzivva sheyyechabber chamesh levad lirmoz baze ot hei rishona shel shemo yitbarach. veramaz baze ki ot hei rishona hi muchlelet tamid beot havd, veze hu sod keriatah ki kesheatta kore yod atta mechabber vav vedlt shehem techunat hah al ze hadderech Adonai veen atta kore ella ot achat, kemo chen haddavar hazze, vehaven. uvechina zo hi sod hachachma, vehinne lecha rishshumah nikkar biriot ellu. chachma – hashshete otiyyot rishonim hem shemona veesrim, kenegdam tzivva orech hayeria shemone veesrim baamma. ot shelishit 40 – arbaim, kenegdam tzivva Adonai rochav arba baamma sheole leminyan eser yeriot arbaim, veot reviit hi ot Adonai sherasham bemaamar chamesh levad, vegam hu sod chamishsha chasadim hannimshachim mehachachma. veachar kach tzivva Adonai keneged tashlum hashshem shehu 11 laasot yeriot izzim achad asar, verasham sheyyechabber shesh levad shehu keneged vav vechamesh levad keneged hei, hare tashlum shemo yitbarach. vegam rasham becheshbon rochav ashte esre 44 lesod havv tiferet yisrael, shehu sod yod hei vav hei sheole bo 45. uchevar hodianu Adonai (Bereshit 48:5) ki lo yeakkev echad lemispar ki yashlimennu hakkelalut. verasham becheshbon haorech sheloshim baamma keneged haderagot hei acharona shebbashshem shemmeira mishshalosh hakkollot asiriyyot vehem sheloshim. veod yesh leeloah millin illain kaddishin, vehashshomea yishma ulevavo yavin.

rashi: Meoddamim. tzevuot hayu adom leachar ibbudan:
Techashim. min chayya, velo hayta ella leshaa, veharebe gevanim hayu lah, lechach meturgam sasgona shessas umitpaer bigvanin shello (shabbat 28):

Vaatze shittim. umeayin hayu lahem bammidbar? peresh rabbi tanchuma: yaakov avinu tzafa beruach hakkodesh sheatidin yisrael livnot mishkan bammidbar, vehevi arazim lemitzrayim unetaam, vetzivva levanav littelam immahem kesheyyetzu mimmitzrayim:

Veasita kearotav vechappotav. kearotav ze defus shehaya asuy kidfus hallechem, vehallechem haya asuy kemin teva perutza mishte ruchoteha, shulayim lo lematta, vekofel mikkan umikkan kelappe mala kemin ketalim, ulechach karuy lechem happanim, sheyyesh lo fanim roin lechan ulechan letzidde habbayit mizze umizze, venoten arko lerachbo shel shulchan, vechatlav zekufim keneged sefat hashshulchan; vehaya asuy lo defus zahav udefus barzel, beshel barzel hu neefe, ucheshemmotzio min hattannur notno veshel zahav ad lemachar beshabbat shemmesaddero al hashshulchan, veoto defus karuy keara:
Vechappotav. bazichin shennotnin bahem levona shetayim hayu lishne kumtze levona shennotnin al shete hammaarachot, shenneemar venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka (Vayikra 24):

Ukesotav. hen kemin chatzae kanim chalulim hannisdakin learkan (menachot 96), dugmatan ose shel zahav, umesadder 3 al rosh kol lechem, sheyyeshev lechem haacher al gabbe otan hakkanim, umavdilin ben lechem lelechem kede shettikkanes haruach benehem velo yitappeshu; uvilshon aravi kol davar chalul karuy kasevaa:

Umenakkiyyotav. targumo umechilateh, hen senifim kemin yitdot zahav, omdin baaretz ugevohim ad lemala min hashshulchan harebe, keneged gova maarechet hallechem, umefutztzalim chamishsha fitztzulim ze lemala mizze, verashe hakkanim shebben lechem lelechem semuchin al otan pitztzulin, kede shello yichbad massa hallechem haelyonim al hattachtonim veyishshavru; uleshon mechilateh sovlotav, kemo nileti hachil (Yirmeyahu 6). aval leshon menakkiyyot eni yodea ech nofel al senifin; veyesh mechachme yisrael omrim kesotav ellu senifin, shemmakshin oto umachazikim oto shello yishshaver, umenakkiyyotav ellu hakkanim shemmenakkin oto shello yitappesh (menachot 97), aval unkelos shettirgem umechilateh, haya shone chedivre haomer menakkiyyot hen senifin:

Asher yussach bahen. asher yechusse vahen, veal kesotav hu omer asher yussach, shehayu alav kemin sechach vechissuy, vechen bemakom acher hu omer veet kesot hannasech (Bamidbar 4), veze vaze, yussach vehannasech, leshon sechach vechissuy hem:
Uree vaase. ree chan bahar tavnit sheani mare otcha, maggid shennitkashsha moshe vemaase hammenora ad shehera lo hakkabba menora shel esh (sham 29):

Asher atta more. ketargumo deat mitchaze betura; illu haya nakud mare, befattach, haya pitrono atta mare laacherim, achshav shennakud chataf kamatz, pitrono deat mitchaze – sheacherim marim lecha (shehannikkud mafrid ben ose lenaase):
Vehaamma mizze vehaamma mizze. latztzafon veladdarom:
Baodef beorech yeriot haohel. shehen odfot al orech yeriot hammishkan shete ammot:
Yihye saruach al tzidde hammishkan. latztzafon veladdarom, kemo shepperashti lemala. limmeda tora derech eretz sheyyehe adam chas al hayyafe (yalkut shemauni):
Mera. rasha:
Makshiv al sefat aven sheker. mekabbel lashon hara veede sheker:
Mezin. maazin, mi shehu meshakker maazin al leshon havvot:
targum: Gavra visha tzayet lesifvata deata shikra veragluta al lishana deata:

rashi: Orech hechatzer. hatztzafon vehaddarom shemmin hammizrach lammaarav mea vaamma:

Verochav chamishshim bachamishshim. chatzer shebbammizrach hayta merubbaat, chamishshim al chamishshim, shehammishkan arko sheloshim verachbo eser, heemid mizrach pitcho bisfat 50 hachitzonim shel orech hechatzer, nimtza kullo bachamishshim happenimiyyim vechale arko lesof sheloshim, nimtzeu esrim amma revach laachorav ben hakkelaim shebbammaarav layriot shel achore hammishkan, verochav hammishkan eser ammot, beemtza rochav hechatzer, nimtzeu lo esrim amma revach latztzafon veladdarom min kale hechatzer liriot hammishkan, vechen lammaarav, vachamishshim al chamishshim chatzer lefanav:
Vekoma chamesh ammot. gova mechitztzot hechatzer vehu rochav hakkelaim:
Veadnehem nechoshet. lehavi adne hammasach, shello tomar lo neemru adne nechoshet ella leammude hakkelaim aval adne hammasach shel min acher, ken nire veenay shellechach chazar ushenaan:
ohc: Chamesh ammot vegomer. ayyen ma shepperashti bappasuk (Shemot 25:9) "vechen taasu".

rashi: Venissa vam. leshon nifal, yihye nissa vam et hashshulchan:
Kelaim. asuyin kemin kale sefina, nekavim nekavim, maase kelia velo maase oreg, vetargum seradim ketargumo shel michbar hameturgam serada, lefi shehen menukkavin kichvara:
Lappea haechat. kol haruach karuy pea:
Matzref lakkesef. keli shetztzorfin bo kesef veosin oto meefer mikle al gabbe cheres, karuy matzref:
Vechur lazzahav. keli shetztzorfin bo et hazzahav, keli shezzokkin bo et hazzahav, kemo kedera shevura, keruya kur:
Matzref lakkesef vechur lazzahav. hammatzref asuy litzrof kesef limlachto vechen hakkur lezakkek hazzahav, aval hallevavot hakkadosh baruch hu zokkan uvochanan veyodea machshevotan:
targum: Tzarafa neki lesama vechura ledahava velaha badek libbaya:

rashi: Venatatta el haaron. kemo baaron:
Haedut. hattora, shehi leedut beni uvenechem shetztzivviti etchem mitzvot hakketuvot bah:

Eved maskil vegomer. al shehiskil nevuchadnetztzar lifsoa shalosh pesiot lichvodo shel hakkadosh baruch hu, ala ligdulla umashal beyisrael, shehovishu maasehem vechalak nachalatam leenehem. davar acher: ger tzedek tov meezrach rasha, veleatid lavo yechallek shalal venachala betoch bene yisrael, shenneemar "vehaya vashshevet asher gar hagger vegomer" (Yechezkel 47:23):
targum: Avda sucheltana yishtalet bivra mevahatana uvenat ache nifleg yeruteta:

rashi: Eser ammot orech hakkaresh. lamadnu gavho shel mishkan eser ammot:
Veamma vachatzi haamma rochav. lamadnu arko shel mishkan, leesrim kerashim sheyyihyu batztzafon uvaddarom min hammizrach lammaarav, sheloshim amma:

Sheloshim baamma. shekkeshennoten arkan lerochav hammishkan, kemo shennatan et harishonot, nimtzeu ellu odfot amma mikkan veamma mikkan lechassot achat mehashshete ammot shennisharu megullot min hakkerashim, vehaamma hattachtona shel keresh sheen hayeria mechassa oto hi haamma hattechuva benekev haeden, shehaadanim gavhan amma:
Keruvim. demut partzuf tinok lahem:

Miksha taase. shello taasem bifne atzmam utechabberem berashe hakkapporet leachar asiyyatam kemaase tzorfim shekkorin shaveladeyr belaaz, ella hattel zahav harebe bitchillat asiyyat hakkapporet, vehakke befattish uvekurnas baemtza, verashin boltin lemala, vetzayyer hakkeruvim bivlitat ketzotav:
Miksha. 115 belaaz, kemo da leda nakshan (Daniel Adonai):
Ketzot hakkapporet. rashe hakkapporet:

Kol ammude hechatzer saviv vegomer. lefi shello peresh vavin vachashukim veadne nechoshet ella latztzafon veladdarom, aval lammizrach velammaarav lo neemar vavin vachashukim veadne nechoshet, lechach ba velimmed kan:

Arbaa ammude shittim. tekuim betoch arbaa adanim, veunekliyyot kevuin bahen, akummim lemala, lehoshiv alehen kelonas sherosh happarochet karuch bah, vehaunekliyyot hen havvavin – shehare chemin vavin hen asuyim – vehapparochet arkah eser ammot lerachbo shel mishkan verachbah eser ammot kegavhan shel kerashim, perusa bishlishit shel mishkan, sheyyehe hemenna velifnim eser ammot vehemenna velachutz esrim amma, nimtza vet kadshe hakkodashim eser al eser, shenne venatatta et happarochet tachat hakkerasim – hamechabberim et shete chovrot shel yeriot hammishkan; rochav hachoveret esrim amma, ucheshepperasah al gag hammishkan min happetach lammaarav, kalta bishne shelishi hammishkan, vehachoveret hashshenit kisseta shelisho shel mishkan, vehammotar taluy laachorav lechassot et hakkerashim:

Lifat kedma mizracha. pene hammizrach; kedem leshon panim, achor lashon achorayim, lefichach hammizrach karuy kedem shehu panim, umaarav karuy achor, kema deat amar hayyam haacharon (Devarim 11:24, Devarim 34:2), yamma maarva:

Chamishshim amma. otan 50 amma lo hayu setumim kullam bakkelaim, lefi sheshsham happetach, ella 15 amma kelaim lechetef happetach mikkan, vechen lakkatef hashshenit, nishar rochav chalal happetach bentayim 20 amma, vezehu shenne uleshaar hechatzer masach 20 amma – vilon lammasach keneged happetach 20 amma orech, kerochav happetach:

Shete yadot lakkeresh haechad. haya choretz et hakkeresh millematta beemtzao begova amma, umanniach revia rachbo mikkan, urevia rachbo mikkan, vehen hen hayyadot, vehecharitz chatzi rochav hakkeresh baemtza, veotan hayyadot machnis baadanim shehayu chalulim, vehaadanim gavhan amma veyoshvim retzufim arbaim ze etzel ze, vidot hakkeresh hannichnasot bachalal haadanim charutzot mishshelosha tziddehen – rochav hecharitz keovi sefat haeden – sheyyechasse hakkeresh et kol rosh haeden, sheim lo chen, nimtza revach ben keresh lekeresh keovi sefat shene haadanim, sheyyafsiku benehem, vezehu shenneemar veyihyu toamim millematta, sheyyacharotz et tzidde hayyadot kede sheyyitchabberu hakkerashim ze etzel ze:
Meshullavot. asuyot kemin shelivot sullam, umuvdalot zo mizzo, umeshuppin rashehem likkanes betoch chalal haeden kishliva hannichneset benekev ammude hassullam:

Ishsha el achotah. mechuvvanot zo cheneged zo, sheyyihyu charitzehem shavim zo chemiddat zo, kede shello yihyu shete yadot zo meshucha letzad penim vezo meshucha letzad chutz beovi hakkeresh shehu amma, vetargum shel yadot tzirin, lefi sheddomot letzire haddelet hannichnasim bechore hammiftan:
Veasu aron. kemin aronot sheosim belo raglayim, asuyim kemin argaz shekkorin 671 belaaz, yoshev al shulav:
ohc: Veasu aron. taam shebbaaron shinna Adonai et devaro hattov mikkol hakkelim, shebbechullam amar "veasita shulchan", "veasita menorat" vegomer, "veet hammishkan taase", "veasita et hammizbeach atze" vegomer, vegam bifrate haaron atzmo gamar omer benocheach dichtiv "vetzippita oto" "veyatzakta lo" "veasita vadde" vegomer. ulay sheramaz sheen gufah shel tora yachol lehitkayyem ella bichlalut kol yisrael, veen metziut baolam yachol asot kol ikkere hattora. veze lecha haot: im hu kohen hare ze eno mekayyem netinat esrim vearba mattenot kehunna ufidyon bechor vechulei, veim hu yisrael hare eno yachol lekayyem mitzvat ase shebbehakravat hakkarbanot vedinehem asher rabbu mitzvot ase shebbahem, vechen levi. uvichlalut kol yisrael yekayyemu kelalut ikkere hattora, laze amar veasu leshon rabbim, uvishar perate tikkune haaron amar leshon yachid, ki letakken kele hattora shehem lomdeha vaameleha vahachanoteha yecholin lehitkayyem meadam echad.

Od ulay shekkadam ledabber lo belashon ze legallot lo al kol hammaase, shehagam shemmedabber immo lenocheach, lo elav ba hammitzva ella lezulat, shehem chachme lev (Shemot 36:1), kemo shebbeer achar kach, umechanne haddavar elav lefi shehu hametzavve leyisrael.

Od lefi ma sheamru zichrono livracha (Rashi al Devarim 8:1), ki aron etz asa moshe vesam sham halluchot techef biridato min hahar ad sheasa betzalel haaron shehunechu sham leolam, vechen amar befarashat ekev (Devarim 10:1) "veasita lecha aron etz". dikdek lomar "lecha", perush: en perush "veasita" kishar "veasita" asher tzivviticha bemaase mishkan – "veasita shulchan", "veasita menorat", "veasita mizbeach", vechullan lo asaan ella betzalel. davar ze lecha ani metzavve laasot, vechen asa, dichtiv (Devarim 10:3) "vaaas aron atze shittim", uchetiv (Devarim 10:5) "vaasim et halluchot baaron asher asiti". asher al ken amar kan veasu, perush, millevad ma shettaase atta shehu lefi shaa, od yaasu haosim minnichse nidvat hammishkan. veim haya omer "veasita", haya sover moshe ladun mimma sheggilla lo baaron shellefi shaa sheyyihye mishshello gam et ze yihye haddavar ken, o yachshov sheyyihye oto aron atzmo shekkevar asa. laze amar, lo chen hu, veasu vegomer. uvishar maasim shello haya maase zulat haamur, dibber hakkatuv kedarko "veasita", lomar shehazzechut mechuvvana lemoshe hagam sheacherim osim.

rashi: Tihyena chovrot. tofran bemachat zo vetzad zo, chamesh levad vechamesh levad:
Ishsha el achotah. kach derech hammikra ledabber bedavar shehu leshon nekeva, uvedavar shehu leshon zachar omer ish el achiv, kemo shennee bakkeruvim ufenehem ish el achiv (Shemot 25):
Even chen. keshehaadam ba lifne hakkadosh baruch hu umefayyeso bidvarim veshav lo, even chen umargaliyyot hi beenav:
El kol asher yifne yaskil. bechol ma sheyyevakkesh mimmennu matzlicho:
targum: Kefa deshochada chasida hi veappe man deshakel lah lechol atar demitpene sikkula:

rashi: Veyikchu li teruma. li – lishmi:
Teruma. haferasha, yafrishu li mimmamonam nedava:
Yiddevennu libbo. leshon nedava vehu leshon ratzon tov, 459 belaaz:

Tikchu et terumati. amru rabbotenu shalosh terumot amurot kan, achat terumat beka laggulgolet shennaasu mehem haadanim, kemo shemmeforash beelle fekude, veachat terumat hammizbeach beka laggulgolet lakkuppot liknot mehen karbenot tzibbur, veachat terumat hammishkan nidvat kol echad veechad (talmud yerushalmi shekalim 1). 13 devarim haamurim bainyan kullam hutzrechu limlechet hammishkan o levigde chehunna keshettedakdek bahem:
ohc: Dabber el bene yisrael. tzarich ladaat lamma lo hispik bema shekkadam lomar lemor vehaddavar muvan shellivne yisrael yomar, o lo haya tzarich lomar "lemor" veyaspik beamro "dabber el bene yisrael".

Venire li al derech ma sheamru zichrono livracha (yoma 4.) minnayin shehaomer davar lachavero shehu beval tomar, shenneemar "vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor". veal pi haddevarim haelle yitztarech lomar "dabber el bene yisrael", sheim lo chen yachshov moshe ki lo ba ella latet reshut sheen ze beval tomar, chova minnayin? talmud lomar "dabber" vegomer. ulederech ze timtza margoa lenafshecha bechol hattora kullah sheamar hakkatuv "lemor" vechazar lomar "dabber", ki bechol mitzva tzarich lomar lo "lemor" vedabber", uveachat mehenna lo yihye nishma shechova alav hem haddevarim leamram lahem ella reshut. verabbotenu zichrono livracha (yalkut haruveni) darshu "dabber el bene yisrael" shello yemanne alehem meerev rav, vedorshim leshon dabbarut userara. od yitbaer besamuch beofen acher.

Veyikchu li. tzarich ladaat lamma katav vav bitchillat inyan. veulay sheyyirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (shekalim 1,3) memashkenin al hashshekalim, veamru zichronam livracha (tanchuma) ki shalosh terumot shanu kan, shetayim mehem shekalim beka laggulgolet, achat laadanim veachat lekarbenot tzibbur, vehashshelishit nidvat hammishkan ad kan. uchefi ze nitkavven beamro veyikchu keneged nidvat hashshekalim harmuza batteruma hassemucha lah, lomar sheyyeshno bichfiyya lishkol, vesamach tevat veyikchu el bene yisrael lirmoz shebbashshekalim medabber hakkatuv, sheenam shoklim ella bene yisrael velo benot yisrael, dichtiv (Shemot 30:13) "kol haover" vegomer. ulefi ze amro meet kol ish, perush shehallekicha tihye behashevaa meet kol ish, vaafillu et asher yiddevennu libbo tihye lekicha shava mikkullam, velo yarbe hannadiv velo yamit hakkilay. veod yirtze betosefet vav lirmoz shekkevar kadam davar acher, vehu nidvat lev, karamuz besof devarav sheamar asher yiddevennu libbo, ulederech ze yedabber hakkatuv gam bitrumat hammishkan, veyachpotz Adonai shekkol nedava tihye millev velo tihye hannetina ad shettikdam hannedava ballev.

Od nire lefaresh hakkatuv al pi ma sheamru bemassechet bava batra (8,1): kuppa nigbet bishnayim umitchalleket bishlosha, nigbet bishnayim lefi sheen osin serarut al hatztzibbur pachot mishshenayim. veamru sham: mena hane mile? amar kera (Shemot 28,5) 'vehem yikchu. umay serarut? shemmemashkenim al hatztzedaka im amud hu, ad kan. veheelu sham hattosafot veharan ki shenayim sheamru davka bedavar hakkatzuv, aval sheeno katzuv tzarich shelosha. veda ki leinyan din afillu yachid im hu mumche yachof adam beal karcho ladun oto yechidi, kidtanya (sanhedrin 5,1): im haya yachid mumche larabbim vechulei hare ze dan yechidi. vechatvu hattosafot sham: veyachol lachof et haadam beal karcho dei bidkabbeleh vechulei. umikkan ani lamed shehu haddin vechol shekken hu sheyyachol lehanehig serarut yechidi veeno tzarich shenayim, uma mishpat hatztzarich shelosha dan vechayef, serarut shemmaspik bishnayim lo kol shekken. uvaze naskil beur hakkatuv, amro dabber el bene yisrael, en perusho leshon dibbur ella leshon serarut vedabbarut, lomar ki hu levaddo yachol laasot shene mishpatim sheyyeshnam bainyan: haachat hi hahaaracha, vehashsheniyya hi hasserara, shehagam shehahaaracha tzarich shelosha vehasserara tzericha shenayim kannizkar, atta levaddecha tihye dabbar al haddavar letzad sheatta yachid mumche taspik bimkom shelosha, veen tzarich lomar bimkom shenayim leinyan hasserarut, vedavka atta, aval hazzulat veyikchu leshon rabbim. vetimtza shekken haya dichtiv (Shemot 36,3): "vayyikchu millifne moshe", hare ki moshe levaddo kibbel hannedava, ben davar sheyyesh bo kitzba ben davar sheen bo kitzba. vahagam shebbattalmud darshu mippasuk (Shemot 28,5) "vehem yikchu", ulay ki sham chiddesh leinyan hasserarut shetztzericha shenayim, vechan leinyan perat lekichat davar sheen bo kitzva shello natan reshut laasot haddavar beyachid ella lemoshe, aval hazzulat tzarich rabbim. ulederech ze yityashshev amro veyikchu betosefet vav, letzad shekkadam veamar dabbaruto shel moshe, laze yutzdak lomar achar kach "veyikchu".

Meet kol ish vegomer. ulay sheyyechavven lomar ki beish sheyyodim bo shehu nediv lev, lo yachnisuhu bemishpat hahaaracha ladaat ma yekabbelu mimmennu, kevan shehu muchzak ki libbo nadiv, yikchu mimmennu et asher yavi, ki vadday sheyyodea hu atzmo shezze hu yechalto, veet zo atzdik shehu terumati hatztzarich latet, keamro et terumati.

Od yirtze lomar sheenah chashuva likkaroot terumati ella hammuva minnidvat lev haadam, vehu amro meet asher vegomer tikchu et terumati, aval hameusse lo keraah terumati ella teruma dichtiv "veyikchu li teruma".

Od nire bedikduk amro shelosha ribbuyim ellu meet kol ish shello haya lo lomar ella "measher yiddevennu" vegomer, veulay shennitkavven hakkatuv lerabbot shelosha peratim sheyyeshnam behaderaga meshunna bedin hatztzedakot mikkol yisrael, vehem: hayyetomim vehannashim vehashshoa. hayyetomim – kemo sheamru bemassechet bava batra (8,1) en poskim tzedaka al hayyetomim, veim laasot lahem shem – muttar. hannashim – kemo sheamru besof massechet kamma (119,1) sheen lokchim mehannashim ella davar muat, veamru od sham ki muat umerubbe hu lefi erech ma shehem hannashim, uchemaase ravina shellakach sharsherot zahav mehem veamar ki beerech bene mechoza davar muat hu. shoa – kemo sheamru bevava batra (sham) sheasur legabbay tzedaka letavo veligbot mimmennu vechulei, uchemaase huva sham (taanit kad,1) od shehayu nishmatim haggabbaim mehitraot lefanav leval yihye metzer leatzmo veyitten ma sheen bo koach litten. vehinne benidvat hammishkan amar Adonai lemoshe sheyyikkach mehashshelosha hannizkarim, vehu ma sheribba bishloshet haribbuyim: yetomim, nashim, shoa. et lerabbot hannashim, kol lerabbot hayyetomim, ish asher yiddevennu libbo ze shoa kemashmao, shemmishshelashtam yikkach afillu davar gadol.

Veyesh taam baddavar al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (tanchuma) sheamru ki hammishkan hu kappara al maase haegel. od amru (Shemot Rabba 33,8) veze leshonam: amar moshe lifne Adonai, vechi yisrael yecholin livnot mishkan? amar lo: mehakkatan shebbahem kulei, ki hamman haya morid leyisrael avanim tovot umargaliyyot, ad kan. vegam amru (tanchuma) ki mibbizzat mitzrayim natlu katan shebbechullam massa arbaim chamorim kesef vezahav vaavanim tovot vechulei. veamru (Shir HaShirim Rabba 1,11) od shebbizzat hayyam gedola mibbizzat mitzrayim, hare shehaya leyisrael osher muflag. ulefi ze yesh taam nachon lishlashtam, ki lo amru en lokchim mehayyetomim ella bemakom sheen bo shem velo kappara, aval bemakom sheyyesh echad mehem kammishkan – lokchim mehem. vehannashim gam ken bimkom kappara lokchim mehem, veod shehagam sheyyittenu davar gadol beerech ashram hammuflag davar katan yechashev, vehashshoa gam ken letzad rov haosher lo yaase bo roshem kol ma sheyyitten lenidvat hammishkan afillu yitten kol hatztzarich lammishkan. vedikdek lomar tikchu et terumati, lomar shello hittir lakachat mehaderagot hannizkarim "meet kol ish" vegomer ella "et terumati" shehi terumat hammishkan latteamim shepperashnu.

Uvederech remez yirtze sheyyechavven kol echad ledabbek baAdonai bechinat nafsho hannikret teruma beemtzaut hammaase, vehu amro veyikchu li teruma, ki hannefesh shel yisrael tikkare teruma, dichtiv (yirmeya 2:3) "kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato", uteruma nikret reshit, uveemtzaut lekichat meet kol ish vegomer yassigu shettishre alehem hashshechina, vehu amro tikchu et terumati, ki hashshechina tikkare terumat Adonai, vehammaskil yavin.

rashi: Umalkacheha. hem hatztzevatim haasuyin likkach bahem happetila mittoch hashshemen, leyashshevan ulemashchan befi hannerot, veal shem shellokchim bahem keruyim melkachayim; vetzivtaha shettirgem unkelos leshon tzevat, 409 belaaz:

Umachtoteha. hem kemin bazichin ketannim shechote bahen et haefer shebbanner babboker babboker, keshehu metiv et hannerot meefer happetilot sheddalku hallayla vechavu, uleshon machta paveyyshareya belaaz, kemo lachtot esh miyyakud (Yeshayahu 30):
ohc: Umalkacheha vegomer zahav tahor. hutzrach lomar zahav tahor, lefi sheallibba dechulle alma enam baim mehakkikkar, velaze tzarich lehodia mimma yaasu otam:

rashi: Ateret zekenim. kesheroim bene venehem holchin bederech tova:
Vetiferet banim avotam. kesheavotehem tzaddikim, hi tiferet habbanim:
targum: Kelila desave vene vanaya veshivhorhon divnaya avahathon:

ohc: Venatatta et happarochet vegomer veheveta shamma. mikkan mashma ki yakdim litlot happarochet bimkomo, veachar kach yavi haaron lifnim mehapparochet, uvefarashat pekude (Shemot 40:3) amar Adonai elav "vesamta sham et aron haedut vesakkota al haaron et happarochet", mashma ki yakdim haaron, vechen asa moshe shehikdim haaron techilla kamvoar sham (Shemot 40:20).

Venire ki ma shehikdim netinat happarochet lahavaat haaron, eno ella sheratza ligmor maase happarochet, aval seder et mi yakdim hinne huva befarashat pekude, o letzad ki seder hahakama en ze mekomo ella befarashat pekude, velo huzekar kan havaat haaron ella lomar ma meshammesh happarochet uma maasav, shehu lehavedil ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim shehu mekomo shel haaron, laze lo dikdek lomar mi kodem, vetidreshennu bimkomo.

rashi: Miksha tease hammenora. shello yaasenna chulyot velo yaase kaneha veneroteha evarim evarim veachar kach yadbikem, kederech hatztzorfim shekkorin shaveladeyr belaaz, ella chullah baa mechaticha achat, umakkish bakkurnas vechotech bichli haummanut umafrid hakkanim elach vaelach:
Miksha. targumo negid, leshon hameshacha, shemmamshich et haevarim min haeshet lechan ulechan behakkashat hakkurnas, uleshon miksha makkat kurnas, 115 belaaz, kemo da leda nakshan (Daniel Adonai):
Tease hammenora. meeleha, lefi shehaya moshe mitkashshe vah, amar lo hakkabba hashelech et hakkikkar laur vehi naaset meeleha, lechach lo nichtav taase (tanchuma):
Yerechah. hu haregel shellematta heasuy kemin teva, ushelosha raglayim yotzin hemennu ulematta:
Vekanah. hakkane haemtzai shellah haole beemtza hayyarech zakuf kelappe mala, vealav ner haemtzai asuy kemin bazech, latzuk hashshemen letocho velatet happetila:

Gevieha. hen kemin kosot sheosin mizzechuchit, arukkim uketzarim, vekorin lahem madeyrenash belaaz, veellu asuyin shel zahav, uvoltin veyotzin mikkol kane vekane kamminyan shennatan bahem hakkatuv, velo hayu vah ella lenoy:

Kaftoreha. kemin tappuchim hayu, agullin saviv, boltin sevivot hakkane haemtzai, kederech sheosin lammenorot shellifne hassarim, vekorin lahem 466 belaaz, uminyan shellahem katuv bapparasha, kamma kaftorim boltin mimmenna vechamma chalak ben kaftor lechaftor:
Uferacheha. tziyyurin asuyin bah kemin perachin:
Mimmenna yihyu. hakkol miksha yotze mittoch chatichat haeshet, velo yaase levaddam veyadbikem:
ohc: Tease hammenora. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "tease hammenora", uvimnachot perek hakkometz rabba (menachot koach,1) darshu "tease" lerabbot shear hammattachot. ulefi ze dikdek lomar "tease" velo "taase", ki bime moshe lo haya tzorech laze ki shel zahav asu, uvammidbar lo hutzrechu laasot acheret.

rashi: Veyatzakta. leshon hattacha, ketargumo:

Paamavetayv. ketargumo zivyateh; uvazzaviyyot haelyonot samuch lakkapporet hayu netunot, shetayim mikkan ushetayim mikkan lerachbo shel aron, vehabbaddim netunim bahem, vearko shel aron mafsik ben habbaddim, ammatayim vachetzi ben bad levad, sheyyihyu shene vene adam hannosin et haaron mehallechin benehem; vechen meforash bimnachot bef shete hallechem (menachot daf 98):

Ushete tabbeot al tzalo haechat. hen hen arba tabbaot shebbitchillat hammikra, uferesh lecha hechan hayu; vehavvav zo yetera hi, ufitrono kemo shete tabbaot, veyesh lecha leyashshevah ken: ushete min hattabbaot haellu al tzalo haachat:
Tzalo. tziddo:
Shemen lammaor. shemen zayit zach lehaalot ner tamid:
Besamim leshemen hammishcha. shennaasa limshoach kele hammishkan vehammishkan lekaddesho, vehutzrechu lo vesamim, kemo shemmeforash bechi tissa:
Veliktoret hassammim. shehayu maktirin bechol erev vavoker, kemo shemmeforash bivatta tetzavve, uleshon ketoret haalaat kitor vetimrat ashan:

Veasita et hakkerashim. haya lo lomar veasita kerashim, kemo shenneemar bechol davar vedavar, mahu hakkerashim? meotan haomdin umeyuchadin lechach; yaakov avinu nata arazim bemitzrayim, ucheshemmet tzivva levanav lehaalotam immahem kesheyyetzu mimmitzrayim, veamar lahem sheatid hakkabba letzauot otan laasot mishkan bammidbar meatze shittim, reu sheyyihyu mezummanim beyedchem; hu sheyyissed habbavli bappiyyut shello, "tas matta mezorazim korot battenu arazim", shennizdarzu lihyot muchanim beyadam mikkodem lachen:

Atze shittim omdim. aytashetanebaysh belaaz; sheyyehe orech hakkerashim zakuf lemala bekirot hammishkan, velo taase hakketalim bikrashim shochvim, lihyot rochav hakkerashim legova hakketalim keresh al keresh:
ohc: Veasita et hakkerashim lammishkan. perush, ki hammishkan yikkare haohel sheal hakkerashim, veen hakkerashim nikraim mishkan ella karshe hammishkan.

Atze shittim omdim. rabbotenu zichronam livracha beyoma (72.) amru sheomdin derech gedilatan. venire sheddiyyeku lah mimma shello amar al ze hadderech "veasita et hakkerashim lammishkan omdim atze shittim" o "veasita et hakkerashim atze shittim lammishkan omdim", sheaz yihye nishma shehahaamada hi bemitzvat hammishkan shello yihyu shochvim. umeamro atze shittim omdim ramaz ki chozeret tevat omdim gam litchunat haetzim meatzmam, sheyyihyu keseder haamadatam bishat gedilatam.

Remez hammishkan – kerashim, en kerashim ella kesharim, shebbeemtzauto yitkashsheru veyityachadu kol bechinot hakkedushsha, elyonim vetachtonim, vechullan remuzim bo. "eser ammot orech hakkaresh" – en lecha bechina mibbechinat hakkedushsha sheen bah kelalut asara.

Veamro veamma vachatzi, kan ramaz yichud matztza shelema umatztza perusa, vehu sod hei vedlt. o yirtze sod hayyesod chay haolamim hu remez haamma, vaateret hayyesod hu bechinat chatzi haamma, nimtzeta omer ki chol keresh yesh bo remez asara sheyyeshnam bechol sefira, veyesh bahem remez tzaddik vetzedek meyuchadim barochav.
Minyan hakkerashim 48, vehu sod (Yeshayahu 54:12) "vesamti kadkod shimshotayich".

Haadanim shemam yaggid umaasehem yatzdik bechinatam, ki hem bechinat hashshechina asher titkanne beshem 65, vaasher tekabbel hayyesod betochah. umisparam mea, vehu sod hakkaton lemea, gam hi haasiri lammadregot vecholelet kol haasiriyyot hare mea.

rashi: Vadde. motot:
Komato. gova raglav im ovi hashshulchan:
ohc: Ammatayim arko vegomer. hinne keshetterabbea kol ammot hashshulchan amma al amma berum amma, yihyu ben orech verochav vegova shalosh ammot merubbaot beorech verochav vegova, vehu sod hashepaat shulchan haelyon mishshalosh haderagot benetzach hod yesod haolam.

rashi: Pagosh dov shakkul beish. tov laadam sheyyifga bo dov meshakkel, veal yifga bo echad min hakkesilim hammesitim oto lasur meAdonai umittorato:
targum: Pagia dov uretita begavra chakkima la mitzia vesichla beshatyuteh nafel:

rashi: Lifat negba temana. en pea zo leshon miktzoa, ella kol haruach keruya pea, ketargumo: leruach evar daroma:

Vechaftor tachat shene hakkanim. mittoch hakkaftor hayu hakkanim nimshachim mishshene tziddeha elach vaelach, kach shaninu vimlechet hammishkan: gavhah shel menora 18 tefachim, haraglayim vehapperach shelosha tefachim – hu happerach haamur bayyarech, shenneemar ad yerechah ad pirchah (Bamidbar 8) – utefachayim chalak, vetefach shebbo gavia mehaarbaa geviim vechaftor vaferach mishshene chaftorim ushene ferachim haamurim bammenora atzmah, shenne meshukkadim kaftoreha uferacheha, lamadnu shehayu bakkane shene chaftorim ushene ferachim levad min hashshelosha chaftorim shehakkanim nimshachin mittochan, shenne vechaftor tachat shene hakkanim vegomer, utefachayim chalak, vetefach kaftor ushene kanim yotzim mimmennu elach vaelach nimshachim veolim keneged gavhah shel menora, tefach chalak, vetefach kaftor ushene kanim yotzim mimmennu, vetefach chalak, vetefach kaftor ushene kanim yotzim mimmennu venimshachim veolin keneged gavhah shel menora, utefachayim chalak, nishtayyeru sham shelosha tefachim shebbahem shelosha geviim vechaftor vaferach, nimtzeu geviim 22 – 18 leshishsha kanim, shelosha lechol echad veechad, vearbaa begufah shel menora, hare 22 – veachad asar kaftorim, shishsha besheshet hakkanim, ushelosha begufah shel menora shehakkanim yotzim mehem, ushenayim od bammenora shenne meshukkadim kaftoreha, umiut kaftorim shenayim, haechad lematta etzel hayyarech, vehaechad beg tefachim haelyonim im 3 haggeviim, vetisha ferachim hayu lah, shishsha lesheshet hakkanim, shenne bakkane haechad kaftor vaferach, ushelosha lammenora shenne meshukkadim kaftoreha uferacheha, umiut perachim shenayim, veechad haamur befarashat behaalotcha ad yerechah ad pirchah, veim tedakdek bemishna zo hakketuva lemala, timtzaem keminyanam ish ish bimkomo:
Veammudav esrim. chamesh ammot ben ammud leammud:

Veadnehem. shel haammudim nechoshet, haadanim yoshvim al haaretz vehaammudim tekuin letochan; haya ose chemin kundasin shekkorin 410 belaaz, arkan shishsha tefachim verachban shelosha, vetabbaat nechoshet kevua vo beemtzao vechorech sefat hakkela sevivav bemetarim keneged kol ammud veammud, vetole hakkundas derech tabbato vaunkeliyyot shebbaammud heasuy kemin vav – rosho zakuf lemala verosho echad takua baammud – keotan sheosin lehatztziv delatot, shekkorin 359 belaaz, verochav hakkela taluy millematta vehi komat mechitztzot hechatzer:
Vave haammudim. hem haunkeliyyot:

Vachashukehem. mukkafin hayu haammudim bechute chesef saviv, veeni yodea im al pene chullan, im berosham, veim beemtzaam, ach yodea ani shechashuk leshon chagora, shekken matzinu befilegesh baggiva veimmo tzemed chamorim chavushim (Shoftim 19), targumo chashukim:
Et neroteha. kemin bazichin shennotnin betochan hashshemen vehappetilot:

Veheir al ever paneha. ase pi sheshet hannerot shebberashe hakkanim hayyotzim mitztziddeha mesubbim kelappe haemtzai, kede sheyyihyu hannerot keshettadlikem meirim el ever paneha – mussav oram el tzad pene hakkane haemtzai, shehu guf hammenora:
Lamma ze mechir beyad kesil liknot chachma. lilmod tora:
Velev ayin. veen belibbo lekayyemah, veeno lomed tora ella liknot shem:
targum: Lema den azla leh tagruta lesachla delet leh libba vechachmeta:

rashi: Michse laohel. leoto gag shel yeriot izzim ase od michse acher shel orot elim meaddamim, veod lemala mimmennu michse orot techashim; veotan michsaot lo hayu mechassin ella et haggag, arkan 30 verachban 10, ellu divre rabbi nechemya, uledivre rabbi yehuda michse echad haya, chetzyo shel orot elim meaddamim vechetzyo shel orot techashim (shabbat 28):
Michbar. leshon kevara, shekkorin kryblo belaaz, kemin levush asuy lo lammizbeach, asuy chorin chorin, kemin reshet; umikra ze mesoras vecho pitrono: veasita lo michbar nechoshet maase reshet:
Mimmennu tihyena karnotav. shello yaasem levaddam vichabberem bo:
Vetzippita oto nechoshet. lechapper al azzut metzach, shenne umitzchacha nechusha (Yeshayahu 48):
Sefat yeter. divre gaava:
Af ki lenadiv. vechol shekken shello nae sefat sheker lenadiv:
targum: La yae letafsha sifta yattirta af la leshalita sifta deshikra:

rashi: Bechol et ohev harea. leolam heve ohev reim, liknot ohavim:
Veach letzara yivvaled. leet hatztzara yivvaled lecha harea keach, laazor lecha ulehishtattef betzaratcha:
targum: Bechol idan gavra rachim hu veacha leakta mityelid:

rashi: Mibbayit umichutz tetzappennu. shelosha aronot asa vetzalel, shenayim shel zahav veechad shel etz, arba ketalim veshulayim lechol echad ufetuchim milmala, natan shel etz betoch shel zahav veshel zahav betoch shel etz vechippa sefato haelyona bezahav, nimtza metzuppe mibbayit umichutz (yoma amud bet):

Zer zahav. kemin keter mukkaf lo saviv lemala missefato, sheasa haaron hachitzon gavoah min happenimi, ad sheala lemul ovi hakkapporet ulemala hemennu mashshehu, ucheshehakkapporet shochev al ovi hakketalim, ole hazzer lemala mikkol ovi hakkapporet kol shehu vehu siman lecheter tora:

Karkov hammizbeach. sovev; kol davar hammakkif saviv beiggul karuy karkov, kemo sheshshaninu behakkol shochatin ellu hen galme chele etz kol sheatid lashuf ulecharkev, vehu kemo sheosim charitzin agullin bekarshe dafne hattevot vesafsale haetz, af lammizbeach asa charitz sevivo, vehaya rachbo amma vedafno lenoy vehu lesof shalosh ammot shel gavho kedivre haomer gavho pi shenayim kearko, ha ma ani mekayyem veshalosh ammot komato? missefat sovev ulemala, aval sovev lehilluch hakkohanim lo haya lemizbach hannechoshet, ella al rosho lifnim mikkarnotav, vechen shaninu vizvachim: e zehu karkov? ben keren lekeren; vehaya rochav amma, velifnim mehen amma shel hilluch ragle hakkohanim, shete ammot hallalu keruyim karkov; vedikdaknu sham vehachtiv tachat karkov hammizbeach millematta? lamadnu shehakkarkov bedafno hu ulevush hammichbar tachtav? veteretz hametaretz tere havo, chad lenoy vechad lakkohanim delo yistargu, ze shebbaddofen lenoy haya, umittachtav hilbisho hammichbar vehiggia rachvo ad chatzi hammizbeach, vehu haya siman lachatzi gavho, lehavedil ben damim haelyonim ledamim hattachtonim; uchenegdo asu lemizbach bet olamim dugmat chut hassikra veemtzao, vechevesh shehayu olin bo aappi shello fersho beinyan ze, kevar shamanu befarashat mizbach adama taase li velo taale vemaalot – lo taase lo maalot bechevesh shello, ella kevesh chalak, lamadnu shehaya lo kevesh; kach shaninu bammechilta. umizbach adama hu mizbach hannechoshet, shehayu memallein chalalo adama vimkom chaniyyatan, vehakkevesh haya bidrom hammizbeach, muvdal min hammizbeach melo chut hassaara, veraglav maggiin ad amma samuch lekale hechatzer shebbaddarom, kedivre haomer eser ammot komato, uledivre haomer devarim kichtavan – shalosh ammot komato – lo haya orech hakkevesh ella eser ammot, kach matzati bemishnat arbaim vetesha middot, veze shehu muvdal min hammizbeach melo hachut, bemassechet zevachim (daf 62) lemaduhu min hammikra:
Verichim. ketargumo abberin, uvelaaz ashepareysh:

Chamishsha lekarshe tzela hammishkan. ellu chamishsha 3 hen, ella shehabberiach haelyon vehattachton asuy mishte chatichot, ze mavriach ad chatzi hakkotel veze mavriach ad chatzi hakkotel, ze nichnas battabbaot mitztzad ze, veze nichnas battabbaot mitztzad ze, ad shemmaggiin ze laze, nimtza sheelyon vetachton shenayim shehen arbaa, aval haemtzai arko keneged kol hakkotel, umavriach miktze hakkotel vead katzehu, shenneemar vehabberiach hattichon vegomer mavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze, haelyonim vehattachtonim hayu lahen tabbaot bakkerashim likkanes betochan, shete tabbaot lechol keresh meshullashim betoch eser ammot shel gova hakkeresh – chelek echad min hattabbaat haelyona ulemala, vechelek echad min hattachtona ulematta, vechol chelek hu revia orecha hakkeresh, ushene chalakim ben tabbaat letabbaat kede sheyyihyu chol hattabbaot mechuvvanim zo keneged zo – aval labberiach hattichon en tabbaot, ella hakkerashim nekuvim beavyan, vehu nichnas bahem derech hannekavim shehem mechuvvanin ze mul ze, vezehu shenneemar "betoch" hakkerashim; habberichim haelyonim vehattachtonim shebbatztzafon veshebbaddarom orecha kol echad chamesh esre amma, vehattichon arko sheloshim amma, vezehu min hakkatze el hakkatze – min hammizrach vead hammaarav – vachamishsha verichim shebbammaarav orech haelyonim vehattachtonim shesh ammot, vehattichon arko shetem esre, keneged rochav shemona kerashim, kach hi meforeshet bimlechet hammishkan:
Kechol asher ani mare otcha. kan et tavnit hammishkan, hammikra hazze mechubbar lammikra shellemala hemennu veasu li mikdash kechol asher ani mare otcha:

Vechen taasu. ledorot (sanhedrin 16), im yovad echad min hakkelim, o keshettaasu li kele vet olamim, kegon shulchanot umenorot vechiyyorot umechonot sheasa shelomo, ketavnit ellu taasu otam; veim lo haya hammikra mechubbar lemala hemennu, lo haya lo lichtov vechen taasu ella ken taasu, vehaya medabber al asiyyat ohel moed vechelav:
ohc: Kechol asher vegomer. bappesikta (rabbati 16) amru: kesheamar Adonai lemoshe "veasu li" vegomer, nivhal moshe veamar lefanav: "halo hashshamayim usheme hashshamayim lo yechalkeluhu" vegomer, ad sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: "lo kemo sheatta sover, ella eshrim kerashim" vechulei, ad kan. vetzarich ladaat mi amad besod Adonai umoshe avdo ladaat kol haddevarim sheavru benehem, vahagam shekkol divrehem divre kabbala hem, im kol ze lo yibbatzer davar mehakketuvim.

Venire lomar ledivrehem zichronam livracha shehuksha lahem sheen mashmaut lakkatuv mimma nafshach: im hu nimshach lematta al ze hadderech "kechol asher vegomer taasu", lo haya lo lomar "vechen" betosefet vav ella "ken taasu", shehi gezerat techillat ma sheamar "kechol asher" vegomer. veim amro "kechol" chozer leamro "veasu li mikdash", lo haya lo lehafesik beamro "veshachanti betocham", ella haya lo lomar "veasu li mikdash kechol asher" vegomer, veachar kach yomar "veshachanti" vegomer. umimma shehikdim lomar "veshachanti", gilla Adonai ki gamar maamar kelalut hammitzva velo hutzrach lomar bah "kechol" vegomer, vesamach al ma sheyyodiennu kol perate hammaase shiur hakkerashim vechol hakkelim kemo sheamar achar kach. umimma sheanu roim shennimlach achar kach lomar "kechol" vegomer, hammaskil yavin shezze haya letzad devarim shennoldu baemtza, shezzulat ze mittechilla may savar shello amar "kechol", ulevassof may savar. venaskil ladaat ma hem haddevarim sheyyecholin lihyot baemtza, mehatteshuva atta yodea hashsheela, vehatteshuva hi kechol asher ani vegomer. ha lamadta shechashav yoter, vehassevara tatzdik uteammet ze, veyoter ze en lo shiur. levavcha yavin ki yeshnah litmiha, vehu amram sheamar "halo sheme hashshamayim" vegomer, veal ze hutzrach lahashivo veamar lo kechol asher vegomer, veherahu tavnit hammishkan beoto matztzav. vehakkatuv meid al ze meamro mare velo amar are leatid, veaz raa ki haya esrim kerashim vegomer. vetaam hariyya velo hispik bedibbur, avaer beezrat hashshem besamuch.

Vederech ze naale lehavin divrehem zichronam livracha (berachot noah,1) sheamru befasuk (Shemot 38:22) "uvetzalel vegomer asa et kol asher tzivva", afillu devarim shello amar lo rabbo hiskima dato vechulei. moshe tzivva livtzalel laasot kelim techilla veachar kach mishkan, amar lo betzalel: "minhag haolam laasot techilla bayit" vechulei. amar lo: "kach shamati mippi hakkadosh baruch hu, betzel el hayita, ki bevadday kach tzivva li hakkadosh baruch hu" vechulei, ad kan. vekashe ech yishkach moshe mitzvat Adonai, chas veshalom sheyyeamen alav davar kaze. ulehavin hainyan yesh lehair od ki kefi seder hakkatuv roani ki Adonai hikdim mitzvat hakkelim techilla, et haaron vechapporet ucheruvav, veachar kach hashshulchan, veachar kach hammenora, veachar kach hammishkan, umoshe emet udevarav emet, velamma chazar middevarav harishonim?

Achen lefi ma shepperashnu, ki kesheamar "kechol asher ani mare otcha et tavnit hammishkan", az beoto matztzav herahu hammishkan bitchilla, ucheshepperat lo perate hammaase hikdim hakkelim, veyesh baze shene derachim bedivre Adonai: haechad sheyyakdim hammishkan kammuvan mippasuk 1 dichtiv et tavnit hammishkan, uma shehikdim Adonai beseder hammaase et hakkelim, lo lehatechil bahem, ella shehitchil mimma sheggamar shehu tavnit hakkelim, vehashsheni shekkavvanat Adonai hu lehakedim hakkelim kasseder sheamar Adonai bifrate hammaase, vetaam shehikdim Adonai befasuk 1 lomar et hammishkan kodem hakkelim hu letzad shehattemiha shehayta lemoshe "shamayim usheme shamayim" vegomer kemo shekkatavti lemala, lo hayta ella al hammishkan, laze baa hatteshuva behoraat hammishkan ki katan hu, uveaggav hodia hakkatuv ki gam herahu im tavnit hammishkan tavnit hakkelim shehayu bo. veulay ki nitkavven gam ken lomar ki en tzorech sheyyihyu gedolim behafelaga, ucheshebba lesadder seder perate hammaase hikdim hakkelim.

Umoshe alav hashshalom mittechilla hichria beferush divre Adonai kederech sheni, uchesheddan lefanav betzalel hichria bisvara kadderech harishon. velaze timtza sheamar hammidrash (Pesikta rabbati) sheamar moshe "vadday kach amar li hakkadosh baruch hu", vetzarich ladaat lamma amar "vadday"? ella letzad shehayu lefanav shene derachim hannizkarim, umittechilla berer echad mehem, veatta chazar bo veamar bevadday ki haemet hu kidvar betzalel. vehinne letzad shello amar lo Adonai beferush et mi yakdim, lo yeamer al ze chas veshalom sheshshachach divre Adonai.

Veal yikshe beenecha lefi devarenu leshon hammaamar sheamar moshe: "kach shamati mippi hakkadosh baruch hu". en hakkavvana lomar sheamar beferush hikdim hammishkan, ella perush lefi seder haddevarim ken nishma.

Venishar latet tuv taam lamma hutzrach Adonai lehareoto et tavnit hammishkan, veulay ki letzad shello bau haddevarim ella teshuva ledivre moshe sheamar "shamayim usheme" vegomer, laze im haya meshiv Adonai eshrim kerashim vechulei, haya shomea moshe ki lo ba hashshiur ella lomar ki yekabbel veyitratztze Adonai bevayit katan kaze mibbeli lehateriach, veen bediyyuk shiur ze mitzva, velu yihye sheyyomar Adonai elav betzav latzav shello yosif, im kol ze adayin yeshno shehu letaam histappekut bammuat, asher al ken herahu Adonai tavnit hammishkan demut shehu lemala, uvaze yatzdik ki zo mitzvato lo lemala velo lematta.

Uvederech remez yirmoz hakkatuv beamro beseder ze shehikdim veshachanti betocham kodem amro kechol, lomar lo inyan gadol ki bechinat hakkedushsha vehaderagoteha lo begeder hammispar, ki gavoah meal gavoah ugevohim. halo timtza amram zichronam livracha (avot 3,7) echad sheyyoshev veosek battora shechina immo, shenneemar (Shemot 20:21) "bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi", veamru al shenayim ushelosha vachamishsha vaasara, vechol echad kefi haderagato. veamru od (Bereshit Rabba 74) sheen hashshechina shora al pachot mishshishshim ribbo, ki mittaam ze lo nittena tora lehaavot ad shehayu habbanim bemispar shishshim ribbo. mikkan takish vetadin ki haderagot hakkedushsha hem meechad ad shishshim ribbo, veze bivchinat hammispar uvivchinat haechut kamma haderagot meechad leechad ad en ketz. vechevan shekken, kaasher amar Adonai lemoshe sheyyishkon betochenu, lo yada moshe haderagot shel bechinat hashshochen kamma shiurah. laze nitchakkem Adonai vedibber elav kaddevarim haelle: veshachanti betocham kechol asher ani mare otcha, samach kechol asher vegomer lveshachanti, lomar ki otah bechina hamedabberet immo keshiur otah hammerkava asher haya marehu yishkon betocham. uchefi ze tihye niksheret tevat kechol vegomer im veshachanti vegomer.

Vechen taasu. hinne lefi ma shepperashti sheherahu tavnit hammishkan lomar kaze taasu, lo pachot velo yoter, al yikshe lecha, im ken lo haya tzarich lomar "vechen taasu", ki timtza sheamru bishvuot 17, 1 veze leshonam: echad hannichnas laazara vechulei sheen mosifin al hair vehaazarot ella bemelech venavi veurim vetummim vesanhedrin. mena hane mille? amar rav shimi amar kera: "kechol asher ani mare vegomer veet tavnit kol kelav vechen taasu" – ledorot. hinne ki vaa "vechen taasu" letzauot sheyyaasu kasseder hazze ledorot. veda shedderashat "ledorot" doresh lah hattalmud mittevat "vechen taasu", lo mittosefet vav levad, ki lichshennomar sheeno doresh ella yittur tevat vav, en kan yittur, ki im haya omer hakkatuv "ken taasu" lo haya nishma kavvanat hahodaa shebba hakkatuv lehodienu sheavru haddevarim ben moshe uven Adonai, veyihye kashe li lishmoa divre Adonai lamma lo amar "kechol" vegomer kodem amro "veshachanti", ella vadday shekkol tevat "vechen taasu" meyutteret. vechen peresh Rashi sham bishvuot veze leshono: vechen taasu, kera yetera lemidrash ledorot, ad kan. vetamo shel Rashi zichrono livracha lo mittaamenu, ella letzad shepperesh "kechol asher ani" vegomer shehu mechubbar lemala "veasu li mikdash vegomer kechol" vegomer, im ken hare ba haddavar leikkuv shello yachshov lehitnaddev laasot gadol, im ken "vechen taasu" lamma li? ledorot. uledarkenu shehalachnu leshitat divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha ki amro kechol vegomer ba lehashiv lemoshe ikkuv hashshiur mimma shehera lo kayyotze bo bashshamayim, mizze yargish shello yeshannu.

Veraiti leharav ibben ezra shepperesh "vechen taasu" al hakkelim, lefi shello huzkar bitchilla ella "veasu li mikdash". velo natan lev harav lomar taam shehutzrach lomar "vechen taasu" al hakkelim, velo hispik bema shemmetzavve besamuch al peratut kol hakkelim. bishlama ma sheamar "veasu li mikdash" hi kelalut hammitzva vetamah sheyyaase mikdash lishkon Adonai betocho, veachar kach amar ofne habbinyan, ma sheen taam ze tzodek bemaamar "vechen taasu" al asiyyat hakkelim, im lo shettomar kedivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheddarshu ledorot. velo yadati lamma maalim enav meor hachayyim asher heiru rabbotenu zichronam livracha.

Gam beenay yippale divre ramban zichrono livracha shehissig al divre Rashi sheamar "vechen taasu" ledorot, veamar: velo yadati im yihye ze emet sheyyitchayyev shelomo laasot kele bayit olamim ketavnit ellu, umizbach hannechoshet asa eshrim amma orech veesrim rochav" (divrei hayamim 2 4:8), ad kan. middevarav nire ki neelma millifne zichrono sugeyat massechet shevuot, sheddivre Rashi hem divre haggemara, uma makom lachlok al hattalmud. vehaya nire lomar shessover ramban ki ma sheamru bashshas "vechen taasu" ledorot, en hakkavvana al shiur hakkelim ella al devarim haamurim sham shetztzarich melech venavi vechulei veshivim veachat sanhedrin, veen devarav nirim, ki mi mefis. veod lidvarav ma makshe sham baggemara mimmeshichat kelim shemmekaddeshet kelim sheasa moshe velo bishar kelim sheasu zulat moshe, vehutzrach hashshas lehavi lahem reaya mehappasuk, vehaya yachol lomar ki lo lechol happeratim amar hakkatuv "vechen taasu" ledorot ella laddevarim shemmanu sham bammishna?

Ella shetztzarich leyashshev kushyat ramban mimmizbach hannechoshet sheasa shelomo. veraiti leharav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi sheratza leyashshev veamar ki en kavvanat "vechen taasu" al hashshiur mammash, ella al dugemat techunat habbinyan harochav beerech haorech vegova lefi erech arko verachbo, aval leinyan haggodel en kefeda. velaze keshem shemmizbeach sheasa moshe haya Adonai al Adonai, kemo chen asu ledorot merubba esrim al esrim. venistayyea harav middivre hattosafot beferek hazzorek (shabbat tzach:) shehikshu lema shennishma middivre hashshas ki rochav hammishkan haya eser ammot, minnayin lahem ze, vedilma rachbo achad asar ammot vechulei. veteretz rabbi yehuda demibbet olamim yalfinan lah, shehaya arko shishshim amma verachbo esrim, hachi nammi bammishkan rachbo shelish arko, uchetiv "vechen taasu", ad kan. vehiksha harav al ze, im ken lamma lo asa haggova shel hammizbeach kitchunat mizbach moshe sheasa shalosh gova lechamesh orech verochav, ulefi shiur ze yaale lemizbach shelomo shehayu bo esrim al esrim, shenem asar gova. veteretz ki kach baa hahalacha shello amar "vechen taasu" ella al orech verochav levad velo al haggova, ad kan.

Ulefi dati en divre harav nirim, ki ma shekkatav ki "vechen taasu" ledorot lo baa ella al techunat habbinyan velo al shiuro, lo yekubbelu haddevarim mippiv belo hochacha mehashshas. veim mechamat hakkushya, yoter yesh lehanniach haddavar betzarich iyyun millivdot middatenu devarim sheen lahem al ma sheyyismochu. uma shehochiach mitterutz rabbi yehuda, vegam alav ani dan, veod eno hochacha ki rabbi yehuda lo samach terutzo al derashat "vechen taasu". uma shekkatav harav behetek divre rabbi yehuda "uchetiv vechen taasu" enam middivre rabbi yehuda ella harav lehatzedik devarav amar ken. uferush divre rabbi yehuda hu ki gilluy milleta hu omer, ki mimma sherainu shehaya bevet olamim esrim al shishshim, vechan bammishkan yesh safek im haya esrim orech vaasara rochav o achad asar, yitgalle hassafek mibbet olamim. o efshar shehaya lahem ezo reaya lilmod seder ze mibbet olamim velo midderashat "vechen taasu". veze lecha haot ki lo hizkir rabbi yehuda derashat "vechen taasu" lechazzek terutzo. veod ma shehosif lehakeshot mehaggova veamar ki baa hahalacha mehar sinay shello neemar "vechen taasu" ella al techunat haribbua velo al techunat haggova leshiur haribbua.

Da ki nechleku rabbotenu zichronam livracha (zevachim 59:) rabbi yehuda verabbi yose. rabbi yose sover ki chol mizbechot hannechoshet, ben ma sheasa moshe, ben ma sheasa shelomo, ben ma sheasu bene gola vesheatid leheasot – kullan eser ammot gova shel kol echad mehem, veshalosh ammot shekkatuv battora – mekom hammaaracha levad, ad kan. usevara zo halacha hi (282 hilchot bet habbechira 82), vesugeyat perek shete hallechem (menachot 97.) kedaat zo maggedet. velisvara zo en kushyat harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi kushya kol ikkar, verabbi yehuda cholek vesover devarim kichtavan – shalosh ammot komato. vehinne kushyat harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi enah tzodeket ella lisvarat rabbi yehuda, umin harauy lo haya medabber devarav bederech peshitut shennire ki hem devarim muskamim asher lo chen hu. uma shetteretz harav zichrono livracha ki kach baa hahalacha vechulei, missugeyat shevuot lo mashma ken, mimma sheamar hashshas ammatanitin deen mosifin al haazarot vechulei mena hane mille, umetaretz rav shimi deamar kera "vechen taasu" ledorot, ad kan. hinne mimma sheshoel hashshas mena hane mille vehutzrach rav shimi letaretz, shema minnah ki hashshoel lo haya yodea derashat "vechen taasu" ledorot, umimmotza davar atta yodea ki lo haya yodea gam ken hahalacha sheamar harav shebbaa al haggova sheenah ledorot, sheim haya yodea hahalacha behechreach shehaya yodea derashat "vechen taasu" ledorot sheal mashmautah baa hahalacha. vechevan shekken, lamma lo hiksha hashshoel atzmo miggova hammizbeach shello asao shelomo keshel moshe, shehi kushyat harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi atzmah, shehare en lah terutz ella bahalacha shebbaa al ze, vahalacha zo lo yedaah hashshoel kannizkar. veyesh od lehochiach meomek hassugeya ki lo hayta halacha baze, vedivre harav shello bedikduk.

Vaani omer ki en kushyat ramban mehammizbeach shehaya esrim al esrim, velo kushyat rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi mehaggova kushya. vahare lefanecha barayta arucha beferek kadshe kadashim (zevachim sav,1) veze leshonam: tanu rabbanan, keren vechevesh visod veribbua meakkevin, middat arko umiddat rachbo umiddat komato enam meakkevin. vekaamar beshas mena hane mile? deamar kera "hammizbeach" leakkev, ad kan. hare ki mizbeach atzmo sheasa moshe yachol haya laasoto meesrim al esrim, vehaggova gam ken yachol haya laasoto yoter mishshalosh ammot. veim ken ma makom lekushyat harav mimmizbeach sheasa shelomo, ki hakkadosh baruch hu gilla ki en meakkev gova verochav veorech. vegam harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi zichrono livracha nelam meenav divre habbarayta, vechashav ki lo haya moshe yachol laasot hammizbeach beyoter mishshiur ze, vegam haggova tzarich sheyyihye chamesh al shalosh gova velo al yoter, vehutzrach letaretz shene hatterutzim hakkechushim. vehinne shatalti lecha etz shatul al mayim vetechezak bo bal timmot, ki amro "vechen taasu" hu al devarim hameakkevin bammizbeach medabber, shehem keren vechevesh visod veribbua kidkatane babbarayta, vegam shello yifchot mechamesh ammot rochav vechamesh ammot orech kemo sheamru sham beferek kadshe kadashim, uvilvad shello yafchitennu mimmizbeach sheasa moshe.

Ella shennishar lanu ladaat shear happeratim shebbammishkan hayu leikkuva, uvevet olamim lo hayu meakkevin. veadrabba, katav rambam beferek 1 mehilchot bet habbechira sheen bonim ella baavanim o bilvenim. vehinne havinoti bechol ma shekkatav rambam bemishpete bet elohenu, vaere ki bishlosha kelim katav shetztzarich sheyyihyu kemot kelim sheasa moshe bammidbar mammash, vehem: hashshulchan vehammenora umizbach hazzahav, vechen meforash beferek shete hallechem (menachot 99,2). aval shear kelim vetzurat habbayit en lakachat shiur ledorot mimmaase moshe bammidbar. ulefi ze haya nire lomar ki lo baa mitzvat "vechen taasu" ledorot ella bakkelim. veen ze emet, ki baggemara derashuhu leinyan kiddush haazara, veze yaggid sheggam al habbayit baa hammitzva ledorot. veod, gam bakkelim roani sheasa shelomo keruvim sheniyyim, umeshunnim harebe mikkeruvim sheasa moshe (Melachim 1 6), vechamma shinnuyim hayu bishar hakkelim.

Vehinne behasekala muetet bainyan en shum kushya kelal, ki yesh ladaat ki chol binyan habbayit vehakkelim lo asaam shelomo kefi asher nire been sichlo lefaer, ella al pi navi, vegam hannavi higgid ki lo divre nevuato higgid ella divre kabbalato, dichtiv bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 1 28:11) "vayyitten david lishlomo beno tavnit haulam vegomer vetavnit kol asher haya varuach immo vegomer hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil kol melechet hattavnit" vegomer, uchetiv od (Rashi divrei hayamim 1 28:12) "asher haya varuach immo kaasher herahu shemuel haroe", veamru zichronam livracha beaggadat shemuel (midrash Shmuel perek 15): rabbi yirmeya beshem rabbi shimon vechulei bet hammikdash mesarah hakkadosh baruch hu baamida lemoshe, umoshe mesarah lihoshua baamida vechulei, yehoshua mesarah lazzekenim baamida, dichtiv "vayyeesof yehoshua vegomer vayyityatztzevu" vegomer, zekenim mesaruha lanneviim baamida, neviim mesaruha ledavid baamida vechulei, david lishlomo vechulei, veomer "hakkol bichtav" vegomer melammed shennittena liddaresh, "miyyad Adonai" melammed shennittena bemasoret, "alay hiskil" melammed shennittena beruach hakkodesh, ad kan. hareta ladaat ki kol ma sheasa shelomo babbayit haya halacha lemoshe missinay, vehakkol katuv bassefer galuy ledorshe tora beruach hakkodesh.

Vechen timtza shekkatav Rashi beferush divre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 1 28:19), veze leshono: vehakkol darash shemuel min hattora beruach hakkodesh, kemo sheshshaninu har habbayit haya chamesh meot amma al chamesh meot amma, darash orech hechatzer mea vaamma verochav chamishshim bachamishshim vegomer yihyu chamesh meot al chamesh meot, ad kan. umin hassetam yihye kol hammaase nirmaz battora lammevinim beruach hakkodesh. ulefi ze ma sheamar hakkatuv "vechen taasu" ledorot hem al devarim shello ba alehem hahafkiyyut battora, kammusekol limvine madda beruach hakkodesh. baze yitnahagu al pi maase haamur bemishkan midbar, aval devarim shenneemru battora bemishpat mikdash olamim lo tihye lahem setira mippasuk "vechen taasu", kevan sheyyesh lo makom laamod bo bishar happeratim shello baa alehem hahalacha, vehaven.
Ulederech ze gam ken nirtak chevel kushyat ramban meal Rashi, vegam nitrappe keevo shel rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi beinyan shiur gova mizbeach, lu yehe shehaya gova mizbeach midbar meakkev.
