Veleheyot sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha shennittena lidrosh binyanah shel bet olamim min hattora, amarti littol chelek bidrasha zo bishnayim ushelosha peratim. veze yatza rishona: techillat dibber Adonai amar veasu li mikdash vegamar omer tavnit hammishkan, vehaya tzarich lomar "veasu li mishkan". ha lamadta ki al shene mikdashot tzivva, uchemo sheramaznu bitchillat hainyan. veramaz maasehu beamro chamishshim bachamishshim kemo shepperesh shemuel hannavi alav hashshalom, veim eno inyan lemishkan midbar tenehu inyan lemikdash olam haramuz beamro veasu li mikdash. umeatta maamar vechen taasu ledorot eno noheg bifrat ze shel shiur tavnit habbayit, veodennu bimkomo lishar devarim sheddarshu zichronam livracha bishvuot (shavuot 15,1) leinyan navi vesanhedrin vechulei.
Od matzinu (Melachim 1 6:23) sheasa shelomo shene keruvim sheniyyim nosafim al ma sheasa moshe, venimtzeu arbaa keruvim asher lo tzivva Adonai, gam meshunnim shinnuy gadol mikkeruve moshe.

Venire ki hakkatuv remazam bema sheamar (Shemot 25:18) "veasita shenayim keruvim vegomer mishshene ketzot hakkapporet, vaase keruv echad vegomer ucheruv echad" vegomer, vekashe lamma hutzrach lomar shete peamim hammaase "veasita" "vaase". od kashe shekkol hakkatuv meyuttar, ki meamro "mishshene ketzot hakkapporet" muvan hu shekkeruv echad mikkatza vegomer. od kashe lamma amar od "al shene ketzotav"?

Achen ramaz Adonai lemaase shene keruvim sheyyaasu bevet olamim millevad keruvim sheyyaase moshe. keneged ma sheyyaase lefi shaa amar veasita lenocheach ki hu yaase bammishkan, ucheneged keruve bet olamim sheramaz bitchillat devarav amar vaase, lo dibber elav lenocheach ella kimtzavve al asiyya acheret lizman acher, shemmillevad shene keruvim hannizkarim shehem mikketzot hakkapporet, od yaasu maase acher keruv echad mikkatza mizze, veellu hem bifne atzman kemo shekken asaam shelomo (Melachim 1 6:23-32) shehayu raglehem nogim baaretz velo biktze hakkapporet. uferush mikkatza bemakom shekkala ketzato, veulay shennitkavven betevat mizze lomar millevad ze vechozer el hakkeruv shehizkir. veachar kach chazar lehatenot hakkatuv veamar keneged keruvim sheyyaase moshe amar min hakkapporet, perush miggufo shel kapporet taasu et hakkeruvim shezzacharti bitchillat devaray shene keruvim. uchede shello tite shechozer el hakkeruvim hashsheniyyim, laze hizkir paam sheniyya taasu shello haya tzarich lomar shekkevar amar "vaase", ella lomar ki eno medabber bemaase shel keruve hammikdash ella bemaase moshe hu medabber, velaze amar lenocheach taasu. veod heir Adonai lahavincha ken bema sheamar et hakkeruvim shello haya tzarich lehazekiram kevan shebbahem hu osek, velo haya lo lomar ella taasem o taase otam, umeamro taasu et hakkeruvim gilla sheeno medabber bema shellefanav ella bema shellifne fanav kemo shepperashnu. veamro al shene ketzotav perush, tzarich sheyyaamdu al ketze hakkapporet, shello tomar hen emet sheyyihyu miggufo shel kapporet aval efshar sheyyeradded lahem raglehem veyaamidem baaretz velo al kapporet haaron, laze amar al shene ketzotav, perush sheyyihye haamadatam al ketzot hakkapporet mammash, ma shello hitna chen bashshenayim shel bet olamim.

Vahagam shettimtza shebbammaase sheasa betzalel amar hakkatuv keseder kol haamur, shennire shekkol haamur bakkatuv yeshno bemaase hammishkan shel midbar, veyishshevu rabbotenu zichronam livracha taam hakkefel shello tomar shettaase shenayim lechol katze vechulei, yeuyyan sham bedivre Rashi (Shemot 25:19). vehinne im lo haya letaam sheratza lirmoz al keruvim hashsheniyyim sheyyaase leatid, lo haya lo lichtov techilla setam "veasita shenayim keruvim" velachzor lehasir hattaut shello tachshov shenayim mikkol tzad, veyomar "keruv echad" vegomer, umittechilla haya lo lichtov "veasita keruv echad mikketze hakkapporet ucheruv echad vegomer taase otam". ella vadday shennitkavven lirmoz kemo shepperashti, ufeshat hakketuvim bimkomo munnach, ki halo timtza ma shepperash shemuel haroe befasuk (Shemot 27:18) "chamishshim bachamishshim" en ze peshat hakkatuv ella derasha, velo neekar happeshat. gam ledarkenu, hagam sheyyeshno lifshat hakkatuv, yeshnah ladderasha mikkoach hakkushya shehikshenu besamuch. veod timtza ki chan bemitzvat Adonai dikdek lomar tevat vaase ledayyek ma shepperashnu bah, ma sheen ken bemaase betzalel lo amar "vayyaas", yaspik beheara.

Umizbach hazzahav matzinu (Melachim 1 7:48) sheasa shelomo acher veganaz leshel moshe, kamforash bedivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (menachot 99,1) shehashshulchan vehammenora sheasa moshe yesh bo machloket im lo hayu mesadderin umadlikin (ella) bo o gam bishar shulchanot vehammenorot sheasa shelomo hayu mesadderim umadlikin lifamim baze velifamim baze, aval mizbach hazzahav davar muskam shennignaz velo shimmeshu ella beshel shelomo, vetzarich ladaat lamma ganaz shel moshe.

Venire ki hattora ramza haddavar bema sheakra seder mitzvat mizbach hazzahav mimmakom shehaya rauy letzauot alav, ki timtza ki mittechilla hitchil baaron shehu penimi penimiyyim, veachar kach hakkapporet, veachar kach hashshulchan, veachar kach hammenora, veacharehem hammishkan yeriav kerashav ammudav adanav, veacharav mizbach hachitzon, veacharav chatzar hammishkan, veacharav hashshemen uvigde sharet leaharon vekarbenot hachinnuch vehattemidin, veachar kol ze tzivva mizbach hazzahav. veyesh baze haregasha gedola beshinnuy gadol kaze, veramaz baze sheddino meshunne mikkol hammishkan vechelav, ki hammishkan vechelav harauy levet olamim yeshammesh levet olamim, kegon hashshulchan vehammenora kemo shekkatavnu lemala shehayu meshammeshim bevet olamim, umi sheeno rauy levet olamim kegon mishkan vechelim shello shimmeshu bammikdash, gam mizbach hachitzon shello haya bo hakepada ella beribbua uvammikdash hayu tzerichin laasoto gadol letzad hatztzorech, aval mizbach hazzahav hagam shello tishtanne avodato shehu haketarat chatzi mane babboker vachatzi mane baerev, af al pi chen lo yeshammesh bevet olamim, veasa acher ugenazo lachalutin ma shello asa chen beshulchan umenora sheasa moshe, shehagam sheasa asara – shel moshe ole al kullan. veinyan remizot maase bet olamim eno ella remez bealma.

rashi: Veasita masach. vilon, hu masach keneged happetach, kemo sachta vaado (Iyov 1), leshon magen:
Maase rokem. hatztzurot asuyot bo maase machat, kefartzuf shel ever ze kach partzuf shel ever ze:
Rokem. shem haamman velo shem haammanut, vetargumo ovad tzayyar velo ovad tziyyur. middat hammasach kemiddat happarochet – eser ammot al eser ammot:
Uvammenora arbaa geviim. begufah shel menora hayu arbaa geviim – echad bolet bah lematta min hakkanim, vehashshelosha lemala min yetziat hakkanim hayyotzin mitztziddeha:
Meshukkadim kaftoreha uferacheha. ze echad mechamishsha mikraot sheen lahem hechrea (yoma 52), en yadua im geviim meshukkadim o meshukkadim kaftoreha uferacheha:
Poter mayim reshit madon. hammatchil bimriva hu kefoteach chor begidre agfe ammat hammayim vehammayim yotzin bo, vehachor holech umarchiv. ken hammadon holech vegadel tamid:
Velifne hitgalla. kodem shettitgalla cherpatcha netosh et hariv (sanhedrin 6:):
targum: Ashed dema hech maya megare tigre ukedam itztadya ate dina:

rashi: Utechelet. tzemer tzavua bedam chillazon vetzivo yarok (menachot 44):
Veargaman. tzemer tzavua mimmin tzeva sheshshemo argaman:
Veshesh. hu pishtan.
Veizzim. notza shel izzim, lechach tirgem unkelos umeazze – habba min haizzim – velo izzim atzmam, shettargum shel izzim izzayya:
Nevuv luchot. ketargumo chalil luchin, luchot atze shittim mikkol tzad vehechalal veemtza, velo yehe kullo etz echad sheyyehe avyo chamesh ammot al chamesh ammot kemin saddan:
Leummat hammisgeret tihyena hattabbaot. baraglayim tekuot, keneged rashe hammisgeret:
Levattim levaddim. otan tabbaot yihyu vattim lehachenis bahen habbaddim:
Levattim. letzorech vattim levaddim, ketargumo – atra laarichayya:
ohc: Levattim levaddim. lefi ma shepperashti betabbeot haaron shetztzarich latzeket arba tabbaot ulekavam baaron, uvetoch hattabbaot yachnis shete tabbaot, uvetoch hattabbaot yitten habbaddim, kan amar ki eno tzarich laasot kacha, ella hattabbaot atzman hakkevuot hem yihyu battim labbaddim, vehaven:

rashi: Lechol kele hammishkan. shehayu tzerichin lahakamato ulehoradato, kegon makkavot litkoa yetedot veammudim:

Yitdot. kemin nigre nechoshet asuyin liriot haohel ulekale hechatzer, keshurim bemetarim saviv saviv beshippulehen, kede shello tehe haruach magbihatan, veeni yodea im techuvin baaretz o keshurin uteluyin vechavdan machbid shippule hayeriot shello yanuu varuach, veomer ani sheshsheman mochiach alehem shehem tekuim baaretz, lechach nikreu yetedot, umikra ze mesayyeeni ohel bal yitzan bal yissa yetedotav lanetzach (Yeshayahu 33):
Mechasse pesha mevakkesh ahava. im yecheta ish leish, veze mechasse alav veenennu mazkir lo chattato veeno mare lo panim zoamot, gorem lo sheyyohav oto:
Veshone vedavar. shennoter eva umazkiro: kach vechach asita li! miyyad:
Mafrid alluf. az mafrid mimmennu allufo shel olam shehu hakkadosh baruch hu, shehizhiro "lo tikkom velo tittor" (Vayikra 19:18):
targum: Dimchase chova bae rechimuta udeshane milta mefarek rachama:

rashi: Misgeret. ketargumo gedanfa; venechleku chachme yisrael baddavar, yeo lemala hayta saviv lashshulchan kemo levizbezin shebbisfat shulchan sarim, veyeo lematta hayta tekua meregel leregel bearba ruchot hashshulchan, vedaf hashshulchan shochev al otah misgeret:
Veasita zer zahav lemisgarto. hu zer haamur lemala, uferesh lecha kan sheal hammisgeret hayta:
Uleyarkete. leshon sof, ketargumo velisyafe, ulefi shehappetach bammizrach, karuy mizrach panim vehammaarav achorayim, vezehu sof, shehappanim hu harosh:
Taase shishsha kerashim. hare tesha ammot rochav:
Vahakemota et hammishkan. leachar sheyyiggamer hakimehu:
Horeta bahar. kodem lachen, sheani atid lelammedcha uleharotcha seder hakamato:
ohc: Vahakemota et hammishkan. peresh rabbi avraham ibben ezra sheyyomar ken lechachme lev vechulei. harav hiskil bichlalut mitzvat Adonai vechashav ki keshem shenneemru kol maaseha shel hammishkan lenocheach veachar haemet lo hu asa ella chachme lev, kemo chen tihye mitzva zo. velo chen hu leolam, ki chol ma sheyyetzavve Adonai benocheach lemoshe hu yaase veen zulato, zulat bemakom sheyyachzor Adonai veyomar beferush ki acherim hem haosim, az nomar ki taam sheddibber elav lenocheach hu lomar lo ki kevan shehu hammetzavve keillu hu haose. uchemaase kol hammishkan vechelav shehagam shekkinna haddavar elav, chazar vetzivvahu befarashat ki tissa "karati veshem betzalel vegomer veitto oholiav vegomer uvelev kol chacham vegomer veasu et kol asher tzivviticha", chazar vegilla haddavar ki lo yaase moshe davar bammelacha. aval hakamat hammishkan shello matzinu shechazar Adonai uferesh lo mi hammekim, hare ze yaggid ki haddevarim kichtavan ki hu yakim, vehu hekim dichtiv (Shemot 40:18) "vayyakem moshe et hammishkan" vegomer, hu levaddo veen ish itto, vehu divre chachamenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 52) veikkar, vezulato ikkar neekar.

rashi: Porse chenafayim. shello taase chanfehem shochvim ella perusim ugevohim lemala etzel rashehem, sheyyehe asara tefachim bechalal shebben hakkenafayim lakkapporet, kidita vesukka:
Sirotav. kemin yorot:

Ledashsheno. lehasir dishno letocham, vehu shettirgem unkelos lemispe kitme – lispot haddeshen letocham; ki yesh millot belashon ivrit milla achat mitchallefet bappitron leshammesh binyan usetira, kemo vattashresh sharasheha (Tehillim 80), evil mashrish (Iyov Adonai), vechillufo uvechol tevuati tesharesh (Iyov 31:12); vechamohu bisippeha poriyya (Yeshayahu 17:6), vechillufo mesaef pura (Yeshayahu 10:33) – mefashsheach seippeha; vechamohu veze haacharon itztzemo (Yirmeyahu 50) – shibbar atzamav; vechamohu vayyiskeluhu vaavanim (Melachim 1 21:13), vechillufo sakkelu meeven (Yeshayahu 62:10) – hasiru avaneha, vechen vayazzekehu vaysakkelehu (sham Adonai), af kan ledashsheno – lehasir dishno, uvelaaz adeshatzenaderayr:
Veyaav. ketargumo, migrafot shennotlim bahem haddeshen, vehen kemin kissuy hakkedera shel mattechet dak velovo vet yad, uvelaaz vavedayl:
Umizrekotav. lekabbel bahem dam hazzevachim:

Umizlegotav. kemin unkeliyyot kefufim, umakke vahem babbasar venitchavim bo umehappech bahen al gachale hammaaracha sheyyehe memaher serefatan, vvlaaz karevatzeynesh, uvilshon chachamim tzinnoriyyot (yoma 12):

Umachtotav. bet kibbul yesh lahem littol bahen gechalim min hammizbeach, lesetam al mizbeach happenimi lakketoret, veal shem chatiyyatan keruyim machtot, kemo lachtot esh miyyakud (Yeshayahu 30), leshon sheivat esh mimmekomah, vechen hayachte ish esh becheko (Mishlei 6):
Lechol kelav. kemo kol kelav:
Battabbaot. bearba tabbaot shennaasu lammichbar:
Meshukkadim. ketargumo, metzuyyarim hayu, kederech sheosin lichle chesef vezahav shekkorim nayyleyr belaaz:
Shelosha geviim. boltin mikkol kane vekane:
Kaftor vaferach. haya lechol kane vekane:

Ushene kerashim taase limkutzot. echad lemiktzoa tzefonit maaravit, veechad lemaaravit deromit, kol shemona kerashim beseder echad hen, ella sheellu hashshenayim enan bachalal hammishkan ella chatzi amma mizzo vachatzi amma mizzo nirot bechalal, lehashelim rachbo leeser, vehaamma mizze vehaamma mizze baot keneged ammat ovi karshe hammishkan hatztzafon vehaddarom, kede sheyyehe hammiktzoa mibbachutz shave:
Vechafalta et hayeria hashshishshit. haodefet beellu haelyonot yoter min hattachtonot:
El mul pene haohel. chatzi rachba haya taluy vechaful al hammasach shebbammizrach keneged happetach, dome lechalla tzenua hamechussa betzaif al paneha:

Yotzim mitztziddeha. lechan ulechan baalachson, nimshachim veolin ad keneged gavhah shel menora shehu kane haemtzai, veyotzin mittoch kane haemtzai ze lemala mizze, hattachton aroch, veshel mala katzar hemennu, vehaelyon katzar hemennu, lefi shehaya gova rashehen shave legavho shel kane haemtzai, hashshevii, shemmimmennu yotzim hashshishsha kanim:
Venoadti. kesheekba moed lecha ledabber immecha, oto makom ekba lammoed sheavo sham ledabber elecha:

Vedibbarti ittecha meal hakkapporet. uvemakom acher hu omer vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor (Vayikra 1), ze hammishkan, michutz lapparochet, nimtzeu shene chetuvim machchishim ze et ze, – ba hakkatuv hashshelishi vehichria benehem: uvevo moshe el ohel moed, vayyishma et hakkol middabber elav meal hakkapporet vegomer (Bamidbar 7), moshe haya nichnas lammishkan, vechevan shebba vetoch happetach, kol yored min hashshamayim leven hakkeruvim, umishsham yotze venishma lemoshe beohel moed (sifre):
Veet kol asher atzavve otcha el bene yisrael. hare vav zo yetera utefela, vechamoha harebe bammikra, vecho tippater: veet asher adabber immecha sham et kol asher atzavve otcha el bene yisrael hu:
Ach meri yevakkesh ra. kelomar: mi shekkol devarav meri vesarvanut hu yevakkesh ra tamid:
targum: Beram gavra merida vae vishta umalacha nuchezraya yishtader aleh:

rashi: Yeriot izzim. minnotza shel izzim:
Leohel al hammishkan. lifros otan al hayeriot hattachtonot:
Adam chasar lev tokea kaf. arevut mamon. davar acher: tokea kaf larshaim kede lalechet bedarchehem, vahare kevar orev arubba lifne reehu. kevar arav lehakkadosh baruch hu lishmor mitzvotav:
targum: Bar nash chasir rayana mashlem yedeh vearev arvuta al chavreh:

rashi: Ammudehem shelosha. chamesh ammot ben ammud leammud. ben ammud shebberosh haddarom haomed bemiktzoa deromit mizrachit ad ammud shehu min hashshelosha shebbammizrach chamesh ammot, umimmennu lashsheni chamesh ammot, umin hashsheni lashshelishi chamesh ammot, vechen lakkatef hashshenit, vearbaa ammudim lammasach, hare asara ammudim lammizrach keneged 10 lammaarav:
Lechem panim. shehayu lo panim kemo shepperashti, uminyan hallechem veseder maarchotav meforashim beemor el hakkohanim:

Techat geara vemevin. tachat zo taamo lemala battav, ma sheen ken bechol hammikra, lechach ani omer shehi shem davar kemo "chittat" (Bereshit 35:5), vechen perusho: hachenaat geara nikkeret bemevin yoter mimmea makkot shemmakkin et hakkesil:
targum: Ala baata veman demitbayin tav min dilmemche lesachla mea chuterin:
Vahava lishlomo shavin alfin denatlin bechatfa vetamnan alfin defaslin betura:
Veulama al appe hechla deveta asrin amin urekeh al appe futeya deveta asar amin puteya al appe veta:
Uvena yat asrin amin misyafe veta vemchitzat arzaya min ushaya ad katlaya uvena leh milgav levet keppore lekodesh kudeshaya:
Uvet kappore migo veta milgav atken lemittan taman yat aron keyama dayay:
Vaavad leveta kavin petichan milgav usetiman milvara vechafan kelinsa bet anchat reshe shiryat arzaya:
Uveta beitbenayuteh avnin shelemin matkas itbane vearzovin vecholilin kol man defarzel la ishtema beveta beitbenayuta:
Bar merabbane istartigaya dimmanan al evidta dishlomo telata alfin utelat mea dimfalchin beama deavdin baavidta:
Uvena shelomo yat beta veshachleleh:

Mechitzata arita chamesh amin futeyah umetziata shit amin futeyah uteliteta sheva amin futeyah are nefakta avad leveta sechor sechor levara min mechitzaya lemeheve reshe shiryata neyachin al zizya vela yehevyan shiryata meabberan bechatle veta:
Venisrin dearza chafe veta milgav ugelaf chezu vein veatunin shoshanin kol beta chafe nisrin dearza let avna mitchazya:
Uvena yat kotle veta milgav bimchitzat arzaya mearit beta ad kotlaya ad mate sheme sharyata chafe nisrin dearza milgav vachafa yat ushe veta bimchitzat birvan:
Ufaked malka vaakaru avnin ravrevan avnin yekaran leshachlala veta avnin pesilan:
Umane malka shelomo maske misin mikkol yisrael vahava maske misin telatin alfin gavra:
Min deakim libbeh la mashkach tavta udemithappech belishaneh nafal bevishta:
Ufesalu ardichle shelomo veardichle chirom vearguvelaya veatkinu aaya veavnaya lemivne veta:
Beta haden di at bane im tehach bikyamay veyat dinay tabed vetitar yat kol pikuday limhach behon veakim yat pitgamay imach di malelit im david avuch:
Uveta di vena malka shelomo kodam Adonai shittin amin urekeh veasrin puteye utelatin amin rumeh:
Tara dimchitzata arita petiach leibbar beta miyamina uvimsibbata salkin min arita leilita beorach metzieta:
Dematzde lemiskena margez levarye udechade letavra dechavreh la mizdakke:
Vahava vearba mea vetamnan shenin lemippak bene yisrael meara demitzrayim beshatta reviata beyerach ziv nitzanaya hu yarcha tinyana lemimlach shelomo al yisrael uvena veta kodam Adonai:
Dimzakke lerashia umechayev letzadika merachakteh delaha af tarvehon:
Vayay yehev chuchemta lishlomo kema demalel leh vahava shelama ben chiram uven shelomo ugezaru keyam tarvehon:
Uvena yat beta veshachleleh vetalel yat beta behanetuchin veela minhon sidra derichpat resheh shiryata arzaya:
Vearbein amin heve veta hu hechala lekivleh:
Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai im shelomo lememar:
Defarea bishta chalaf tavta la tifsok bishta min bayteh:
Veashre shechinti bego bene yisrael vela archek yat ami yisrael:
Veshalchinun lelivnan asra alfin yarcha mishtanan yarcha havo belivnan teren yarchin gevar beveteh vaadoniram memana al maske misin:
Demolid sichla chimutza dileh vela chade avuy detafsha:
Uvena yat teka al kol beta chamesh amin rumeh vetalel yat beta baae arzaya:
Uvena al katle veta ziva sechor sechor lehechala ulevet kappore vaavad mechitzaya sechor sechor:

bart: Akrav shel perumbeya. meteg varesen uferumbeya, echad hen. vehabbarzel hannichnas befi habbehema nikra akrav:

Ulechayayim. mechubbarim laakrav kemin shene tassin metzuyyarim, echad mikkan veechad mikkan al lechaye habbehema, asuyin lenoy. vehen tehorin keshehen bifne atzman, detachshite vehema ninhu, vetachshite vehema vechelim en mekabbelim tuma:
Teena shehi omedet bechatzer. ilan shel teena shehu omed bechatzer, vechatzer kovaat lammaaser:
Veim tzeraf. shetayim, chayyav:
Rabbi shimon omer achat bimino. afillu shalosh kehay gavna lo have tzeruf veshare. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Ala leroshah. lerosh hatteena:
Memalle cheko veochel. sham. uvilvad shello yorid lechatzer:
Baddaf hashsheni. sheetzlo berochav hammegilla:
Min hatztzad. baggillayon shel yemin hagget. o baggillayon hassemali:
O meacharav beget pashut. sheedav vetocho:
Hikkif. chibber ze etzel ze:
Shenehem pesulim. sheen nikret hachatima lo im ze velo im ze:
Et shehaedim nikrin besofo. sheggag chatima kelappe sofo, velo sheragle chatima kelappe rosho, kasher:

Haomer lachavero tze vekaddesh li ishsha felonit vehalach vekiddeshah leatzmo. amrinan baggemara may vehalach, shehalach berammaut. ulehachi tenan haomer lachavero velo tenan haomer lishlucho, leashmoinan deaf al gav delo asao shaliach mittechilla lechach, ella sheamar lo kaddesh li ishsha felonit, im kiddeshah leatzmo karinan beh shehalach berammaut verammay have:
Uva acher vekiddeshah betoch sheloshim yom mekuddeshet lashsheni. veyachol lechansah afillu betoch ellu hashsheloshim yom:

Bat kohen leyisrael. im bat kohen hi zot shennitkaddesha leachar sheloshim yom, kol otan sheloshim yom tochal batteruma, shello nifsela milleechol bitrumat bet aviha. veim bat yisrael lechohen hi, lo tochal batteruma, sheadayin enah eshet kohen:
Mekuddeshet. utzericha get mittarvayhu:

Hallokeach mayim umelach vechulei. mayim umelach en niknim bechesef maaser sheni, dichtiv (Devarim 14) venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha, kelal, babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar, perat, uvechol asher tishalcha nafshecha, chazar vechalal, kelal uferat uchelal i atta dan ella keen happerat, ma happerat meforash davar shehu ochel vegiddule karka, devakar vatzon gedelim min hatztzemachim shehem giddule karka, vetalush, vedavar hammitkayyem ad shemmolichan lirushalayim, af kol davar shehu ochel vegiddule karka vetalush vedavar hammitkayyem, yatzu mayim umelach sheaf al pi shehen ochel enan giddule karka, yatzu ferot hamechubbarim lakkarka, sheenan telushim, yatzu ferot hannirkavim kodem sheyyaggiu lirushalayim sheenan davar hammitkayyem, shekkol ellu en nikkachim bechesef maaser:
Lo kana maaser. velo chala kedushshat maaser al haddavar hakkanuy velo yatzu hammaot lechullin:
Hallokeach perot shogeg. shello haya yodea shemmikkesef maaser hu kone:

Yachzeru damim limkoman. hammocher lokeach perotav umachazir haddamim, mishshum dahave kemikkach taut, sheim haya yodea hallokeach shehem deme maaser lo haya lokeach bahem perot hallalu, mishshum torach hadderech, vechevan deshogeg hu batel mikkach:
Mezid. sheyyada shekkesef maaser hu:
Yoolu veyeachlu bammakom. asher yivchar Adonai, kelomar birushalayim:
Veim en mikdash yerakkevu. shehaddavar hakkanuy bechesef maaser eno nifde tahor berichuk makom, keditnan lekamman beferek 3:
Hamekaddesh bechelko. shechalak im echav hakkohanim:

Enah mekuddeshet. dechohanim mishshulchan gavoah ka zachu, veamar kera (Bamidbar 18) ze yihye lecha mikkodesh hakkadashim min haesh, ma esh en atta mishtammesh bo ella laachila, kach mattanot hallalu lo tishtammesh bahen ella laachila, uvemaaser ketiv laAdonai‏ hu, bahavayato yehe:
Rabbi yehuda omer mezid kiddesh. bemaaser sheni. hoil veyotze lechullin al yede fidyon, vahare hotzio lechullin al yede kiddushin hallalu. verabbi meir savar let derech chillul bechach:
Uvehekdesh. shel bedek habbayit:
Mezid kiddesh. shekkevan sheyyada shehu hekdesh vehotzio lachullin bechavvana, nitchalla kedushshato:

Uveshogeg. delo yada shehu hekdesh velo nicha leh delitchallel hekdesh al yedeh, lo nitchalla kedushshato, veenah mekuddeshet. verabbi yehuda savar ippecha. vahalacha kerabbi meir bemaaser, ucherabbi yehuda behekdesh:
Lo yimkor adam perotav vechulei. dekaavar mishshum velifne ivver lo titten michshol (Vayikra 19):
Veim bikkeru. im yesh bahen bakkurot shehiggiu leonat maasrot vehashshear lo higgiu, notlan umocher et hashshear:

Keren agulla vekeren peshuta. chatzotzrot mikkarne habbehemot asuyot perakim perakim mechubbarim, ella sheachat mehen tzuratah agulla veacheret peshuta. vechibbur happerakim shel agulla kashim utzerichim umman yoter mechibbur happerakim shel peshuta, umippene ze amru hammachazir keren agulla veshabbat chayyav chattat, ma sheen ken bifshuta:
Keren agulla temea. sheyyesh lah bet kibbul. vekeren peshuta tehora, sheen lah bet kibbul. vekarnayim din kele etzem yesh lahen, sheppeshutehen tehorim kifshute chele etz:
Metzuppit. mekom hannachat happe, vehu hakkatzar shebbah. milleshon omdim tzefufim:
Temea. dechashvinan lah kichle mattachot, veaf al pi shehi peshuta mekabbelet tuma:
Hakkav shellah. hatztzad harachav shebbah, im haya shel mattachot:
Rabbi tarfon metamme vachachamim metaharim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Kene menora tehorim. sheen lahem shem bifne atzman, utenan leel beresh pirkin kol keli mattachot sheyyesh lo shem bifne atzmo, tame:
Happerach. mekom moshav hanner shebberosh hammenora perach shemo:
Basis. ragle hammenora shehi yoshevet alehen:
Charchur. keli asuy kemin mara shechofrim bo et hakkarka, uvarzel shello mechuddad tefe lachtoch bo hashsharashim shello yeakkevu et hammachresha:
Sheyyinnatel rubbo. rov habbarzel o rov chissumo:
Mekofo. chor shemmachnis bo hakkata. kemo [berachot daf noah] kofa demachata:
Tahor. detu lo chazi limlacha kevan sheen yachol lehachenis bo vet yad:

Kurdom. mechuddad vechotech mishshene tzedadav. hatztzad haechad rachav umishtammeshin bo hannaggarim vekaruy ushpo, targum machrashto ushefeh. vehatztzad hashsheni katzar vekaruy bet bikkuo lefi shebbeoto tzad baale vattim mevakkeim etzim. uvaggemara vemassechet betza [daf lo] kore latztzad harachav nakvut shello, velatztzad hakkatzar zachrut shello:
Kasda. kova nechoshet shennotnim anshe hammilchama al roshan:
Ulechayayim. tassin shel barzel shennotnim al lechayehen:
Im yesh bahen bet kibbul mayim. sheshshotin bahem mayim bammilchama:
Kidon. romach katan shebbeyad hassarim vehammelachim:
Nikon. kemo kinon. leshon umishkal keno (Shmuel 2 21). vehu habbarzel shebbetoch haromach:
Maggafayim. batte shokayim shel barzel shennosin anshe hammilchama:
Tachshite nashim. af al pi sheen asuyin limlacha ella lenoy, merabbinan lehu mikkera dichtiv (Bamidbar lo) vechol asher lo yavo baesh taaviru vammayim:
Ir shel zahav. kemin atara notnot hannashim beroshan asuya chetzurat yerushalayim:
Katlayot. chutim shel zahav shennotnot seviv hatztzavvar. umippene shehaishsha choneket atzmah bahen kede shetterae baalat basar, lechach nikraim katlayot:
Unezamim. yesh mehen nizme haaf veyesh mehen nizme haozen:
Bechut shel pishtan. shehayu hachulyot nekuvot umilleu mehen hachut:
Hachulyot temeot. dechol chada veanpe nafsha chashiva cheli maase:
Shel avanim. shehayu margaliyyot vaavanim nekuvot umilleu mehen hachut:
Tame. hachut, hoil veshel mattechet hu:
Kimlo tzavvar ketanna. kimlo tzavvar shel bat ketanna:

Eved kenaani nikne vechesef uvishtar uvachazaka. dichtiv (Vayikra 25) vehitnachaltem otam livnechem [acharechem] lareshet achuzza, hikkish avadim lekarkaot, ma karka nikne bechesef bishtar uvachazaka, af eved kenaani nikne bechesef bishtar uvachazaka. vechezkat haeved, kegon shehittir minal lerabbo, o hinilo, o holich kelav acharav levet hammerchatz, hifshito, hirchitzo, sacho, gerdo, hilbisho, higbiho o shehigbiah harav et haeved, kenao:

Bechesef al yede acherim. sheyyittenuhu lerabbo al menat sheyyihye ze ven chorin. aval hu atzmo lo yekabbel mehem, vaafillu al menat sheen lerabbo reshut bo, dekasavar en kinyan leeved beshum tzad belo rabbo:

Uvishtar al yede atzmo. desavar chova hu leeved sheyyetze mittachat yede rabbo lecherut, sheim eved kohen hu, poslo milleechol batteruma, veim eved yisrael hu, osro beshifcha. umishshum hachi kaamar deeno yotze lecherut bishtar al yede acherim ella al yede atzmo, dechevan dechova hi lo en chavin leadam ella vefanav. vechesef deal yede acherim shane, shekken kabbalat rabbo garma lo lehishtachrer meelav, veen acherim hallalu chavin lo, ella kabbalat harav, veharav eno naase shelucho, ella letzorech atzmo, umaknehu meelav:
Vachachamim omrim bechesef al yede atzmo. dekasavre yesh kinyan leeved belo rabbo, hilkach kone et atzmo vechesef afillu al yede atzmo, vechol shekken al yede acherim:

Uvishtar al yede acherim. desavre zechut hu leeved sheyyetze mittachat yede rabbo lecherut, vezachin leadam shello vefanav. vahalacha kachachamim. vehaeved kenaani kone atzmo im simme rabbo et eno o hippil et shinno o kata mimmennu echad meesrim vearbaa rashe evarim, shehem [rashe] etzbeot yadayim, veetzbeot raglayim, verashe aznayim, verosh hachotem, verosh hazzachrut, verashe shadayim baishsha. veha dela chashiv lehu bematnitin bichlal haddevarim shehaeved kone et atzmo, mishshum dehayyotze verashe evarim tzarich get shichrur merabbo, vehayenu kone et atzmo vishtar:

Uvilvad sheyyehe hakkesef mishshel acherim. deeved en lo chelum, deaf metzia vekabbalat mattana hakkol lerabbo. veim ba lehippadot al yede atzmo tzarich lihyot hakkesef mishshel acherim sheyyittenuhu lo al menat sheen lerabbo reshut bo:
Kol mitzva sheenah teluya vaaretz. kol mitzva shehi chovat hagguf mikkere enah teluya vaaretz. veshehi chovat karka mikkere teluya vaaretz:
Chutz min haarla. shennoheget bechutza laaretz halacha lemoshe missinay. vechile hakkerem bechutza laaretz midderabbanan. vechile zeraim muttarin lezaram bechutza laaretz:

Rabbi eliezer omer af hechadash. asur bechutza laaretz min hattora, af al pi shehu chovat karka. shenneemar (Vayikra 23) bechol moshvotechem, bechol makom sheattem yoshvim. vahalacha cherabbi eliezer:
Koligrifon. keli shebberosho haechad kemin shinnayim shettochavin bappat o vabbasar umotziin oto min hattannur, uverosho haacher gorfin bo gechalim vaefer min hattannur:
Nittela chappah. hatztzad harachav heasuy kechaf sheggorfin bo haefer:
Temea. mippene harosh hashsheni sheyyesh bo hashshinnayim sheruyin letashmishan:
Michchol. rosho echad chad keen zachrut lichchol bo et haayin, verosho haacher rachav lenakkot bo et haozen:
Machtev. rosho echad chad kemachat lichtov al pinkas shel shaava, verosho haacher av vechalak limchok bo hakketav hechakuk bashshaava ulehachlikah, kede sheyyehe rauy lachazor velichtov bo:
Zomalistera. rosho echad kaf asuy lekabbel et hazzuhama min hakkedera ulehaavirah, verosho haacher keen mazleg lehaalot habbasar:
Vechen hashshen shel mader. berosho echad hofchim et hakkarka, uverosho acher mechabberim kele hammachresha ze im ze:
Shiur kullan. im nittal harosh haechad shetztzarich sheyyishshaer barosh hashsheni chede shiur bet achiza sheyyihye rauy laasot melachto:
Kele mattachot peshutehen temeim. delo ittakkash lesak:

Chazru letumatan hayeshana. chachamim gazru al kele mattachot shehittichan veasa mehen kelim chadashim, sheyyachzeru letumatan hayeshana. gezera shemma yomru sheviratan shel kelim metaharatan utevilatan metaharatan. ma sheviratan enah teuna haarev shemesh, shehare mishtamshin bahen beoto hayyom shennitmeu, ushevaran vechazar vaasaan chadashim, af tevilatan enah teuna haarev shemesh, veatya lemeevad teruma vekadashim bechelim shello heeriv shimshan:

Lo lechol tuma ella letumat hannafesh. rabban shimon ben gamliel savar detaama degazru al kele mattachot sheyyachzeru letumatan yeshana enah ella gezera shemma tishtakkach torat me chattat min hakkelim, sheen lecha adam mamtin shivat yamim ella shovran miyyad vechozer veose otan chadashim, hilkach lo gazru ella letumat met bilvad shetztzerichim hazzaat shelishi ushevii. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Bimsira. bealim mosrin otah lallokeach baafsar o besaarah:
Behagebaha. velo bimshicha:

Niknet bimshicha. veaf al gav deefshar behagebaha, mikkol makom niknet bimshicha, mishshum demissarcha, shehi mitchazzeket betzipparneha tamid leachez al gabbe karka. ufesak hahalacha, ben behema dakka ven behema gassa niknet bimshicha vechol shekken behagebaha. umeshicha kona besimta shehi zavit shel reshut harabbim, uvechatzer shel shenehem. umesira kona birshut harabbim, uvechatzer sheenah shel shenehem. vehagebaha kona vechol makom. vechol ma sheddarko vehagebaha eno nikne ella vehagebaha. vedavar hannikne vimsira eno nikne vimshicha. vechen davar hannikne vimshicha eno nikne vimsira:
Hammechulchelet. mitnanaat umitnadnedet, leshon vattitchalchal hammalka:
Rabbi yehuda omer matztzelet. dachashiv lah tzamid patil hoil veenah yotzet:
Vachachamim omrim enah matztzelet. dechevan demitchalchelet lav tzamid patil hu. vahalacha kachachamim:
Haya vet etzba. shel megufa meshukka venichnas letoch hechavit, chashiv hashsheretz shebbetochah keillu hu vetoch hechavit. uvet etzba hu hammakom min hammegufa sheadam machnis etzbao letocho:
Ochalim shebbetochah. shebbetoch bet etzba hashshokea venichnas letoch hechavit:
Temeim. dimgufat hechavit kechavit damya:
Shel zahav venimtza shel kesef kulei. deikka denicha lah beha veikka denicha lah beha:

Rabbi shimon omer im hitah leshevach hare zo mekuddeshet. lo falig rabbi shimon ella al shevach demamon, demissetama nicha lah beoto shevach. aval al shevach deyochasin, kegon levi venimtza chohen, mode rabbi shimon daafillu hitatu o hita hu otah leshevach enah mekuddeshet, delo nicha lah bishvacho mippene shemmitgae aleha. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Kol haose mitzva achat. yetera al zechuyyotav, kede sheyyihyu zechuyyotav merubbin meavonotav:
Metivin lo umaarichin lo yamav. laolam habba:
Venochel et haaretz. eretz hachayyim:
Vechol sheeno ose mitzva achat. shehayu avonotav merubbin mizzechuyyotav, veeno ose mitzva achat sheyyihye mechetza zakkay umechetza chayyav, ella nisharu avonotav merubbin:
Velo vederech eretz. sheen massao umattano benachat im habberiyyot:
Eno min hayyishshuv. eno moil leyishshuvo shel olam. vahave moshavo moshav letzim, ufasul leedut:
Hammaatan. makom shetztzovrin sham hazzetim kede sheyyitrakkechu veyihyu reuyot lehotzi shamnan:
Tovel echad echad bemelach. sheen kovea ella vemelach vetzeruf shetayim, hilkach im malach venatan lefanav chayyav:
Min hammaatan hattahor chayyav. uchegon shehaadam hannotlan tame, shei efshar lo lehachazir et hammotar, shekkevar nitmeu kol otan shennatal beyado:
Min hattame patur. shekkevan shehammaatan kullo tame [vehaadam] hannotlan tame hare hu machazir et hannotar:
Hallokeach behema lezivche shelamim. mimmeot maaser sheni, shekkach hu ikkar mitzvat meot maaser sheni liknot mehem shelamim, deyalfinan sham sham ligzera shava mehar eval:
Vechayya. sheenah reuya lehakerava, ukenaah mimmeot maaser sheni leechol otah besar taava, kelomar chullin:
Yatza haor lechullin. veen tzarich leechol damav birushalayim:

Yatza hakkankan lechullin. veen tzarich lemachro veleechol damav bikdushshat maaser birushalayim. vehanne mile keshehammocher vehakkone hedyotim veen notnim enehem ella babbasar leechol uvayyayin lishtot, aval im echad mehem umman leabbed orot, o yotzer cheres, deachshav vadday noten enav baorot o vakkankannin, naasa kekone ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo, velo yatzu lechullin:
Hattemed. pesolet shel anavim shennatan alehem mayim:
Eno nilkach bechesef maaser. dechashiv kemo mayim, vaanan bainan peri mipperi vegiddule karka:
Nilkach bechesef maaser. dechevan shehechmitz chashiv ochel, vehu derama telata veashkach arbaa:
Notel et haeshkol. ochel kedarko veen tzarich legarger, vechen berimmon en tzarich lifrot, vechen baavattiach en tzarich lispot, dehaynu lachtoch chatichot dakkot:
Rabbi akiva omer vechulei. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Kusbar. kach shemah baaravi, vehu zera gad, uvelaaz 416:
Mekarsem. mechattech:
Sea. baaravi 143, uvelaaz 142:
Ezov. baaravi 677:
Vehakkoranit. baaravi 309, uvelaaz 520:
Im hayu nishmarim chayyavin. deen chayyav bammaaser ella ochel venishmar:

Tabbaat adam. kegon tabbaat shel etzba. aval tabbaat shehitkinah lachgor bo matnav velikshor bah ben ketefav, tehora, vehayenu tabbaat kelim. vetaama, mishshum delo rabbe kera letuma ella tachshite adam velo tachshite vehema vechelim:
Korat hachitztzim. it dimfarshe ashpa shehachitztzim munnachim bah, veit dimfarshe hammattara lachetz:

Veshel asirin. osin kemin pegima vakkora lehachenis bah regel adam [umannichin etz aroch al gabbah] veen yachol latzet. uvilshon mikra korehu sad, vetasem bassad raglay (Iyov 13). vekorot shel chitztzim veshel asirin haamurin kan, demattechet ninhu velo shel etz:

Kolar. shennotnim betzavvar haasirim. [vehu soger]. targum vayyittenuhu vassugar (Yechezkel 19), bekolarin. umishshum dekolar asuy sheyyissaennu immo vechol makom sheholech, chashuv keli maase tefe mikkorat haasirim sheeno zaz bah mimmekomo, hilkach kolar tame:
Sheyyesh bah bet neila. osim lashshalshelet bet neila [venotnim otah beregel hassusim] vesogrim bemafteach, vachashiva keli:
Lichfita. shalshelaot shekkoftim bahen hakkof vegure hakkelavim hakketannim. ulenoy hen asuyin vahavu tachshit divhema velo mittamme:

Sitonot. socharim gedolim shemmochrim bemidda gassa. veyesh lahen shalshelet shekkovim beroshah echad hammidda, sea o tarkav, veroshah hashsheni notnim betabbaat shebbaddelet o vakkora, vesogrim aleha bemafteach kede shello tigganev hammidda:
Veshel baale vattim tehora. distama asuya lenoy vetachshit lakkeli:
Mafteach echad. mechulya achat. deshalshelet bechulya achat lo avde eynashe, vela chashiva cheli:
O shekkashar chillazon beroshah. kidmut chillazon shehu dag shebbayyam shemmiddamo tzovim hattechelet kashar lah beroshah asuy mibbarzel, vehu meshavve la mana:
Kol hannaase damim beacher. mefaresh baggemara kol hannishshom damim beacher, kol davar sheim ba letitto damim beacher tzarich leshumo, dehaynu kol mittaltelin bar mimmatbea:

Kevan shezzacha ze. kelomar kevan shemmashach haechad nitchayyev haacher bachalifin bechol makom shehem im metu o avdu, veaf al pi shello mashach, lefi shebbimshichat hammocher et hassudar o et hachefetz, nikne hammikkach lallokeach bechol makom shehu. veaf al pi sheen bachefetz shekkonim bo shave feruta. uvilvad shello yihye matbea o ferot, sheellu en konin bahem. vechol haddevarim niknim bachalifin, mittaltelin avadim vekarkaot, chutz mehammatbea sheeno nikne bachalifin, mishshum dedateh deenash atztzureta dematbea lo al gufeh, vetzureta avida devatla. lefichach im lakach adam matbea belo mishkal uvelo minyan, veamar ellu chalife sade felonit, o eved peloni, o chefetz peloni, kevan shemmashach ze, nitchayyev haacher bachalifav, deha galle dateh delav atztzureta kafed hoil velo shakal velo mana. veen shum derech sheyyoil bikniyyat hammatbea hecha deleteh beeneh, ella lehakenoto aggav karka:

Reshut haggavoah bechesef. gizbar shennatan maot bivhema letzorech hekdesh, afillu hi vesof haolam, kana. uvehedyot lo kana ella bachazaka, kelomar ad sheyyimshoch. veim natan hahedyot damim al hachefetz, kol zeman shello mashach hachefetz lo kana, umachazir hammocher et haddamim im chozer bo mimmechirat hachefetz, vetzarich lekabbel alav mi sheppara. aval im mashach hallokeach hachefetz, af al pi sheadayin lo natan haddamim shehitna, en shum echad mehem yachol lachazor bo. veim lo natan damim velo mashach hachefetz, ella shennitpashru al hammikkach bifne edim venitratztza ze sheyyikne bechach vechach, venitratztza chavero limkor bechach uvechach, afillu amar attem eday, en beelle haddevarim kelum, vaafillu mi sheppara en kan:
Amirato laggavoah kimsirato lahedyot. haomer shor ze ola, bayit ze hekdesh, afillu besof haolam, kana. uvehedyot lo kana ad sheyyimshoch babbehema, veyachazik babbayit:

Af al pi shehen shel chatzer hachayyavet. veheela happerot laggag derech chatzer, af al pi chen lo tavle, hoil uveshaa shehichnisan lechatzer haya vedato lehaalotan uleachlan baggag. vehanne mile kesheyyesh baggag arba ammot al arba ammot, aval im en baggag arba ammot al arba ammot, batel legabbe chatzer:
Bet shaar. etzel petach hechatzer:
Achsadra. mukkefet mishshalosh mechitztzot umekura lemala:
Mirpeset. makom lifne haaliyyot, veyotzim min haaliyyot lammirpeset, umin hammirpeset yordim besullam lechatzer:
Sheyyesh lo shem bifne atzmo. shehu yadua venikkar umeyuchad bishmo:
Tame. ben yesh lo bet kibbul ben en lo bet kibbul:
Hanneger. yated shel barzel shennoetz rosho echad bakkarka verosho hashsheni achore haddelet. i nammi, kemin ammud shessoger umavriach haddelet min hakkatze el hakkatze:
Manul. kol davar shennoalim vesogrim bo haddelet nikra manul. vedugmato bammikra beshir hashshirim (perek 5) al kappot hammanul:
Pota. kemin kos katan shel barzel kovim baaretz, vetzir haddelet sovev alav kede sheyyehe noach lehippateach ulehissager. vedugmato vammikra (Melachim 1 7) vehappotot ledaltot habbayit happenimi:
Vehatztzinnor. 191 belaaz:
Shennaasu lakkarka. lehishtammesh bakkarka. vechol hamechubbar lakkarka hare hu chakkarka veeno mekabbel tuma:
Kikdera millematta. rachav millematta veyesh lo vet kibbul:
Vechaadasha milmala. al rosh hannezem millemala yesh lo garin shel zahav o shel kesef asuy kaadasha:
Venifrak. haadasha min hakkedera:
Hakkedera temea. shehare yesh lah bet kibbul. velo mippene shehi mittachshite nashim, shehare enah reuya letachshit kemot shehi:
Vehaadasha temea. sheyyesh lah shem bifne atzmah:
Tzinnora. rosh hannezem hannichnas benekev haozen o venekev haaf. ulefi shehu asuy kemazleg karuy tzinnora. targum mizlegotav tzinnoryate:
Tehora. sheen lah shem bifne atzmah:
Heasuy kemin eshkol. nezem heasuy arbaa o chamishsha gargerin ze al gabbe ze kemin eshkol:
Venifrak tahor. sheen lechol gargir vegargir shem bifne atzmo, vehu eno rauy letashmish mishshennifrak:
Shellanu. linat layla:
Haarema hachayyevet. hakkeri shennitchayyev bammaaser, kehahi ditnan beferek kamma veim eno memareach mishsheyyaamid arema:
Hamekallef. mesir kelippatan:
Mekallef achat achat. seora achat. vedavka kesheeno samuch laggoren, aval im haya samuch laggoren afillu killef yoter patur, mippene shehu machazir et hammotar:
Hammolel melilot. hamehavhev shibbolin baur umemaachan beyado lehasir happesolet:
Menappe. lehaferiach hammotz:
Miyyad leyad. menaaran miyyado achat leyado haacheret:
Yarkah patur. shehazzera ikkar, veyarkah lo chashiv ella im ken kivven leyarak:
Mitasseret zera veyarak. chayyav leasser, ben achal hazzera, ben achal healin yarak kemot shehen:
Hashshevet. kach shemah baaravi, uvelaaz 76:
Vezerim. zemorot. vaafillu zeraah setam mitasseret zera veyarak vezerim, lefi shehashshevet osa zemorot arukkot. aval hakkusbar enah mitasseret zerim ella im ken zeraah techilla lezerim:
Eno mitasser zera veyarak. im zara setam velo feresh:
Hashshechalim. baaravi chav el shear, uvelaaz 666:
Haggargir. kach shemo baaravi, uvelaaz 221. vahalacha kachachamim:
Barzel tame. shebba mishshivre chelim:
Shebbelalo. shetterafan ze vaze vehittichan veasa mishshenehem keli:
Barzel tahor. shebba min haeshet umin hacharara vechulei:
Im rov min hattame tame. dechozer letumato hayeshana:
Hachalama. tit haddavek keloven betza:

Umin haggelalim. sheerev hattit im gelale habbakar veasa mehen kelim utzerafan bakkivshan. im rov min hachalama. mekabbelim tuma kedin kele cheres. veim rov min haggelalim, tehorim, dichle gelalim en mekabbelin tuma:

Kelostera. hanneger shel haddelet. vehu hayyated shennoalim bo haddelet kidfareshna leel, regilim laasot berosho chemin tappuach, vehu nikra gelostera. veim naasa mibbarzel tame, chozer letumato hayeshana, lefi sherauy laduch bo shumin bimdocha:
Umetzuppa tehora. im hayta shel barzel tahor umetzuppa shel mattechet tame, tehora, devatar ikkara azlinan velo vatar hatztzippuy shehu shel mattechet tame:
Happin vehappurena. shinnayim hakkevuim bappotachat, vehappin nichnas betoch happurena:

Shomtah mippetach ze vetolah bachavero. al yede gerira vilvad, detiltul min hatztzad hu. aval tiltul gamur, lo. verabbi tarfon share afillu tiltul gamur ki archeh. veshemma ata tanna leashmeinan hacha diklostera temea ditnan baresha lav divre hakkol hi ella pelugta derabbi yehoshua verabbi tarfon, dilrabbi yehoshua tehora, dechi hechi dela meshavve la mana leinyan shabbat hachi nammi lo meshavve la mana leinyan tuma:
Maaser sheni en mochrin oto. afillu leholicho lirushalayim, lefi shehu kodesh. usetam matnitin kerabbi meir deamar maaser [sheni] mamon gavoah hu:
Veen machalifin oto. lo yomar lo helach yayin veten li shemen, shemen veten li yayin:
Veen shoklin kenegdo. sela shel chullin keneged sela shel maaser sheni, mishshum bizzuy mitzva:
Velo yomar adam lachavero birushalayim. leel ayre chutz lirushalayim, vehacha kamashma lan daafillu virushalayim shekkonin bedamav maachol umishte eno rashshay lehachalif:
Vechen shear kol happerot. afillu otan perot demaaser didhu lo have ella midderabbanan:
Aval notnim ze laze mattenat chinnam. kegon shemmazmino leechol immo al shulchano. vedivre hakkol hi, aval latet lo bemattana mammash ledivre haomer mattana kemecher asur:
Eved ivri nikne vechesef. dichtiv (Vayikra 25) mikkesef miknato, melammed shehu nikne bechesef:

Uvishtar. shenneemar beama haivriyya (Shemot 21) im acheret yikkach lo, hikkishah hakkatuv leacheret. ma acheret bishtar, af haama bishtar. veyilmod eved ivri meama haivriyya, dichtiv (Devarim 15) haivri o haivriyya, makkish ivri leivriyya:
Bashshanim. lesof shesh shanim yetze chafshi, vaafillu hayta shemitta betoch shesh shanim, oved, dichtiv (Shemot 21) shesh shanim yaavod uvashsheviit. peamim shehu oved bashsheviit:
Uvayyovel. im paga yovel betoch shesh shanim, motzio:

Uvegiron kesef. dichtiv beama haivriyya (sham) vehefdah, vehukkash ivri leivriyya, im kenao rabbo beshesh manim vehu atid latzet lesof shesh, nimtza kone avodat kol shana bemane, keshebba lifdot atzmo megarea lo rabbo mippidyono deme avodat hashshanim sheavad:
Yetera alav ama. shekkona atzmah bechol elle uvesimane naarut, kidyalfinan mivyatza chinnam, ribba lah yetzia lazo, sheotza vesimanim:

Uvemitat haadon. dichtiv vaavado leolam, lo velo labben. aval hannimkar umet haadon betoch shesh, oved labben, dichtiv shesh shanim yaavod, ben lo ben livno. vedavka leven oved kol shesh im met haadon, aval levat uleach velishar yorshim eno oved, dichtiv (Devarim 16) vaavadcha shesh shanim, lecha velo layyorshim. veama haivriyya kona atzmah bemitat haadon kannirtza, dichtiv gabbe nirtza (sham) veaf laamatcha taase ken:
Chavit shennitkallefa. chavit zefuta mibbifnim venittal cheres mimmenna mibbachutz, vehazzefet omed kenegdo mibbifnim:
Kevotim. kankannim shel cheres shemmannichin bahen muryas nikraim kevotim:
Sheggefatan. shekkissa otan bemin sid shekkorin gippesim ditnan leel shemmakkifin bo:
Im hassafa. lematta missefat hakkeli, shennimtza hatztzamid patil mibbifnim vehassafa megulla mibbachutz:
Rabbi yehuda omer en matztzilin. dekasavar tzamid patil alav ketiv, velo tzamid patil mittocho. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Masmer haggara. izmel shel umman hammakkiz dam. venikra gara al shem shemmegarea et haddam. veyesh mefarshim, masmer shel nappachim shekkavua lahen masmer bassaddan, keshemmesallekim chaticha shel barzel min haesh verotze lachtoch mimmenna mannichah al hammasmer umakke vakkurnas venigraat:
Even hashshaot. even sheyyesh bah kavvim ureshumim alehem shemot hashshaot, umasmerim techuvim bah shebbahem mechavvenim et hashshaot:
Masmer haggardim. masmer aroch shehaoreg machnis bekane dak umechabber al hakkane et hammatve:
Aron shel garosot. haosin gerisin shel pol barechayim shellahen yesh lahen kemin aron shel etz:
Rabbi tzadok metamme. oto aron, detorat keli alav:
Vachachamim metaharin. dichli etz heasuy lenachat hu veeno asuy littaltel. verabbi tzadok savar, peamim metaltelin oto letakkeno. veen halacha kerabbi tzadok:
Hayta agala. shehaaron munnach aleha, shel mattechet:
Temea. shehare hi asuya letashmish:
Tetze shello vichtubba. deamar i efshi veishsha nadranit. aval gitta baya missafek, kevan delo peresh, dilma dateh nammi annadranit:
Happoslim bakkohanim. meforash bichtubbot [daf 75]:
Lefasin. kemo ilpasin. machavot gedolot shel barzel shemmevashshelin bahen:
Vesiftotehen shavot. sheen sefat achat mehen gevoha mechavertah:
Baelyona. hi happenimit shehachitzona tachteha:

Hi temea kulei. im hashsheretz baelyona, ochalin shebbattachtona tehorin, derachamana amar (Vayikra 11) kol asher yippol el tocho, velo el toch tocho, vehashsheretz shebbaelyona toch tocho detachtona hu. veim hashsheretz battachtona, lo nitmeu hoochalim shebbaelyona, derachamana amar (sham) kol asher betocho yitma, velo shebbetoch tocho:
Hayu vechones mashke. kelomar nekuvim bechones mashke dehaynu chede tohoratan, deilpasin asuyin lemashkim uleochalin, umetilin oto lechumro bechones mashke:
Hashsheretz baelyona. dehaynu happenimit:
Kullan temeot. deroin et hashsheretz keillu hu vechol achat, kevan dinkuvot bechones mashke:
Battachtona. dehi hachitzona:

Hi temea vechullan tehorot. deen tuma nichneset derech shulav. umihu im hayu ochalim umashkim bappenimit, nitmeu, kevan delo merach hannekev kidmuchach leel beferek shemini. vehayenu taama, mishshum denikkav bichde tohorato nechshav kaavir shel chitzona, voochalim umashkin mittammein meavir keli cheres veen adam vechelim mittammein meavir keli cheres:
Hashsheretz baelyona. hasheta mayre bilfasin shelemot:
Hi vehattachtona temea. dichmunnach betochah dame kevan deodefet. aval emtzait tehora, deen keli mittamme baavir keli cheres:

Kol sheyyesh bo mashke tofeach tame. nitma mashke tofeach shebbetoch hakkeli haemtzai meavir keli cheres, vechazar hammashke vetimme et hakkelim. derabbanan gazru al mashke sheyyetamme cheli, gezera mishshum mashke zav vezava. vehu haddin dahave matze leashmoinan chiddush ze shel mashke tofeach baresha keshehashsheretz baelyona vehattachtona odefet veyesh mashke tofeach baemtzai:

Hakkovesh. yerakot o zetim bechometz o veyayin, vechen hashsholek o hammoleach, af bassade chayyav. shehaur vehammelach vehammikkach vehatteruma vehashshabbat vehechatzer hammishtammeret, kol echad meellu kovea lammaaser:
Hamechammen baadama. hammatmin perot tachat hakkarka kederech shergilin lehatemin perot sheen mevushshalim kol tzarkan kede sheyyitbashshelu:
Vehametabbel. perot bemelach o vetzir o vechometz veochel, patur, veeno kovea lammaaser kemo hakkovesh o hammoleach, ella ochel mehen achilat aray ufatur min hammaaser:
Happotzea zetim. memaech vechotesh otam kede sheyyetze hasseraf, dehaynu hammerirut shellahen:
Hassochet zetim al besaro. lasuch gufo:
Letoch yado chayyav. dema shennatan letoch yado nechshav keillu natan letoch bor katan, dehaynu hachafira shehayyayin vehashshemen yordim bah:

Hamekappe letavshil. hashshole pesolet shemmaale hayyayin beet retichato nikra mekappe, veim achar shennatan yayin battavshil hesir mealav hachartzannim vehazzaggim hatztzafin lemala, kippuy aray hu ze veeno kovea lammaaser kishar mekappe yayin bealma. uvetavshil tzonen ayre, dei betavshil roteach ha amrinan shehaur kovaat lammaaser, uvelo hakepaa haya nikba lammaaser mechamat haur:
Likdera. rekanit, kodem shennatan letochah hattavshil natan betochah yayin vehikpahu, hava leh kimkappe bevor katan vechayyav:
Hamekaddesh bearla vechulei‏ enah mekuddeshet. dechullehu issure hanaa ninhu. arla, dichtiv lo yeachel, echad issur achila veechad issur hanaa bemashma:
Uvechile hakkerem. dichtiv (Devarim 22) pen tikdash, pen tukad esh:
Uveshor hanniskal. dichtiv beh (Shemot 21) velo yeachel et besaro:
Uveegla arufa. dichtiv bah kappara kekadashim, shenneemar (Devarim 21) venikkapper lahem haddam:

Betzippore metzora. detanya, neemar machshir umechapper bifnim, ashamo shel metzora shehu machshir oto leechol bekadashim, vechattato shemmechapper, ushenehem naasim bifnim. veneemar machshir umechapper bachutz, machshir, tzippore metzora shemmachshirin hametzora lavo el toch hammachane, umechapper, egla arufa, shenneemar bah venikkapper lahem haddam, ushenehem naasim chutz laazara. ma machshir umechapper haamur bifnim, shehem ashamo vechattato shel metzora, asa vo machshir kimchapper, detarvayhu kadashim ninhu vaasurim bahanaa, af machshir umechapper haamurim bachutz, shehem tzippore metzora veegla arufa, asa bo machshir kimchapper lihyot asurim bahanaa. umeematay asurin tzippore metzora bahanaa, mishsheat shechita. vehatztzippor hashshechuta vilvad hi sheasura bahanaa. veegla arufa, yeridatah el nachal etan osrattah:
Uvisar hannazir. deamar kera (Bamidbar 6) kadosh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho, giddulo pera sear rosho yihye kadosh:
Ufeter chamor. neemar bo (Shemot 13) vaarafto, veneemar beegla arufa vearfu, ma egla arufa asura bahanaa, af peter chamor asur bahanaa. veeno asur bahanaa ella achar arifa:
Uvasar bechalav. neemar shalosh peamim lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo, echad leissur achila, veechad leissur hanaa, veechad leissur bishshul:

Uvechullin shennishchatu vaazara. dichtiv (Devarim 12) ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom vezavachta, berichuk makom atta zoveach vei atta zoveach bekeruv makom. yachol lo yochlennu aval yashlichennu lakkelavim, talmud lomar (Shemot 22) lakkelev tashlichun oto, oto atta mashlich lakkelev vei atta mashlich lakkelev chullin shennishchatu baazara:

Mecharan vekiddesh bidmehen mekuddeshet. sheen lecha davar shettofes et damav lihyot kamohu ella avoda zara usheviit. avoda zara, shenneemar (Devarim 7) vehayita cherem kamohu, kol ma sheatta mehavve mimmennu hare hu chamohu. usheviit, shenneemar kodesh hi, tofeset dameha kehekdesh. vahavu avoda zara usheviit shene chetuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbain keechad en melammedin:
Shotin al haggat. uchegon shehichnis sham rosho verubbo, delekka lemigzar shemma yavi hakkeli elav veyishte chutz laggat, dechutz laggat have keva veasur lishtot:
Ben al hachammin. ben shemmazag hayyayin bechammin, ben shemmezago vetzonen:
Rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok mechayyev. degazar shemma yotzi min hayyayin chutz laggat:
Al hachammin chayyav. shehu kovea, lefi sheeno yachol lehachazir hammotar, sheyyekalkel hayyayin shebbaggat, aval mazag betzonen patur, sheyyachol lehachazir hammotar. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hassayif vehassakkin vehappigyon. sakkin sheyyesh lo shete fiyyot karuy pigyon:
Maggal yad. maggal chalak asuy leshabber atzamot velachtoch etzim:
Maggal katzir. male fegimot utelamim:

Hashshechor. hem misparayim ketannim shemmegallechin bahem. venikraim shechor lefi shehem mashshirin et hassear, demashshirin umashchirin chad hu, vehachi amrinan beferek mashshilin perot [betza daf la] man detane mashchilin lo mishtabbesh. veyesh mefarshim, hashshechor, taar:
Vehazzug shel sapparim. misparayim gedolim min hashshechor:
Shennechelku. shehen shel chulyot umefarkim otan ze mizze. vechen hattaar yesh sheen bet yad shello mechubbar, umefarkin oto:
Hassamuch layyad. chazi limlacha tefe. aval hassamuch larosh, yare shemma yachtoch yado. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Misperet shennechleka. hem misparayim shel nashim, ucheshennechleka akkatti kol chad chazi lachtoch:
Vachachamim metaharin. kevan shennishbera. vahalacha kachachamim:

Hattemarot shel tiltan. yesh mefarshim lulave tiltan, keen sheyyesh laggefanim, vehen neechalim. veyesh mefarshim keshemmatchil haggivol litzmoach nire bimkom tzemichato kemin gargir av venikra temara, kidamrinan [sukka log.] gabbe hadas niktam rosho vealta vo temara. uvetiltan vechardal ufol hallavan chashuvin ochel:
Hatztzalaf. belaaz 391:
Temarot. lulavin shebbo, veyesh mefarshim happerach:
Aviyyonot. hu ikkar happeri, vekafrisin hu shomer happeri:
Rabbi akiva vechulei. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Usetamuha shemarim hitztziluha. setama kachachamim deyesh tzamid patil mibbifnim:
Ad sheyyemarach. saviv lazzemora min hatztzedadim. aval al hazzemora atzmah lo vae meruach:
Neser. peshute chele etz hu:
Besinim. shennatan ben neser leneser kelippot dakkot shel sene:
O veshogmin. kelippe etz shel shogmin. veotan kelippin natan ben neser leneser kede lechabberan:
Afillu hikdicha tavshilo. serafathu al yede haur o al yede melach. dedarshi vet hillel ervat davar, o erva o davar, kelomar shear davar sirachon sheeno erva:

Rabbi akiva omer afillu matza acheret naa mimmenna. vedarish kera hachi, im lo timtza chen shel noy beenav, o im matza bah erva, o davar shel sirachon, al kol echad mishshelosha devarim hallalu yachol legaresh. vahalacha kevet hillel:
Haolar. keen misparayim shel mattechet shemmetakkenim bo hakkulmosin:
Vehakkulmos. shel nechoshet uvarzel o shel kesef:
Metutelet. [chatichat] barzel veoferet shettaluy bechevel shettofes habbannay beyado lirot shello yavo hakkotel akum:
Vehammishkalot. litra vachatzi litra:
Hakkiron. keli varzel shebbo tochavim hazzetim bammaatzar sheotzrim otan bo:
Vehakkan vehakkanna. haamma shemmesargelim bah hassefarim, vehalluach shettachteha. ken peresh hearuch:
Golme chele etz. shello nishlema melachtan, kegon shechaserim ogen, o ozen, o habbasis shellahen shehen yoshvim alav, o shetztzarich lehachelikan ulehashvotan, nikraim golamim:

Chutz mishshel eshkeroa. garsinan. vehu min erez. teashshur, metargeminan eshkeroa. vegalme chelim shennaasu meetz ze, tehorin, lefi shekkelippato ava vekasha, veen chashuvin kelim ad shettusar kelippatam vetiggamer melachtam. vegirsat hattosefta, chutz mishshel pirasha, mippene shehen mechussarim shelika. ufirasha hu atze gofer. vechelim hannaasim mimmennu en melachtan nigmeret ella vishlika, shemmachnisim otan baesh umotziin shelek, veshuv en yereim shemma yissadku:
Gerofit shel zayit. anaf shel zayit karuy gerofit. kemo shel teena denikra yichur. veim asu cheli min haggerofit, golem hu veeno mekabbel tuma:
Ad sheyyishlok. sheyyachnisu otan baesh ad sheyyotziu hashshelek shellahen. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Haoker shetalim. netiot achar shetztzamchu vegadlu ketzat okrin otan veshotlin otam bemakom acher, vehem mitabbim umitrachavim umitgaddelin sham:
Patur. afillu rau fene habbayit, mippene sheadayin lo nigmera melachtan:
Lakach bimchubbar lakkarka. hakkone perot keshehen mechubbarin patur, sheen hammikkach kovea lammaaser ella vekone betalush, lo vimchubbar:
Lakat. shetilin lishloach lachavero patur:
Im yesh kayyotze vahem nimkarim bashshuk. chashive keillu nigmera melachtan. veen halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya:
Ezo hi chatzer shechayyevet bammaaser. shekkovaat lammaaser kemo vayit:
Chatzer tzorit. shekken betzor hayu moshivin shomer befetach hechatzer:

Kol sheechad poteach veechad noel. kegon sheyyesh bechatzer shene vattim lishne vene adam, uchesheechad mehen poteach petach hechatzer ba hashsheni venoel, uchesheechad noel hashsheni moche veyado ufoteach, nimtzet chatzer sheenah mishtammeret:
Veen omrim lo ma atta mevakkesh petura. veaf al pi sheeno vosh leechol betochah:
Vehachitzona petura. kevan sheyyesh lappenimit derisat haregel aleha enah mishtammeret. vekayma lan halacha kedivre chullan lehachemir:
Dinar shennifsal. sheppesalattu malchut o medina, o shennechsar:
Vehitkino. shennikkevo kede sheyyitlennu betzavvar beno o vetzavvar bitto:
Sela. arbaa dinarim:

Vehitkinah lihyot shokel bah. kesef o zahav. deillu davar hannidbak kegon basar vayayin, ha tanya beferek hammocher et hassefina [bava batra daf 89] sheen osin mishkalot shel mattechet lishkol bahen davar hannidbak:
Ad shene dinarim. shehu shekel echad. vehu chatzi sela:
Pachot mikkan yakotz. shello yerammu vah bene adam sheyyachshevu shehu shekel. vechen im hu yoter mishshekel nammi yakotz shello yitu vo veyikkechuhu vesela:
Tinokot shettamnu teenim. bassade, dei babbayit, belo shabbat bayit kovaat. venakat tinokot leashmuinan deyesh lahem machashava hannikkeret mittoch maasehem:
Lo yochlu lemotzae shabbat. dechevan shekkevatan shabbat lammaaser asurim leolam ad sheyyitasseru:
Kalkalat shabbat. kalkala melea perot sheyyichadah lashshabbat:
Uvet hillel mechayyevin. bammaaser miyyad afillu kodem hashshabbat, dechevan sheyyichadah lashshabbat hukbea miyyad:

Lishloach lachavero. nitbal miyyad, velo yochal aray ad sheyyeasser, vaafillu lo shelachah, lefi shekkevan sheyyichadah leshalchah hu makpid aleha kemo bechalkalat shabbat. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Katav sofer veed. chatam sofer veed. dahave lehu shene edim. veashmeinan matnitin delo chayshinan shemma habbaal lo tzivva lachtom lassofer, ella amar lishnayim imru lassofer veyichtov, velifloni ufeloni edim veyachtomu, vechashu hanach edim lechissufa desafra sheyyomar eni beenav kasher leedut, veachtemuhu velo reshuto devaal. leha lo chayshinan:
Chanichato. shem levay shel mishpacha:
Meusse. bechazka:
Beyisrael kasher. im anasuhu vaddin. kegon kol hanach dechofin lehotzi, o shehayta asura lo. veim anasuhu shello chaddin, pasul. ufosel min hakkehunna, mishshum reach get:

Uvegoyim. kaddin, pasul, ufosel min hakkehunna. shello chaddin, afillu reach get en bo. umi shechayyav litten get min haddin veen koach bedayyane yisrael lechofo, chovtin oto al yede nachrim, sheomrim ase ma sheyyisrael omer lecha, venoten hagget al pi dayyane yisrael:

Hassemichot vehattenufot. enah somechet, veenah menifa, veenah maggeshet mincha vekeren maaravit deromit kemishpatah, im hi chohenet, veenah kometzet velo makteret, veenah moleket of, veenah mekabbelet dam bammizrak, veenah mazza dam:
Chutz missota unezira shehen menifot. minchatan beatzman, shemminchatan teuna tenufa vabbealim:
Hallokeach sede yarak. min hannachri:
Besureya. hem aratzot shekkavash david, kegon dammesek vaaram naharayim vaaram tzova. uvemiktzat devarim asaum keeretz yisrael uvemiktzatan lo:

Im ad shello va leonat hammaasrot chayyav. hoil uveshaa shebbaim lide chiyyuv birshuto shel yisrael hem. aval im higgia et hachiyyuv birshut haoved kochavim patur, dildavar ze asu sureya kechibbush yachid velav shemeh kibbush:
Veloket kedarko. ufatur milleasser af ma shennosaf birshuto. aval poalim lo yiskor, dechayshinan dilma ate lemeavad hachi af besade shellakach ad shello va leonat hammaasrot. verabbi yehuda lo gazar:
Patur. kevan sheen lo beguf hakkarka kelum:

Rabbi omer af lefi cheshbon. ammilteh detanna kamma kae, vehachi kaamar ki hechi dimchayyev im lakach ad shello va leonat hammaasrot leasser al hakkol, hachi nammi mechayyev im higgia leonat maasrot leasser lefi cheshbon shennittosef birshuto, kegon im heviu shelish beyad hannachri, chayyav leasser al shene shelishim shennittosfu virshuto. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

Yatza shemah bair mekuddeshet. penuya sheyyatza aleha kol, pelonit nitkaddesha hayyom lifloni. velo kol havara bilvad, ella kegon shehayu nerot dolkot umittot mutztzaot, uvene adam nichnasim veyotzim veomrim pelonit nitkaddesha hayyom:

Megoreshet hare zo megoreshet. aresha kae, hay itteta deyatza aleha kol mekuddeshet vechayshinan la vaasarnuha linnase ella leoto haish, im chazar veyatza aleha kol megoreshet sheggershah oto peloni sheyyatza lah kol kiddushin mimmennu, hare zo megoreshet umutteret lakkol, shehare kol shechashashnu lo techilla shovro immo:
Uvilvad shello yehe sham amatla. shello yehe im hakkol shel kiddushin o shel gerushin amatla, taam shehu shover et koach hakkol:
Venotea betoch shello lezera. [sheyyitbashshel] bahem hazzera bimkom netiatan:

Mippene shehu garnan. akiratan hu garnan, sheen lahem goren acher lehitchayyev bammaaser, dezaran patur min hammaaser dichtiv (Vayikra 26) mizzera haaretz, velo kol zera, perat lezerone ginna sheenan neechalin, venimtza shennigmera melachtan veasur lenatan ad sheyyeasser:

Taharu milletamme. dechizruin damu, vehattora ribbeta betohorat zeraim, dichtiv (sham 11) al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea tahor hu. aval lechol shear mile kitlushin damu, uvechezkatan hen lammaaser velashsheviit. vaafillu letohorat tuma, davka hishrishu vaaliyya sheyyesh tachtehen afar hammaaziva, aval hishrishu vakkuppa kitlushim dami af leinyan tuma:
Vehen megullin. healin shellahen, kederech gedilatan, kintuim bassade damu, vehattolesh mehen beshabbat chayyav, vechayyavin bashsheviit uvammaasrot:
Vaafillu vetzad sede ketziot. demochcha milleta demehach sade naful, afillu hachi muttarot mishshum gazel, demissetama nityaashu habbealim mehen:
Ufeturot min hammaaser. kedin hefker:
Uvezetim uvecharuvim chayyavin. lefi sheen habbealim mityaashim mehen, shemmarito mochiach alav shemmeilan ze nafal. aval teena im nefilatah nimeset velo yadua meeze ilan hi:
Im darsu rov bene adam. im rov anshe otah hair darsu kevar haggerogarot shellahen bisdotehen, it lan lememar zo min hadderusot hen uchevar nigmera melachtan, vechayyav leasser:
Pilche devela. achar shennidresu vaiggul mechallekim haiggul lechamma pelachin, veyesh befelach harebe develot devukot zo vazo:
Ad shello chenasan lerosh haggag. laasot mehen arema, shehu garnan shel charuvin lammaaser keditnan beferek kamma:

Morid mehen livhema. aval hu lo yochal, sheen ochlim al hammuktze ella vimkoman, kelomar happerot sheshshotchin otam leyabbesh shello nigmera melachtan en ochlim mehen ella vimkoman, deshello vimkoman eno nikkar shello nigmera melachtan. umihu keshemmaachil mehen labbehema afillu shello vimkoman, mittoch sheen hecharuvin maachal behema, meda yedia delo nigmera melachtan velo yavshu kol tzarkan:
Mippene shehu machazir et hammotar. lammakom sheshshotchan sham leyabbesh, vechol hecha demotaro chozer lo tavel:
Haeshet. chaticha shel barzel keshemmotziim oto min hammachtzav:
Charara. leachar shemmattichim habbarzel osim mimmennu iggul kemin uga:
Sovev shel galgal. galgal haagala shel etz, osim sevivo tas shel barzel shello yishshaver batterashim uvasselaim:
Tassin. vayrakkeu et pache hazzahav (Shemot 39), metargeminan veraddidu yat tasse dedahava:
Kanne chelim. besise chelim. leshon veet kanno (sham), dimtargeminan veyat besiseh:
Hogne chelim. kemin anak sevivot sefat hakkelim:
Azne chelim. bet yad sheochazim bo hakkeli:
Hashshecholot. ma shennishtayyer min hakkeli leachar shennaasa. leshon kemishchal binita mechalava (berachot daf 8.) ki min hammayim meshitihu (Shemot 2), metargeminan are min mayya shechalteh:
Gerudot. shennigrad min hakkeli bishat asiyyato. leshon lehitgared bo haamur beiyyov (perek 2):

Tehorim. delo chayshinan bechol hane shemma mikkeli tame vau ucheshechazar veasa mehen keli chazru letumatan yeshana, dechol hane lo niru lekabbel tuma meolam, mishshum degalme chele mattachot ninhu, vegalme chele mattachot en mekabbelin tuma. vehachi tanya battosefta, galme chele mattachot tehorim, veellu hen galme chele mattachot, kol sheatid lashuf, leshabbetz, legared, ulecharkev, ulehakish bekurnas, mechussar ogen o ozen, tahor:
Af min hakketzutzot. im katzatz kelim lachatichot, kelim hannaasim meotan chatichot lo chazru letumatan yeshana. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Gerutaot. kelim shennishtabberu mippene tashmishan venaasa bahen chatichot ketannot achare velotan nikraim gerutot. vehen ketannim mishshivre chelim:
Umin hammasmerot sheyyadua shennaasu mikkelim. af al gav delo yadinan im mikkelim tehorim bau o min hattemein:
Temein. temeim hakkelim hannaasim mehem. dechayshinan shemma mikkelim temein bau vechazru letumatan hayeshana:
Min hammasmerot. setam. delo yadinan im naasu mikkelim o min haeshet:
Bet shammay metammein. degazru hane attu hane:
Uvet hillel metaharin. delo gazru:
Teni. hu cheli shel mattechet machazik shelosha kabbim. vehu milleshon vesamta vattene. uvaale vattim mishtammeshin bo shemmannichin sham gerutaot mishshivre chele mattachot:
Rabban gamliel metamme. desavar kissuy chashuv keli hoil veyesh lo vet kibbul:
Vachachamim metaharin. desavre en kissuy chashiv keli. vahalacha kachachamim:
Veshel rofim tame. ledivre hakkol. mippene sheharofim mannichin bo sammanim:
Migdal. bet haotzar shel etz. 458 belaaz. uvaaravi 381:
Veshel rofim temea. mippene shennoten aleha et haispelanit vetole vah hammisparayim:
Hayyattuchin. melkachayim shennotel bahem hakkeli shehittich bo et hakkesef, lehariko letoch keli acher:
Vehapperachin. battosefta mefaresh ellu hen perachin, hakkevuim bakkirayim. verabbotay lo fershuha li:
Akrav bet habbad. barzel akum dome leakrav, hakkavua bekorat bet habbad sheddorchim bah hazzetim:
Unkeli shebbakketalim. vavin shel barzel hakkevuim bakketalim litlot bahem kelim:
Tehora. deen tashmishan ella im hakkarka:

Enan mekuddashot. deamar kera (Vayikra 18) veishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror, beshaa shennaasu tzarot zo lezo en lecha likkuchin afillu beachat mehen. vehu haddin lechol shear arayot sheyyesh bahen karet, sheen kiddushin tofsin bahem:

Veshellahen hayta. shaminan meha matnitin dehamkaddesh begazel vaafillu begazel didah enah mekuddeshet, velo amrinan middekabbilteh achilteh. middekatane veshellahen hayta veshel sheviit hayta, mishshum deshel sheviit hayta shehapperot hefker mishum hachi hannashim mekuddashot, ella sheen achayot mekuddashot, aval im lo hayta sheviit, hoil veshellahen hayta lo hayu kiddushin tofsim beachat mehen. vedavka begazel shellifne yeush bealim amrinan delo havu kiddushin, aval hamekaddesh begazel shelleachar yeush, kiddushav kiddushin. veshaminan nammi shehamekaddesh beferot sheviit mekuddeshet, velo amrinan enan mamono lizkot bahen, ella chevan shezzacha bahen mamono hem lechol davar. veshaminan nammi sheishsha naaset shaliach lachavertah, vaafillu bimkom shennaaset lah tzara. veaf al gav divchol edut shehaishsha cheshera lah en hatztzara cheshera lah, shelichuta miha chevan deavda avda, deha hacha vakkiddushin hallalu hen naasot tzarot al yede zo shekkibbaltah, vekatane en haachayot mekuddashot, ha nachriyyot mekuddashot. umatnitin mittartza vaggemara alibba dehilcheta hachi, hamekaddesh ishsha uvittah o ishsha vaachotah, shetehen keachat enan mekuddashot, ha achat meishsha uvittah, achat meishsha vaachotah, kegon sheamar lishtehen achat mikkem mekuddeshet li velo feresh leezo mehen mekaddesh, vekibbela achat mehen hakkiddushin al yede chavertah, o shetehen kibbelu kiddushin keachat, mekuddashot, ushetehen tzerichot get. veim amar haruya mikkem levia mekuddeshet li, enan mekuddashot, dechol achat mehen ikka lesappukah baachot ishto veen shum achat mehen reuya levia. umaase nammi vechamesh nashim uvahen shete achayot velikket echad kalkala shel teenim veamar haruya mikkem levia titkaddesh li, veamru chachamim en achayot mitkaddeshot, ha nachriyyot shehayu reuyot levia, mitkaddeshot. aval im amar kullechem mitkaddeshot li, lo hayta shum achat mehen mekuddeshet, dechi hechi deen achayot mekuddashot kach en haacherot mekuddashot hecha deamar kullechem:

Haishsha niknet. lefi sheen haishsha mitkaddeshet ella middatah, tana haishsha niknet velo tana haish kone. veayyde detana resha haishsha niknet, tana sefa hayevama niknet, veaf al gav divama niknet layyavam ben middatah ben shello middatah:
Niknet bechesef. degamrinan kicha kicha missede efron, ketiv hacha (Devarim 24) ki yikkach ish ishsha, uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 26) natatti kesef hassade kach mimmenni:

Bishtar. kegon shekkatav lah al hanneyar o al hacheres veaf al pi sheen bo shave feruta, bittecha mekuddeshet li, bittecha meoreset li, bittecha li leintu, unetano lah bifne edim. veyalfinan la dichtiv (Devarim 24) veyatza vehayta, ma yetzia bishtar, kedichtiv (sham) vechatav lah sefer keritut, af havaya bishtar:

Uvevia. ba aleha bifne edim leshem kiddushin, dichtiv (sham) ki yikkach ish ishsha uvealah. veaf al pi sheen lecha kiddushin meforashim battora yoter mikkiddushe via, amru chachamim shehamekaddesh bevia makkin oto makkat mardut, shello yihyu bene yisrael perutzin:
Bifruta. hi chatzi seora shel kesef:

Hayevama niknet. layyavam lihyot keishto lechol davar, bevia. aval kesef ushetar lo mehannu bah middeorayta, ella rabbanan hu detakkun demahane bah maamar lefaslah al shear haachin, aval lo lefatrah min hachalitza, velo lehittamme lah:
Uteloy hammagredot. bevatte merchatzaot tolin magredot shel mattachot, vehannichnasim sham kol echad lokeach migredet umitgared bah raglav:
Vegolme chele mattachot. kelim shetztzarich lashuf legared ulehakish bekurnas, o shemmechussar ogen, o ozen, enam temeim ledivre chachamim ad shettiggamer melachtan:

Vetavla shennechleka lishnayim. tavla shel cheres sheyyesh bah levizbezim venaaset shete chatichot shavot, sheen achat mehen gedola mechavertah, beha felige rabban gamliel vachachamim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hakkaddur. 126 belaaz:
Happekaat shel gemi. lach aroch shekkorchim oto ze im ze veosim oto agol kemin pekaiyyot shel sheti. 585 belaaz:
Ad sheyyemarach. millematta shel kaddur o shel pekaat ulemala, kede sheyyechasse kullo, mippene shehu chalul:
Vechen matlit shel beged. dechol hane chalulim ninhu. vechullehu en matztzilin ella kesheen bahem shiur lekabbel tuma:
Ukesharah bimshicha. bechut dak kederech sheosim keshemmechassim pi hannod beveged o vinyar shekkoshrim oto, umusaf al hakkeshira vae nammi mericha min hatztzedadin:

Nechasim sheyyesh lahem acharayut. hayenu karkaot, shehammalve et chavero somech alehem lefi shekkayyamim veomdim. uferush acharayut, chazara, shechozer hammalve alehem vetoref otam min hallakochot keshello yimtza chelum lallove:
Niknin bechesef. dichtiv (yirmeya lev) sadot bakkesef yiknu. vehane mille bemakom sheen regilin lichtov shetar, aval bemakom shergilin lichtov shetar lo kana ad sheyyichtov shetar:

Bishtar. shekkotev al hanneyar o al hacheres sadi netuna lecha sadi kenuya lecha, umosro lakkone. vedavka bemattana nikne hakkarka bishtar. aval bimchira, ad sheyyitten et hakkesef, ella im ken mocher sadehu mippene raatah, divha kana bishtar lechudeh. umenalan dimkarkee niknin bishtar, dichtiv (yirmeya lev) vechatov bassefer vechatom:

Uvachazaka. kegon shechafar bakkarka meat, o naal, vegadar, ufaratz kol shehu bifne hammocher. veim haya shello vefanav, tzarich sheyyomar lo lech chazek ukene. umena lan shekkarka nikne vachazaka, dichtiv (Devarim 11) virishtem otah vishavtem bah, bamme yerashtem, bishiva:
Vesheen lahem acharayut en niknin ella vimshicha. dichtiv (Vayikra 25) o kano miyyad amitecha, davar sheefshar letitto miyyad leyad eno nikne ella vintina miyyad leyad:

Niknin im nechasim kulei. im machar mittaltelin im hakkarka, kevan shekkana lokeach hakkarka beechad mishshelosha kinyanim hallalu, niknu mittaltelin immah, vehu sheyyomar lo kene [hane] aggav karka. venafka lan mikkera dichtiv bedivre hayyamim (2 21) vayyitten lahem avihem mattanot rabbot lechesef ulezahav ulemigdanot im are metzurot:

Vezokkin. nechasim hallalu sheen lahem acharayut et hannechasim sheyyesh lahem acharayut kulei. af al gav deen nishbain al hakkarkaot, hecha ditano mittaltelin vekarkaot venitchayyev lishshava al hammittaltelin, zokkin hammittaltelin et hakkarkaot lishshava alehem al yede gilgul shevua. velamadnu gilgul shevua missota, dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) veamra haishsha amen amen, amen meish ze, amen meish acher. amen shello satiti arusa, amen shello satiti nesua, shomeret yavam, uchenusa:
Hallokeach chayya lezivche shelamim. veen karban ba min hachayya, dichtiv (Vayikra 1) min habbakar umin hatztzon:

Uvehema livsar taava. chachamim gazru shello yiknu behema mimmeot maaser sheni ella shelamim, lefi shebbarishona haya muttar likkach behema livsar taava, kevan sherau shehayu hakkol lokchim behema livsar taava umavrichim otah meal gabbe hammizbeach, chazru veamru lo yikchu:
En haor yotze lechullin. kelomar eno vetorat zo sheyyetze haor lechullin, ella lo kana maaser lo hachayya velo habbehema, denaase kekone shor lacharisha bidme maaser, delo kana maaser:
Lo yatza hakkankan lechullin. kevan shennahagu limkor hayyayin belo hakkankan:
Lo yatzu deme hakkeli lechullin. lefi shedderech lemachran belo hakkeli:
Shum baal bechi. shum charif shehaochlo boche veenav zolgot demaot. veli nire shum haggadel behar hallevanon, shekken baaravi korin lallevanon 102:
Richpa. shem makom:
Gerisin hakkillekin. gerisin shel pol habbaim min hakkilki, shem makom, vehen merubbaot, keditnan bingaim (86 41) kigris hakkilki hammerubba:
Vaadashim hammitzriyyot. roshan echad chad. vehamminin hallalu kullam hem midbariyyot, vechezkatan min hahefker, lefi sheenan nizraim bagginna, lefichach peturim min hammaasrot:
Af hakkurekas. baaravi 291, vehu min mimmine hakkeruv:
Hakkutenim. mimmine haadashim. vahalacha kistam mishna:
Venilkachim mikkol adam. af min hachashudim limkor perot sheviit:
Zera halluf haelyon. ani shamati halluf hashshote. aval zera halluf happikkeach chayyav. verambam peresh shehammishna mesoreset, zera haelyon shel luf. veluf hu mimmine habbetzalim:

Sheaf al pi sheavihen teruma. af al pi sheechad mikkol ellu zerone ginna sheenam neechalim hen teruma, uzeraan, hare haggiddulim neechalin. velo amrinan giddule teruma teruma ella keshehazzera hazzarua hu middevarim haruyin laachila:
Sheavihen. hazzera, shehu av lema sheggadel mimmennu:
Shifcha godelet. kolaat sear hannashim. perush acher, dabberanit uvaalat lashon, kemo shenneemar (Yechezkel la) vattagdilu alay befichem:
Af al pi sheamra belibbi haya lehitkaddesh kulei. didvarim shebballev enam devarim:
Tannur yashan. shehussak kede leefot bo sufganim, shezzo hi gemar melachto lihyot chashuv keli lekabbel tuma:
Chadash. shello hussak veeno mekabbel tuma:
Usereda al pi hayyashan. veenah memurachat betit, veen kan tzamid patil:
Nittal hayyashan usereda nofelet. sheenah nismechet al pi hechadash:

Hakkol tame. shehayyashan shealav hassereda chashuv keli veeno matztzil ella betzamid patil, vahare en kan tzamid patil. vehechadash sheeno keli haya chotzetz bifne hattuma mishshum ohel im hayta hassereda nismechet alav, dechol hammatztzil mishshum ohel eno tzarich letzamid patil. aval bizman sheen hassereda nismechet alav en kan ohel, hilkach hakkol tame:

Im en ben chadash lassereda foteach tefach. im en gova tefach ben hakkissuy sheal hayyashan lappe shel hattannur hechadash, nechshav hakkissuy sheal hayyashan keillu hu befi hechadash, venaasa hechadash ohel vechotzetz bifne hattuma vechol ma shebbetocho tahor:
Sivlonot. doronot shedderech chatan lishloach laarusato:
Enah mekuddeshet. velo amrinan yodea haya sheen kiddushav kiddushin vegamar veshalach sivlonot leshem kiddushin, ella amrinan mechamat kiddushin harishonim shalach:
Vechen katan shekkiddesh. veshalach sivlonot mishshehigdil:
Shehitkino. sheikkem rosho o chiddedo kede sheyyihye poteach venoel bo:
Heasuy lishmira. lesiman lirot im nichnas sham adam im lav, sheim lo yimtzaennu kemo shehinnicho beyadua sheadam ba lesham:
Ad sheyyitzrefennu. baesh letzorech ze. vahalacha kachachamim:

Masmer hashshulchani. masmer kavua baammud shellifne hashshulchani lehaamid bo terise hachanut, ucheshemmesallek hatterisim nishar sham hammasmer. umetaharin rabbanan mishshum detashmisho im hakkarka. vahalacha kachachamim:
En mochrin oto. degamrinan geulla geulla mecharamim, neemar bemaaser (Vayikra 27) lo yiggael, veneemar bacharamim (sham) lo yimmacher velo yiggael, ma lehallan mechira immo, af kan mechira immo:

Tamim chay. vehu haddin nammi shachut, shenneemar lo yiggael, eno nimkar lo chay velo shachut, lo tamim velo vaal mum. ella tamim, chelbo vedamo kerevin al gabbe hammizbeach, vehabbasar ochlin oto habbealim birushalayim. uvaal mum, ochlim oto habbealim bechol makom. veayde devae lemitne sefa gabbe bechor mochrim oto tamim chay, tane nammi resha tamim chay:
Veen mekaddeshin bo et haishsha. dahave kemecher:
Habbechor mochrin oto tamim chay. mishshum devivchor ketiv (Bamidbar 18) lo tifde, aval nimkar hu:
Umekaddeshin bo et haishsha. demamono shel kohen hu umuttar lemachro:
Asimon. matbea sheen alav tzura, veen mechallelin alav maaser sheni dichtiv (Devarim 14) vetzarta hakkesef beyadecha, kesef sheyyesh alav tzura:
Velo al hammatbea sheeno yotze. dichtiv (sham) venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha, perat lechesef sheeno yotze, sheeno yachol liknot mimmennu ma shehu rotze:
Velo al hammaot sheenan birshuto. kegon shennafal kiso layyam haggadol, eno yachol lifdot maaser sheni al maot shebbetocho, shehu tzarich liskor mi sheshshat al pene hammayim lehotzio:
Ochel kedarko. min hannof haomed bagginna:
Ochel achat achat. min hannof hannote lechatzer:
Veim tzeraf. shenayim chayyav:
Hakkol holech achar haikkar. deshadinan nofo batar ikkaro, shehu mekom yenikat hailan:
Uvevatte are choma hakkol holech achar haikkar. af hannof hannote chutz lachoma, im lo gealo betoch hashshana, nechlat litzmitut keillu haya betoch hachoma, hoil veikkar hailan betoch hachoma hu:

Uveare miklat hakkol holech achar hannof. af achar hannof kaamar, sheim ikkaro bifnim betoch techum are miklat venofo note chutz lattechum, ki hechi divikkaro lo matze goel haddam katel leh larotzeach, benofo nammi lo matze katel leh, deshadinan nofo batar ikkaro. vei ikkaro bachutz venofo bifnim, ki hechi divnofo lo matze katel leh, beikkaro nammi lo matze katel leh, deshade ikkaro batar nofo lechumra. vechen birushalayim holech achar hannof leinyan maaser sheni, hayenu nammi lechumra, deikkaro bachutz venofo lifnim, ki hechi divnofo lo matze parek, deen maaser tahor nifde betoch yerushalayim, beikkaro nammi lo matze parek leh. vei ikkaro bifnim venofo lachutz, ki hechi devimkom nofo lo matze achel leh belo fediyya, shehare hu chutz lirushalayim, hachi nammi bimkom ikkaro af al pi shehu bifnim lo matze achel leh belo fediyya:

Kol mitzvot habben al haav. kol mitzvot habben hammuttalot al haav laasot livno. vehen shishsha devarim, lemulo, lifdoto im hu vechor, lelammedo tora, lelammedo ummanut, lehassio ishsha, lehashito bannahar:
