Anashim chayyavim. haav chayyav bammitzvot hallalu livno, vehaem petura:

Vechol mitzvot haav. hammuttalot al habben laasot leaviv, shehem mora vechavod. mora, lo yeshev bimkomo, velo yistor et devarav, velo yachria et devarav. kavod, maachil umashke. malbish umechasse, machnis umotzi:
Echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavim. habbanim vehabbanot chayyavim:
Vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah. shehazzeman garam lammitzva shettavo, kegon shofar, sukka, lulav, vetzitzit:

Shello hazzeman geramah. kegon mezuza, maake, aveda, veshilluach hakken. vehane tere chelale lav davka, kidkayma lan en lemedin min hakkelalot afillu vemakom shenneemar bahem chutz, shehare matztza belel happesach, vesimcha vammoadim, vehakehel bechag hassukkot, kullan mitzvot ase shehazzeman geramah hen, venashim chayyavot. vetalmud tora, uferiyya ureviyya, ufidyon habben, mimmitzvot ase shello hazzeman geramah hen, venashim peturot. aval kelala vatra dechol mitzvot lo taase echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavim, chutz mibbal takkif uval tashchit uval tittamma lammetim, kelala davka hu, veyalfinan leh middichtiv (Bamidbar 5) ish o ishsha chi yaasu mikkol chattot haadam, hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashin shebbattora:

Chutz mibbal takkif uval tashchit. dichtiv (Vayikra 19) lo takkifu peat roshchem, velo tashchit et peat zekanecha. kol sheyyeshno vehashechata yeshno vehakkafa, vechol sheeno vehashechata eno vehakkafa. vehane nashe hoil veletanhu vehashechata letanhu vehakkafa. umenalan deletanhu vehashechata, dichtiv peat zekanecha, velo chetiv peat zekanchem, may zekanecha, zekancha velo zekan ishtecha:
Uval tittamma lemetim. dichtiv (sham 21) emor el hakkohanim bene aharon, bene aharon velo venot aharon:
Vehalach vekiddeshah bemakom acher kulei. demare makom hu lo. veen ze tenay:

Haish mekaddesh bo uvishlucho. bo techilla veachar kach bishlucho, shemmitzva bo yoter mibbishlucho, dechi asik gufo bammitzva mekabbel sachar tefe. veyalfinan shelucho shel adam kemoto mikkera, dichtiv (Shemot 12) veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael, vechi kol yisrael shochatin, ella mikkan sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto:

Haish mekaddesh et bitto keshehi naara. vechol shekken keshehi ketanna. vehay denakat naara, orach ara ashmoinan, sheasur laadam lekaddesh et bitto keshehi ketanna ad shettagdil vetomar bifloni ani rotza:
Veim lav enah mekuddeshet. dechevan deamar hitkaddeshi hitkaddeshi, kol chad have kiddushin beappe nafshayhu:

Ad sheyyehe veachat mehen shave feruta. hay achat mehen lo mittokma ella vaacharona shebbahen, dechi amar lah hitkaddeshi li bazo uvazo uvazo vehayta ochelet achat achat, kol otan sheachla havu milve gabbah, vechi matya acharona shebbah nigmarin hakkiddushin, i it bah shave feruta have leh mekaddesh bemilve uferuta, vekayma lan hamekaddesh bemilve uferuta datah apperuta umekuddeshet. aval i let baacharona shave feruta, af al gav deikka bekammae shave feruta, ki mate gemar kiddushin have leh mekaddesh bemilve, vehamekaddesh bemilve enah mekuddeshet:
Hamekaddesh bitrumot. teruma gedola uterumat maaser:
Uvemaasrot. maaser rishon umasar ani:
Umattanot. hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva:
Uveme chattat. uveme efer chattat. ureuyim lemachram lattemeim likkach mehem sechar havaa usechar milluy hammayim. aval sechar hazzaa usechar kiddush, vehu netinat haefer bammayim, asur:

Vaafillu yisrael. hachi kaamar, vaafillu yisrael shennaflu lo terumot umattanot mibbet avi immo kohen, shezzacha bahem veyachol lemachram lakkohanim, im kiddesh bahem et haishsha, mekuddeshet. vaafillu lo naflu lo terumot ella tevalim sheadayin lo huremu, hoil umorisho chohen haya omed laharimam vehatterumot shello, veze hayyisrael sheyyarash otam nammi yafrish mehem hatteruma vehi shello, veyachol lemachrah lakkohanim, demattanot shello huremu kemi shehuremu damu:

Kene moznayim shel sarokot. sorke tzemer ufishtim, umochrim oto beminyan litraot, kesherotzin lishkol yesh lahem makkel aroch shel etz vetaluy berosho chemin tabbaat millemala, veunkelayot shel barzel teluyin millematta veshalshelet, asuyin kemin vavin verashehem kefufim millemala, veyesh leoto makkel tabbaat acheret shemmehallechet al pene chol hammakkel veenah yechola latzet mimmennu, uchemin eshet shel barzel o shel nechoshet av vechaved taluy beotah tabbaat, ucheshebba lishkol sak shel tzemer o shel matve, tochev et haunkeli bassak veochez battabbaat shekkenegdo lemala umaalehu baavir, vehattabbaat shebbo haeshet shel barzel taluy marchikah mittabbaat sheochez bah, umachbedet al hakkane ad sheyyavo veyosher shello yachria leshum tzad yoter, ulefi harechakat hattabbaat shebbo haeshet shel barzel yodea cheshbon hammishkal, sheyyesh simanim bammakkel, ad kan litra achat, ad kan asara, ad kan mea. veze nikra peles bilshon mikra, kedichtiv (yeshaya 40) veshakal bappeles harim. peles umozne mishpat laAdonai‏ (Mishlei 16):
Veshel baale vattim. en regilim latet bo unkelayot shehen otan havvavin shettochavim bassak lehaaloto, ella velo unkelayot koshrim bachevel vetolin bakkane. unkelayot garsinan, velo garsinan unkeyot:
Unkeli shel kattafin. etz aroch keen mot shehakkattaf manniach al ketefo vetole vo shene sakkim echad lefanav veechad meacharav bishne unkelayot shel barzel hattechuvot bammot al shene ketzotav:
Shel rochlim. mochre vesamim vetamruke nashim:
Temea. mippene sheyyesh lah bet kibbul:
Shellefanav temea. lefi shehu mishtammesh bah:
Veshelleacharav tehora. sheeno mishtammesh bah ella lishmira, shello yippol hammasseoy meacharav. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Dargash. mitta ketanna shel or vetolin retzuot bisfat haor saviv veyesh unkelayot shel barzel baarukkot hammitta uchesherotzim lintotah onvin hartzuot beotan unkelayot:

Naklitin. shene ammudim shemmaamidin beemtza dafne hammitta, echad marashoteha veechad bemargeloteha, umefutztzalin berashehen, umannichin kane mizze laze uforsim alav sadin. ufeamim sheen haammudim mefutztzalim, ella cheen shene vavin mannichin berashe hannaklitin, vehu unkeli:
Shidda. teva ketanna:
Akon. teva sheosin hatztzayyadim latzud bah dagim:
Kol hamechubbar lattame. unkeli hamechubberet lichli hamekabbel tuma, tame:
Lattahor. kegon menorat haetz shehi tehora, tehora:
Achat achat bifne atzman. kol unkeli shepparsha mikkeli:
Tehora. lefi sheen lah shem bifne atzmo:
Hametammed. hannoten mayim bachartzannin uvazzaggin o vashshemarim nikra metammed. vehacha mayre benoten mayim bashshemarim davka:
Umatza chede middato. lav davka kede middato, daafillu natan shalosh kaddot shel mayim umatza shalosh vachetzi patur, ad sheyyitten shalosh veyimtza arba:
Patur. veaf al gav dishmarim yehave vehu taam, patur, detaam shemarim shel tevel lo chashiv taam gamur ella keyuha bealma:

Rabbi yehuda mechayyev. desavar i efshar sheyyetzu chol hammayim lachutz, ella nishar chatzi kad shel mayim betoch hashshemarim, venimtza sheellu hashshalosh kaddot vachetzi sheyyatzu yesh bahen kad echad shel yayin ushenayim vachetzi mayim, vahavo keyayin mazug, shekken derech mezigat hayyayin. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Matza yoter mikkede middato. vehu derama telata veashkach arbaa:
Motzi alav mimmakom acher. af mimmakom acher, kelomar lo mibbaya minneh uveh deshare, ella af mimmakom acher yachol leasser lefi cheshbon hayyeter al middato:
Pika. kemin kaddur katan nakuv baemtza shemmesimot hannashim berosh happelech shettoot bo kede sheyyichbad:
Rabbi akiva metamme. dichli mattachot sheyyesh lo shem bifne atzmo hu, vetame, keditnan beresh pirkin:
Vachachamim metaharin. deen lo shem bifne atzmo ella shem levay, pika shel kush, o pika shel oto davar shehi meshammeshet lo. vahalacha kachachamim:
Umetzuppa. im hi shel etz umetzuppa vemattechet tame:
Tehora. devatar ikkara azlinan, velo vatar hatztzippuy shehu shel mattechet tame:
Kush. pelech shehannashim toot bo:
Vehammakkel. shel mattechet tame. hoil veadam rode vo et habbehema, kichli asuy letashmish adam hu chashuv:
Simponya. min keli zemer hu, kedichtiv bedaniyyel (perek 3) pesanterin vesimponya:
Vechalil. af hu min shel keli zemer, vechalul hu vekolo nishma ad lemerachok:

Umetzuppin tehorim. im [hu] shel etz umetzuppe nechoshet tame, tahor hu. devatar ikkar hakkeli azlinan shehu shel etz, vela chashiv yesh lo vet kibbul af al pi shehu chalul, kevan sheeno asuy levet kibbul:

Im yesh lah bet kibbul kenafayim. kelim dakkim ketannim kidmut kenafayim notnim betoch hassimponya. shemmesayyeim lehashemaat kol hanniggun. veim asu vetochah makom levet kibbul shel kenafayim hallalu, chashiv bet kibbul:
Ben kach uven kach. ben shehi metzuppa uven sheenah metzuppa, temea:
Hatztzerifim. en lahem gag, ella hakkorot lemala nogot zo vazo veholchim umitrachavim lematta:
Vehabburganim. kemin shovachim, asuyin bassadot leetzor bahen perot:
Vehaelkatiyyot. sukkot sheosim bimot hachamma letzel. targum kayitz kayta:
Sukkat ginnosar. yam kinneret metargeminan ginnosar, vehu makom beeretz haggalil shepperotav merubbim vetovim, veyoshvav osim sukkot vedarim sham kol zeman happerot:
Af al pi sheyyesh sham rechayim vetarnegolim. lo have keva:
Sukkat hayyotzrim. regilim laasot shete sukkot zo lifnim mizzo, bappenimit matznia kederotav vedar sham, uvachitzona ose melachto umocher kederotav:
Kol sheena dirat hachamma vedirat haggeshamim. vesukka penimit en hayyotzer dar bah bimot haggeshamim, hilkach petura, veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Rabbi yehuda mechayyev. rabbi yehuda letaameh, desavar sukka dirat keva bainan vechayyevet bimzuza. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Tivno. shibbolin shenniddoshu, ufeamim nishar bahen chittin:
Gifto. pesolet shel zetim:
Zaggav. pesolet shel anavim:
Lehotzi mehen mashkin. aggifto vezaggav kae:
Al hakkuttain. shibbolot ketuot shello niddoshu:
